articles.title: BRF-GS: Hyperspectral Bidirectional Reflectance Factor Modeling and Image Generation Based on 3D Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: The bidirectional reflectance factor (BRF) characterizes the directional radiative properties of terrestrial surfaces. However, existing three-dimensional (3D) radiative transfer models require complex scene construction and computationally intensive radiative transfer solvers, limiting efficient generation of multi-angle hyperspectral reflectance imagery. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) offers an efficient framework for neural scene representation and novel view synthesis, but its low-order spherical harmonics representation is insufficient for complex directional reflectance, while the high dimensionality and inter-band quality differences of hyperspectral data introduce additional challenges. To address these challenges, we propose BRF-GS, a 3DGS-based framework for BRF modeling and hyperspectral reflectance image generation. BRF-GS introduces a hybrid BRDF-driven kernel to represent complex directional reflectance, selects geometry-reliable spectral bands for robust 3D scene initialization, and adopts a two-stage training strategy that decouples geometry optimization from spectral modeling. We further construct the AIR-BRF dataset, a multi-angle hyperspectral directional reflectance dataset comprising three scenes with diverse natural and artificial targets. Experiments demonstrate that BRF-GS achieves superior spatial and spectral fidelity and accurately reproduces characteristic view-dependent BRF responses. The proposed framework provides an efficient data-driven approach for BRF modeling and multi-angle hyperspectral reflectance image generation in remote sensing scenes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BRF-GS:基于3D高斯电镀的超光谱双向反射系数模型和图像生成
articles.content_zh: 双向反射因子(BRF)是地面表面方向辐射特性的特征. 然而,现有的三维(3D)辐射转移模型需要复杂的场景构造和计算密集的辐射转移解析器,限制了多角超光谱反射图像的有效生成. 3D高斯平板化(3DGS)为神经场景表现和新颖取景合成提供了高效的框架,但其低序球形口腔表现不足以进行复杂的方向反射,而高频谱数据的高维度和波段间质量差异带来了额外的挑战. 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用基于3DGS的BRF-GS框架,用于BRF模型和超光谱反射图像生成。 BRF-GS引入了混合BRDF驱动的内核来代表复杂的方向反射,选择几何-可信赖的光谱带来进行强力的3D场景初始化,并采用从光谱模型中去除几何优化的两相相训练策略. 我们进一步构建AIR-BRF数据集,这是一个由三个场景组成的多角高光谱方向反射数据集,具有不同的自然和人工目标. 实验表明,BRF-GS实现了优越的空间和光谱忠心,并准确地再现了具有特征的依赖视图的BRF响应. 拟议框架为BRF模型制作和遥感场景多角超光谱反射图像生成提供了高效的数据驱动方法.

articles.title: BLARM: Animating 3D Objects from Video via Blending Latent Rigid Motion Primitives
articles.content: We introduce BLARM, a feed-forward method for video-driven 3D mesh animation. Given a monocular video and a static object mesh, BLARM predicts a temporally coherent animated mesh whose motion follows the video. Rather than relying on explicit rigs or directly regressing high-dimensional vertex motion, we represent animation using a compact set of learned, time-varying rigid motion components and time-invariant vertex-to-component skinning weights. This yields a low-dimensional deformation space without requiring skeletons, cages, skinning weights, or rig annotations. Our architecture conditions geometry-derived deformation latents on video features through factorized spatial-temporal attention, then decodes rigid transformations blended by predicted skinning weights. Trained with trajectory reconstruction, entropy regularization, and motion-aware contrastive learning, BLARM produces accurate and temporally stable animations while recovering compact, interpretable motion structure from monocular video.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BLARM: 通过 Blending Latent Rigid Motion Primitives 制作视频的动画 3D 对象
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍BLARM,一种视频驱动的3D网格动画的向导方法. BLARM预测一个时间性连贯的动画网, 我们不依靠明确的钻机或直接倒置高维顶部运动,而是使用一套精密的、有时间变化的刚性运动组件和时间变化的顶点到组件的剥取重量来代表动画。 这产生出一个低维变形空间,而不需要骨架,笼子,剥皮重量或钻机说明. 我们的建筑条件 几何衍生的变形潜伏 在视频特征 通过因地制宜的空间-时空关注, 然后解码 刚性变形 由预测的剥皮重量混合。 BLARM在进行轨迹重建、 en正态化和运动感知对比性学习方面的培训后,在从单视视频中恢复紧凑、可解释的运动结构的同时,制作准确和时间稳定的动画。

articles.title: VeriCam: A Verification Baseline for the Classification of Unknown Data
articles.content: The advent of foundation models have enabled a new era in zero-shot classification. Yet, key challenges persist. Despite their impressive generalization power that leverages the immense pre-training knowledge, both foundation models for image and text as well as vision-text hybrids lack the representational power needed for fine-grained, minutiae-based class separation that some real-world tasks require. To address the current gaps in the literature, we propose VeriCam, a pipeline designed to learn highly specialized features that enable classification of unknown classes in unseen data. VeriCam works by leveraging the representation power of image models trained for the verification task, where the model develops an intricate feature space that incorporates fine-grained details. By training a model to discriminate between pairs of images from the same and different classes, a relational graph is constructed, representing the class relationships between data points. We then present two approaches for graph clustering: a naive algorithm and a specific setup for the Leiden graph clustering algorithm. The pipeline is validated on the LPLCv2 dataset, which comprises real-world traffic surveillance images. We show that the dataset carries an inherent capture device bias that is posed as a generalization challenge for downstream License Plate recognition tasks such as OCR. As such, we dynamically identify capture devices with a label-agnostic approach, enabling the construction of a fair and unbiased benchmark. In the cross-device scenario, our pipeline reaches an F1-Score of 93.45 in the verification baseline and a V-Measure score of 80.13 in the clustering step. All code is publicly available at https://github.com/lmlwojcik/VeriCam
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VeriCam:未知数据分类核查基线
articles.content_zh: 基础模型的出现使得零射入分级制有了一个新的时代. 然而,关键的挑战依然存在。 尽管图像和文字的基础模型以及视觉文字混合体具有惊人的通俗化能力,利用了巨大的培训前知识,但缺乏一些现实世界的任务所需要的精细、精细的分类分离所需的代表性能力。 为了解决文献中目前存在的空白,我们提议使用VeriCam这一管道来学习高度专业化的特征,从而能够将未知的类别在无形数据中分类。 VeriCam通过利用为核查任务所培训的图像模型的能见度来工作,该模型在其中开发出包含精细细节的复杂特征空间。 通过训练一种模式来区分来自相同和不同阶层的一对图像,构建出一种关系图,代表数据点之间的类关系. 然后我们提出两种图集方法:一种是天真的算法,另一种是莱顿图集算法的具体设置. 管道在LPLCv2数据集上进行验证,该数据集包含现实世界的交通监控图像. 我们显示,数据集带有内在的捕捉设备偏差,这是对下游许可板识别任务(如OCR)的概括化挑战. 因此,我们以不可知的标签方法动态地确定捕获装置,从而能够构建一个公平和公正的基准。 在交叉设备的情况下,我们的管道在核查基线中达到F1-分数93.45分,在集群步骤中达到V-分数80.13分。 所有代码均可在https://github.com/lmlwojcik/VeriCam上公开查阅。

articles.title: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
articles.content: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events. We present DreamX-Creator 1.0, a compact native joint audio-video generation system centered on a 7B generator. Conditioned on a first frame and a text prompt, the generator jointly denoises modality-specialized audio and video streams. The streams are processed independently in the first half of the network and coupled in the latter half through Gated Cross-Modal Attention, whose token- and head-wise output gates modulate each active cross-modal attention-head output. A unified Audio-Video Data System constructs and filters temporally coherent clips, produces structured multimodal annotations, and organizes clips into capability-oriented data pools. Progressive Joint Training comprises two audio-video pre-training stages followed by High-Quality Finetuning. Audio-Video Reinforcement Learning further post-trains the generator with Modality-Aware Multimodal Feedback that routes video-, audio-, and cross-modal feedback to the corresponding streams. For high-resolution output, our Autoregressive 1-Step 2K Refinement pipeline adapts a bidirectional multi-step teacher into an autoregressive multi-step refiner and distills it into a student requiring one denoising evaluation per temporal chunk. Overall, DreamX-Creator 1.0 achieves native, synchronized audio-video generation with performance competitive with state-of-the-art open-source systems. By releasing our compact 7B generator and 2K Refiner, we seek to democratize native audio-video generation and provide an accessible foundation for future research in unified audio-video generative modeling.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DreamX-创造者:以2K分辨率实现原声视频生成民主化
articles.content_zh: 近期的视频生成器经常会省略音频或者在单独的阶段进行合成,限制了视觉动态和相声事件的对等模型化. 我们介绍DreamX-Creator 1.0,是一个紧凑的本土联合音频-视频生成系统,以7B型发电机为中心. 以第一帧和文本提示为条件,生成器联合去除模式专用音频和视频流. 溪流在网络上半段独立处理,后半段通过Gated Cross-Modal Content进行相接,其符号和头向输出门会调节每个活性跨模式的注意头输出. 一个统一的音频视频数据系统构建和过滤时间上一致的剪辑,制作结构化的多式说明并组织剪辑入以能力为导向的数据集合. 进步联合培训包括两个视听培训前阶段,然后是高质量精细调整。 音频视频强化 进一步学习使用 Modality-Aware 多模式反馈将视频、音频和跨模式反馈传送到相应流中。 对于高分辨输出,我们的"自动回转"1-Sep 2K"精细化管将一双向多步生师改编为"自动回转多步生"精细化器并分馏成学生,要求每分时段进行一次去名评价. 总体而言,DreamX-Creator 1.0实现了本土,同步的音频视频生成,与最先进的开源系统具有性能竞争力. 通过释放我们紧凑的7B生成器和2K炼油器,我们力求使本地音频视频生成民主化,并为今后在统一音频视频基因模型的研究提供无障碍的基础。

articles.title: One Adapter, Many Tasks: Task-Conditioned Feature Transformations for Continual Learning
articles.content: Class-incremental learning (CIL) requires a model to incrementally learn tasks that contain new classes without accessing earlier training data while preserving the ability to recognize all seen classes. Recently, pretrained-model-based approaches have become prevalent by adapting a frozen backbone with additional lightweight trainable modules. Existing methods, however, exhibit limitations: task-specific adapters learn explicit per-task representations but are parameter- and computation-inefficient, while LoRA-based merging methods combine per-task LoRA parameters into a single model whose static aggregated weights cause representation interference during inference. To address these problems, we present \textbf{FACET}: task-conditioned \textbf{F}e\textbf{A}ture transformation with \textbf{C}ondition\textbf{E}d feature consis\textbf{T}ency, achieving excellent parameter efficiency while producing highly discriminative features during inference. When continually trained on a task sequence, FACET learns a single shared adapter that employs a dynamic task-conditioned feature transformation, shaping the overall feature distribution of the adapter into a mixture of overlap-reduced task-specific components. On the other hand, we propose an efficient replay-free task-conditioned feature consistency loss, aiming to mitigate catastrophic forgetting of the learned mixture distribution in the adapter's feature space. Even when maintaining only a single adapter, FACET demonstrates robust scalability. On both very long task sequences (e.g., 200 tasks) and standard short task sequences (e.g., 20 tasks), our method achieves superior performance while using significantly fewer trainable parameters and GFLOPs. The code will be made open source upon acceptance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个适应器,很多 任务:有任务规定 持续学习的特性转换
articles.content_zh: 班级递增学习(CIL)需要一种模式来渐进地学习包含新班级的任务,而不获取更早的培训数据,同时保留识别所有所见班级的能力. 最近,采用经过预先培训的以模型为基础的方法,将一个有额外轻量级可培训模块的冷冻骨干加以改造,从而变得很普遍。 然而,现有方法显示出局限性:任务特定适配器学习清晰的每个任务表述,但参数和计算效率不高,而基于LORA的合并方法将每个任务LORA参数合并成一个单一模型,其静态总重在推论中会导致表示干扰. 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了\textbf{FACET}: 任务条件的\textbf{F}\textbf{A} 以\textbf{C}的ture transforming with\textbf{C} ondition\textbf{E}d 特征 consis\textbf{T} 密度, 在推论中实现极佳的参数效率, 同时产生高度歧视的特性 。 在不断接受任务序列培训时,FACET学习使用动态任务条件特性转换的单一共享适配器,将适配器的整体特性分布塑造为由重叠-减少任务特定组件组成的混合. 另一方面,我们提出一个高效的无任务重放附加条件的特征一致性损失,旨在减轻灾难性地忘记在适配器的特征空间中学到的混合物分布. 即使只维持一个可适配器,FACET也表现出了强大的可伸缩性. 在非常长的任务序列(如200个任务)和标准短的任务序列(如20个任务)上,我们的方法既能实现优异的性能,同时又能使用大量更少的可训练参数和GFLOP. 该代码在被接受后会成为开源.

articles.title: Robust retinal biometrics for patient identity verification and retrieval across age and imaging devices
articles.content: Patient identity errors can compromise longitudinal medical records, research databases, and downstream clinical decisions. We present a retinal biometric system for verifying claimed identities and retrieving the correct identity from color fundus images. We trained a 512-dimensional metric-learning encoder combining a ConvNeXtV2 backbone with ArcFace and triplet losses on 227,004 images from 21,851 patient-eye identities in the Rotterdam Study, spanning multiple imaging devices and up to 32.6 years of follow-up. The system was evaluated on held-out Rotterdam Study data and externally on the UK Biobank and Age-Related Eye Disease Study (AREDS). Before evaluation, we used the model to screen for identity inconsistencies and manually adjudicated flagged images, identifying incorrect assignments in 0.588% of Rotterdam Study images, 0.259% of UK Biobank images, and 0.164% of AREDS images. In retrospective-only verification after removing near-duplicate images, the system achieved AUROCs of 0.9998, 0.9997, and 0.9998 in the Rotterdam Study, UK Biobank, and AREDS, respectively. For identity retrieval using only previously acquired images, Recall@1 was 99.7%, 97.2%, and 97.6%, respectively, from galleries averaging 4436-8510 identities; the correct identity appeared among the top five results in at least 98.6% of cases. Performance remained robust across imaging devices and long follow-up intervals, while lower image quality and inconsistent retinal fields accounted for most failures. These findings establish retinal anatomy as a durable biometric signal, useful for safeguarding the integrity of longitudinal imaging records.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 硬视网膜生物鉴别技术,用于跨年龄和成像设备的病人身份核查和检索
articles.content_zh: 患者身份误差会损害纵向病历,研究数据库,下游临床决策. 我们提出了一个视网膜生物鉴别系统,用以核实声称的身份,并从彩色Fundus图像中取回正确的身份。 我们在《鹿特丹研究报告》中从21,851个病人-眼睛身份的227,004个图像上培训了512个维度的计量学习编码器,将一个ConvNEXtV2主干线与ArcFace和三重损失结合起来,涵盖多个成像装置,并长达32.6年的跟踪。 该系统根据搁置的鹿特丹研究数据以及联合王国生物库和与年龄有关的眼病研究外部数据进行了评价。 在评估之前,我们用模型来筛选身份不一致和人工标记的图像,在0.588%的鹿特丹研究图像、0.259%的英国生物库图像和0.164%的AREDS图像中识别出不正确的任务。 在去除相近重复的图像后,该系统在鹿特丹研究、英国生物银行和AREDS分别实现了0.9998、0.9997和0.9998的AUROCs。 就只使用以前获得的图像来获取身份而言,Recall@1分别是99.7%、97.2%和97.6%,分别来自画廊,平均4436-8510个身份;在至少98.6%的案例中,正确的身份出现在前五个结果中。 各种成像装置的性能仍然强劲并有很长的后续间隔,而图像质量较低和视网膜领域不一致是大多数故障的原因。 这些发现将视网膜解剖确定为一种持久的生物鉴别信号,有助于维护纵向成像记录的完整性。

articles.title: Real-Time Video Anomaly Detection Using YOLO Pose Estimation and CLIP-Based Semantic Scoring
articles.content: We propose a lightweight two-stage framework for real-time video anomaly detection. The first stage employs YOLO v11n-pose to detect persons and extract seventeen skeletal keypoints in a single forward pass. The second stage encodes each cropped person region through CLIP ViT-B/32 and computes cosine similarity against predefined textual descriptions of anomalous behaviors. This architecture eliminates the need for optical flow, standalone pose estimators, and density-based scoring modules. Experiments on CUHK Avenue, ShanghaiTech Campus, and a custom indoor dataset collected at Chulalongkorn University demonstrate an end-to-end throughput of approximately 51 FPS on an NVIDIA Titan XP GPU, a 3.36x speedup over the multi-feature baseline, while maintaining frame-level AUROC values of 89.26%, 70.26%, and 84.13%, respectively.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 使用 YOLO Pose 估计和 CLIP 语义分解进行实时视频异常检测
articles.content_zh: 我们提出一个轻量级的两级框架,用于实时视频异常检测. 第一阶段使用YOLO v11n-pose来检测人员,并提取出单向前传的17个骨骼键. 第二阶段通过CLIP VIT-B/32对每个被裁剪的人区域进行编码,并根据对异常行为的预定义文字描述来计算同位素相似性. 这种架构消除了光学流动的需要,独立地呈现出估计器,并基于密度的评分模块. 在上海Tech Campus CUHK大道的实验以及朱拉隆功大学所收集的定制室内数据集显示,NVIDIA Titan XP GPU的端到端吞吐量约为51个FPS,比多地基快3.36x,同时保持了帧级AUROC值分别为89.26%,70.26%和84.13%.

articles.title: LISynSeg: Data-Centric Label-to-Image Synthesis for Cross-Modality Whole-Heart Segmentation
articles.content: Whole-heart segmentation (WHS) in computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is affected by acquisition shifts and heterogeneous cardiac annotations. Existing WHS systems combine architectural design, transfer learning, and generic spatial or intensity augmentation. We investigate whether changes to data augmentation and training supervision can improve cross-modality WHS while the segmentation architecture is held constant. We present LISynSeg, a data-centric approach that augments real-image nnU-Net training with label-to-image synthesis. Synthetic volumes are generated from cardiac label maps using contrast and acquisition perturbations calibrated to the training cohort, then mixed with real images to retain thoracic context absent from the labels (and thus the synthesized images). We model cardiac label variation through controlled changes in myocardial wall thickness and partial supervision of uncertain vessel endpoints. On the CARE Whole-Heart benchmark, synthetic-only training performs worse than the real-image nnU-Net baseline, whereas calibrated real-synthetic training improves cross-modality segmentation without changing the architecture; the improvement is larger for MRI than for CT. The results show that modifying the training data strategy can benefit model development for heterogeneous cardiac data. Code and trained weights will be released at https://github.com/MedICL-VU/Care26_LISynSeg.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LISynSeg:跨模式数据-Centric Label-to-Image合成 全心分裂
articles.content_zh: 计算成像(CT)和磁共振成像(MRI)中的全心分化(WHS)受到获取变化和不同心谱的影响。 现有的WHS系统结合了建筑设计,转移学习,以及通用空间或强度增强. 我们调查数据扩增和培训监督的改变能否改善交叉模式的WHS,而分块结构保持不变。 我们提出LISynSeg,这是一种以数据为中心的方法,它用标签到图像的合成来增强真实图像nnU-Net的培训。 合成卷由心脏标签图产生,使用对比和获取扰动校正到训练组,再与真实图像相混合来保留标签中缺失的胸膜上下文(并因此被合成的图像). 我们通过心肌壁厚度的可控变化和对不确定的容器端点的部分监督来模拟心脏标签的变化。 在 " 援外社全心全意 " 基准上,只进行合成培训的情况比实际图像nnU-Net基线差,而校准的真合成培训则在不改变结构的情况下改进了跨模式分化;磁共振比CT的改进更大。 结果显示,修改培训数据战略可以有利于开发不同心脏数据的模型。 将在https://github.com/MedICL-VU/Care26_LISynSeg上发布代码和经过训练的重量。

articles.title: Multimodal Shared Latent Representation of Narration, Microscope and iOCT Images for Phase Recognition in Vitreoretinal Surgery
articles.content: Surgical phase recognition is key to context-aware computer-assisted feedback in vitreoretinal procedures, yet the scarcity of synchronized multimodal intraoperative data, particularly microscope views and intraoperative OCT, limits approaches that aim to replicate the multimodal integration surgeons perform naturally. Surgical narration, by contrast, is abundantly available online and offers rich semantic supervision. Prior work has mainly explored pairwise contrastive learning (e.g., intraoperative OCT-microscope or microscope-narration), leaving the joint modeling of all three modalities largely unexplored. We introduce a framework that uses microscope views as a shared anchor to bridge surgical narrations and intraoperative OCT (iOCT) without requiring a fully synchronized tri-modal dataset, leveraging real microscope-narration videos and a synthetic dataset of synchronized microscope video and tool-aligned iOCT pairs. Contrastive alignment transfers structural priors from the synthetic domain to real videos lacking iOCT, and a dual-head MS-TCN++ integrates the resulting embeddings for joint macro- and micro-phase prediction. Evaluated on real vitreoretinal surgeries, our framework improves macro-phase recognition over a zero-shot baseline (mean F1 0.38 to 0.53) and provides an exploratory route to estimating fine-grained instrument-tissue measurements that are not directly observable in real microscope video alone; these micro-phase estimates are validated quantitatively on synthetic data and shown only qualitatively on real surgery. To our knowledge, this is the first work to unify microscope view, iOCT B-scans, and surgical narrations in a shared latent space for surgical phase recognition.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 描述、显微镜和iOCT图像在紫外科中用于阶段识别的多模式共享底片
articles.content_zh: 手术阶段的识别对于在紫外线程序中了解情况、计算机辅助反馈至关重要,但缺乏同步的多模式操作内部数据,特别是显微镜视图和操作内部OCT,限制了旨在复制多模式整合外科医生自然进行的方法。 与此相对照,外科医生的叙述可以在网上大量提供,并提供丰富的语义监督。 先前的工作主要探索了对等对比性学习(如操作内OCT-显微镜或显微镜-解说),使得所有三种模式的联合模型基本没有被探索. 我们引入了一个框架,利用显微镜视图作为共享主锚,将外科手术描述和内科手术OCT(iOCT)相接而无需完全同步的三模式数据集,利用真实的显微镜描述视频以及同步显微镜视频和工具相接iOCT对的合成数据集. 相矛盾的对接将结构前缀从合成域转移到缺乏iOCT的真实视频上,一个双头MS-TCN++整合了所形成的嵌入,用于联合宏相和微相相预测. 经过对真实的紫外线外科手术的评估,我们的框架比零射入基线(平均值为F1 0.38至0.53)改进了宏观相位识别,并提供了一个探索性途径,用以估计仅在真显微镜视频中无法直接观测到的细纹仪器-问题测量;这些微相相相位估计在合成数据上得到定量验证,在真相外科中只显示质量. 据我们所知,这是第一个将显微镜视图,iOCT B-扫描仪,外科描述统一在一个共享的潜在空间,用于外科阶段识别的工作.

articles.title: Identity-Conditioned Latent Consistency Distillation for Face Synthesis
articles.content: Diffusion models have achieved strong results in high-fidelity image synthesis, but their iterative sampling process makes large-scale generation computationally expensive. This limitation is especially relevant when generating synthetic face datasets for face recognition, where a large number of subjects with many samples in different poses, expressions, ages, etc., are required. In this work, we show that identity-conditioned face synthesis can be performed at a substantially lower computational cost by a latent Consistency Model with few iterations, without compromising image quality. For training, we distill knowledge from the foundation Diffusion Model Arc2Face (teacher) by adapting its original text-to-image pipeline to an embedding-to-face setting, replacing textual prompts with ArcFace identity embeddings. Our distilled model (student) generates identity-conditioned face images with an average inference time of 0.4819 seconds per image, compared with 2.102 seconds for Arc2Face, resulting in a 4.36$\times$ speed-up. Quantitative results, based on FID scores, show that the distilled model remains competitive with Arc2Face across all evaluation protocols. On 100k generated images, it achieves near-parity on CelebA (13.921 vs. 12.928) and outperforms the teacher on WebFace42M (9.317 vs. 9.802). Further evaluations on Synth-500 and AgeDB show a moderate performance gap for the former but comparable results for the latter. These results indicate that Arc2Face can be accelerated through task-specific latent consistency distillation while preserving high image quality for large-scale synthetic face generation. Our proposal is publicly available at https://github.com/UFPR-IPASP-PR/FaceRec-IdentityConsistency.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 面相合成的特性- 附带条件的后端一致性
articles.content_zh: 分泌模型在高真实度图像合成方面已经取得了很强的成果,但其迭代采样过程使得大规模生成计算成本昂贵. 这种限制在生成用于面相识别的合成面相数据集时特别相关,因为需要大量具有不同姿势,表情,年龄等多个样本的主体. 在这部作品中,我们显示,通过一种潜在的一致性模型,可以以低得多的计算成本进行身份条件面部合成,这种模型的迭代很少,而不损害图像质量。 为了进行培训,我们通过调整其原始文本到图像的管道,采用嵌入式面对面的设置,用ArcFace身份嵌入式来取代文字提示,从基础Difunation Model Arc2Face(教师)中提取知识。 我们的蒸馏模型(stuent)生成身份条件化的面相图像,每个图像的平均推导时间为0.4819秒,而Arc2Face的推导时间为2.102秒,导致4.36美元\times$加速. 根据FID分数得出的定量结果表明,蒸馏模型在所有评价协议中仍然与Arc2Face具有竞争力. 在100k生成的图像上,它在CelebA(13.921对12.928)上实现了近平并超越了WebFace42M(9.317对9.802)上的老师. 对Synth-500和AgeDB的进一步评价表明,前者的业绩差距不大,而后者的绩效则相当。 这些结果表明,Arc2Face可以通过特定任务的潜在一致性分馏来加速,同时为大规模合成面相生成保留高成像质量. 我们的建议可在https://github.com/UFPR-IPAP-PR/FaceRec-Identity Consistency上公开查阅。

articles.title: Segmentation of Bovid Dentition Under Imperfect Annotations: A Comparative Study of Convolutional and Attention Models
articles.content:
Semantic segmentation decomposes an image into distinct mask regions corresponding to different object categories, such as people, cars, signs or buildings. Advances in machine learning (ML) have shifted this task away from traditional rule-based heuristics such as edge detection, towards deep neural networks (DNN) that learn to classify pixels directly. However, semantic segmentation DNNs crucially depend on expertly designed mask targets to learn from, and imperfect or misaligned masks can interfere with a model's ability to learn effectively.
  This paper presents a comparative study of segmentation architectures, ranging from convolutional backbones to vision transformers, applied to the B.O.V.I.D. dataset, a corpus of high-resolution bovid dental photographs paired with hand-made segmentation masks not originally designed for ML-based training. We evaluate a range of preprocessing and alignment techniques to mitigate the resulting label imperfections. We find that while these preprocessing choices have limited effect on quantitative metrics such as Dice score and mIoU, their qualitative impact on predicted masks is substantial.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Bovid 登革热的分解说明:革命模型和注意模型的比较研究
articles.content_zh:
语义分解将一幅图像分解成与不同对象类别相对应的截然不同的面具区域,如人,汽车,标志或建筑物等. 机器学习(ML)的进步将这项任务从传统的以规则为基础的heuristic,如边缘检测,转向了学习直接将像素分类的深神经网络(DNN). 然而,语义分解DNNs关键地依赖于专家设计的口罩目标来学习,而不完善或错配口罩会干扰模型有效学习的能力.
本文对分解结构进行了比较研究,从回旋骨干到视觉变压器,被应用到B.O.V. ID数据集,是一套高分辨波维德口腔相片,与原本并非为基于ML的训练而设计的手工分片口罩相配. 我们评价一系列预处理和调整技术,以缓解由此产生的标签缺陷。 我们发现,虽然这些预处理选择对诸如Dice分数和mIoU等定量计量的影响有限,但它们对预测口罩的质量影响很大.

articles.title: FaceSnap: Real-Time Personalized Lightstage Facial Performance Capture
articles.content: Lightstage facial capture produces production-quality digital humans, but it is resource and labor-intensive. Multi-camera setups, hours of computation, and massive data storage create bottlenecks that hinder iterative workflows. This paper introduces FaceSnap, an end-to-end framework that streamlines capture via a two-stage approach. First, a one-time multi-view optimization from a range-of-motion sequence builds a personalized model encoding both geometry and expression-dependent appearance. This model then enables high-fidelity real-time facial performance capture from a single monocular lightstage camera, with no further multi-view capture required. FaceSnap jointly estimates geometry and dynamic 4K texture at 83 fps. The 4K texture is produced by a novel personalized residual upscaler that recovers subject-specific high-frequency detail, which generic upscalers fail to capture. FaceSnap achieves geometric accuracy competitive with full per-frame multi-view optimization while outperforming feed-forward methods trained on production-quality 3D data, all from a single camera view. Finally, we introduce Multi4D, a public benchmark for evaluating 4D facial reconstruction methods in lightstage environments, enabling topology-invariant geometric comparison across methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: FaceSnap:实时个性化光相相相接
articles.content_zh: 轻相机面部捕捉可以产生出生产质量高的数字人类,但它是资源和劳动密集型的. 多相机设置,计算时数,以及大量数据存储,都造成了阻碍迭接工作流程的瓶颈. 本文引入了"FaceSnap"(FaceSnap),这是一个通过两阶段方法来简化捕捉的端到端框架. 一,从范围运动序列中一次性多景优化,构建个性化的模型编码,既能进行几何化,又能进行表达依赖外观. 这个模型然后能够从单相机的单相机上实现高真性能实时面部性能捕捉,不需要再进行多景捕捉. FaceSnap联合估计了几何和动态的4K纹理在83 fps. 4K纹理由一款新作"个性化"后遗症升级器所出,回收了主题特异性高频细节,而通用升级器未能捕捉到. FaceSnap 实现了几何精度竞争,完全采用每帧多视图优化,同时在生产质量3D数据方面训练了超过性能的向导方法,都是从单一相机角度进行的. 最后,我们引入了Multi4D,这是用于评价光相环境中的4D面部重建方法的公共基准,可以使地形学-不变量几何学在方法上进行比较.

articles.title: Driving on Memory
articles.content:
End-to-end autonomous driving models plan future trajectories from raw sensor input. While earlier driving benchmarks often measured deviation from the human trajectory, current benchmarks such as NAVSIM and Bench2Drive evaluate models with richer simulation-based metrics intended to capture safe and compliant driving. A high benchmark score should reflect that a model can understand the scene in front of it and act accordingly. But how much of that score specifically comes from reacting to the dynamic part of that scene?
  To probe this, we remove a model's camera input and replace it with memories from prior drives at the same location. The retrieved memories can provide persistent scene information, including road layout and location-conditioned regularities, but not the current traffic state. Surprisingly, memory is nearly sufficient on NAVSIM, reaching or even exceeding the performance of leading end-to-end methods without actually observing the evaluated scene. Our results suggest that a high NAVSIM score does not require a planner to react to the current traffic scene and should be treated with caution. This effect is benchmark-dependent: driving from memory causes substantially larger performance drops on Bench2Drive and RealEngine. We provide our code at https://github.com/boschresearch/MemoryDrivoR .
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 驾驶内存
articles.content_zh:
端到端自主驱动模型从原始传感器输入中规划出未来的轨迹. 早期的驱动基准往往测量出偏离人类轨道的情况,而目前的基准,如NAVSIM和Bench2Drive,则用更丰富的模拟测量标准来评价模型,目的是捕捉安全和符合要求的驾驶。 高基准分数应反映一个模型能够理解其前方的场景并相应采取行动. 但其中多少具体来自 对现场动态部分的反应?
为了探测这个,我们删除了模型的相机输入器,取而代之的是同一地点的先前驱动器的记忆. 取回的记忆可以提供持续的场景信息,包括道路布局和位置条件的规律,但不能提供目前的交通状态. 出人意料的是,NAVSIM上的内存几乎足够了,达到了甚至超过了领先端到端方法的性能,而没有实际观察被评价的场景. 我们的结果显示,NAVSIM的得分很高,不需要规划人员对目前的交通场景作出反应,应当谨慎对待. 这种效应依赖于基准:从内存驱动导致Bench2Drive和RealEngine的性能大幅下降. 我们在https://github.com/boschresearch/MemoryDrivoR提供我们的代码。 。 。 。 。

articles.title: Analytic Dynamics: Learning Physics-Grounded Representation for Fast Intrinsic Dynamics Inference from Monocular Videos
articles.content: Inferring object dynamics from visual observations is essential for intelligent agents to reason about and interact with the physical world, yet remains challenging due to the fundamental gap between visual evidence and intrinsic dynamics. Existing methods either rely on costly per-scene optimization, limiting efficiency and scalability, or directly map visual evidence to intrinsic dynamics without intermediate physical abstractions, making them prone to appearance and geometry shortcuts. To bridge this gap, we propose Analytic Dynamics, a feed-forward dynamics inference framework that introduces an intermediate physics-grounded dynamics representation between visual observations and intrinsic dynamics. Specifically, we leverage privileged physical states, including position, displacement, and deformation gradient fields, which are available in simulation, to learn a structured dynamics representation that is difficult to discover from visual observations alone. By aligning visual representations with this space, we equip visual models with a physics-grounded inductive bias, guiding them to capture dynamics-relevant patterns for material model classification and parameter regression. To facilitate this research, we develop a dynamics data generation pipeline and benchmark containing paired physical state trajectories, rendered videos, and ground-truth material models and parameters. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Analytic Dynamics achieves efficient, accurate, and generalizable dynamics inference from monocular videos.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 分析动力学:单相声视频的快速内摄动力学推论的学习物理全方位表现
articles.content_zh: 从视觉观测中推断出物体动力学对于智能物剂理性地了解物理世界并与物理世界互动至关重要,但由于视觉证据与内在动力学之间的根本差距,它仍然具有挑战性. 现有方法要么依靠成本高昂的人均场地优化,限制效率和可伸缩性,要么直接将视觉证据映射到内在动力学上而无中间物理抽象,使其容易被外观和几何快捷. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出了分析动力学,这是一个向导的动力学推论框架,它引入了视觉观测和内在动力学之间的中间物理基态动力表达. 具体地说,我们利用在模拟中可用的特殊物理状态,包括位置、迁移和变形梯度等,来学习一种仅从视觉观测中难以发现的结构化动态表现。 通过将视觉表现与这个空间相配合,我们为视觉模型配备了物理学基础的导出偏差,引导它们捕捉出与动态相关的模式,用于材料模型分类和参数回归. 为了促进这一研究,我们开发了一个动态数据生成管道和基准,其中包括对等的物理状态轨迹、制作的视频以及地面真实材料模型和参数。 广泛的实验表明,分析动力学能够从单视视频中实现高效,准确,通俗的动力学推论.

articles.title: SMG: Semantic Motion Graph for Monocular Dynamic Gaussian Splatting
articles.content: We study dynamic Gaussian Splatting from monocular videos. While recent advancements in dynamic Gaussian splatting offer a promising foundation for modeling dynamic scenes, they often overfit to the training views and fail under occlusion or complex scene motion due to the lack of reliable regularization signals in under-constrained regions. We propose Semantic Motion Graph (SMG), a novel approach models the Gaussian motion as the low-rank semantic motion. Our key insight is that the real-world scene motion is often structured by semantic coherence: regions that are spatially close and semantically related tend to exhibit consistent dynamics. To leverage this prior, we construct SMG to model structured motion of the scene. The Gaussian motion is driven by the motion of SMG nodes. We further observe that the uncertainty of Gaussian motion arises from both unreliable off-the-shelf priors and weakly constrained regions during optimization. SMG addresses this by using reliable graph nodes to guide the motion of nearby unreliable nodes. To evaluate dynamic Gaussian splatting under challenging real-world scenarios, we introduce a new multiview dataset collected under an ego-exo setup. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SMG achieves state-of-the-art performance on monocular dynamic Gaussian splatting across challenging real-world benchmarks. Project page: https://smg-gaussian.github.io/.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SMG: 单体动态高斯电镀的语义运动图
articles.content_zh: 我们从单人视频中学习动态高斯电镀。 虽然最近动态高斯平板化的进步为模拟动态场景提供了有希望的基础,但往往与训练观点过于吻合,在隔离或复杂的场景运动下由于在不紧缺的地区缺乏可靠的规范化信号而失败. 我们提出"语义运动图"(SMG),一种新颖的方法将高斯运动作为低等语义运动的模式. 我们的关键洞察力是现实世界的场景运动往往通过语义上的一致性来构建:在空间上相近而相近相通的区域往往呈现出一致的动态. 为了在之前发挥这种作用,我们构建了SMG来模拟现场的结构化运动. 高斯运动由SMG节点的运动所驱动. 我们进一步注意到,高斯运动的不确定性来自不可靠的现成前科和在优化期间受到薄弱制约的区域。 SMG通过使用可靠的图表节点来引导附近不可靠的节点的运动来解决这个问题. 为了在充满挑战的现实世界情景下评估高斯大陆的动态浮点数,我们引入了在自负式设置下收集的新多视图数据集。 广泛的实验表明,SMG在跨越挑战性现实世界基准的单体动态高斯滑板上实现了最先进的性能. 项目网页:https://smg-gaussian.github.io/.

articles.title: MNIST-PRO: MNIST is Back as a Partially Observable World for AI Agents
articles.content: AI agents in partially observable environments need to coordinate active sensing with working memory to maintain an evolving perceptual state. However, existing benchmarks struggle to isolate this perceptual-state construction and interpretation capability because they introduce physical and control complexities. We address this with MNIST-PRO, a benchmark that isolates agentic perception by converting MNIST digit recognition into a sequential, glimpse-based search task with lookback constraints. We evaluate ten multimodal models across four memory representations, including raw visual history, textual states, structured metric grid maps, and a consolidated visual canvas. While models excel under full observability, partial observability exposes a clear performance gap. We identify three distinct bottlenecks. First, perceptual-state construction and interpretation present a challenge, as agents struggle to integrate fragmented glimpses. Second, agents often stop exploring before they see the full sequence. Third, models often fail to revise early, incorrect beliefs even when faced with subsequent contradictory evidence. These results show that simply acquiring visual evidence is not enough. Agents must also be able to build and update a reliable perceptual state.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MNIST-PRO: MNIST回归为AI特工部分可观察世界.
articles.content_zh: 部分可观测环境中的AI剂需要将活感知与工作记忆相协调,以保持一个不断发展的知觉状态. 然而,现有的基准很难孤立这种概念状态的构建和解释能力,因为它们引入了物理和控制的复杂性。 我们用 MNIST-PRO 来解决这个问题,这个基准通过将 MNIST 数字识别转换成一个相继的,有回想限制的取景式搜索任务来隔离代理感知. 我们评价了包括原始视觉历史、文字状态、结构化的计量网格图和综合视觉画布在内的四个内存显示的十个多模式。 虽然模型在完全可观察性条件下表现优异,但部分可观察性暴露出明显的性能差距. 我们发现三个不同的瓶颈。 首先,概念状态的构建和解释是一个挑战,因为代理人们努力整合零散的一瞥。 第二,特工经常在看到完整序列之前就停止探索. 第三,即使面对后来的自相矛盾的证据,模型也往往未能修正早期,不正确的信念. 这些结果表明,仅仅获取视觉证据是不够的。 代理人还必须能够建立和更新可靠的感知状态。

articles.title: TSPFN: A Temporal Tabular Foundation Model for Physiological Time Series Classification
articles.content: Designing models that generalize effectively in low- to medium-data regimes remains a primary challenge in medical machine learning, particularly for physiological time-series classification. While tabular foundation models such as TabPFN offer an attractive alternative to conventional fine-tuning through in-context learning, they are not designed to capture the temporal dependencies inherent to physiological signals. ~In this paper, we introduce TSPFN, a foundation model that redesigns TabPFN's architecture for time series data. TSPFN integrates structured temporal representations and positional embeddings to capture intra-sample temporal and channel dependencies. To fully leverage its spatio-temporal design, the model is pretrained on 140,000 real-world physiological time series across multiple medical domains. This yields a unified, generalizable framework capable of learning the specificities of medical time series. Experiments across diverse physiological benchmarks demonstrate that TSPFN consistently outperforms standard tabular baselines and TabPFN, and achieves superior cross-domain generalization compared to specialized deep time-series models. All our experiments, ablation studies, and pre-processing scheme are publicly available at https://github.com/Jeremstym/TSPFN
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TSPFN: 生理时间序列分类的短期表基模型
articles.content_zh: 设计在中低数据制度中有效概括的模型仍然是医学机器学习的主要挑战,特别是在生理时间序列分类方面。 虽然表格式基础模型,如TabPFN,通过内文学习,提供了常规微调的有吸引力的替代方案,但是这些模型并不是用来捕捉生理信号所固有的时间依赖性. ~在本文中,我们引入了TSPFN,一个重新设计TabPFN架构用于时间序列数据的基础模型. TSPFN整合了结构化的时间表示和位置嵌入,以捕捉到取材时间和通道的依赖性. 为了充分利用其斯皮提奥-时空设计,该模型在14万个真实世界的生理时序上被预先训练,跨越多个医学领域. 这产生了一个统一而通俗的框架,能够学习医疗时间序列的特殊性。 跨不同生理基准的实验表明,TSPFN的业绩始终高于标准表基线和TabPFN,与专业的深度时间序列模型相比,实现了优异的跨领域概括. 我们的所有实验、消毒研究和预处理计划可在https://github.com/Jeremstym/TSPFN上公开查阅。

articles.title: From Intent to Evidence: Policy-Steered Multi-Strategy Retrieval for Long-Video Agents
articles.content: Existing long-video agents acquire evidence through one uniform behavior, ignoring whether the required evidence is concentrated, requires broad occurrence coverage, or must discriminate competing hypotheses---which can cause failure before substantive reasoning begins. Prescribing a fine-grained solution procedure for every question is not a satisfactory remedy, as it restricts autonomous exploration. We propose VESTA, a training-free long-video agent organized as a route-conditioned acquire--verify--consolidate loop. Before exploration, an intent router infers an evidence-acquisition policy---focused, recall, or contrastive retrieval over a shared visual--speech scene index---together with an evidence-accounting policy that configures the evidence view maintained during exploration. Policy-steered retrieval yields provisional references that multimodal evidence operations convert into observations, while the Reasoner remains free to verify them, re-query using intermediate findings, or inspect regions outside the retrieved set. A temporal evidence ledger consolidates observations into an adaptive, compressed view of temporal location, provenance, coverage, conflicts, verification outcomes, and hypothesis support, exposing missing and unresolved evidence to guide subsequent acquisition; finalization prioritizes verified observations. On Video-MME-v2, VESTA improves average accuracy by 2.7 points over VideoARM and gains across all six reported metrics. On LongVideoBench, EgoSchema, and LVBench under shared query-time models, it improves by 6.9 points on the LongVideoBench long subset and 1.5 on LVBench, and matches VideoARM on EgoSchema.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从意向到证据:针对长视频代理的政策性多战略检索
articles.content_zh: 现有的长视频代理通过一种统一的行为获得证据,忽略了所要求的证据是否集中,是否需要广泛的发生范围,或者必须区别对待相竞的假说——这在实质性推理开始前会造成失败. 为每个问题规定一个精细的解决程序并不是令人满意的补救办法,因为它限制了自主探索。 我们提出VESTA,一个无训练的长视频代理 组织一个有路由条件的获取 - 验证 - 整合循环。 在勘探之前,意向路由器会推断出一种注重证据获取政策、回顾或对比性检索方法,而不是一个共用的可视-语音场景指数,同时加上一种证据核算政策,以配置勘探期间保持的证据观点。 政策上的检索产生临时参考,即多式联运证据业务转换为观测,而Reasoner仍然可以自由核实、利用中间结果重新进行查询或检查取回的成套数据以外的区域。 时间证据分类账将观测整合成一个适应性压缩的视角,即时间位置、来源、范围、冲突、核查结果和假设支持,暴露出缺失和未解决的证据,以指导随后的获取;最终确定将核实的观测作为优先事项。 在Video-MME-v2上,VESTA比VideoARM提高了2.7分的平均准确度,在所有6个报告指标上都提高了收益. 在LongVideo Bench, EgoSchema,以及共享查询时间模型下的LV Bench上,它在LongVideo Bench长子集上提升了6.9分,在LV Bench上提升了1.5分,并和EgoSchema上的VideoARM相匹配.

articles.title: DARP: A Calibrated Dual-Arm RGB-D-IR Dataset for Multi-View Robotic Perception
articles.content: Robotic perception from a single viewpoint is often limited by self-occlusion and incomplete surface visibility. This paper presents DARP(Dual-Arm Robotic Perception) https://doi.org/10.21227/rmv3-be47, a calibrated dual-arm RGB-D-IR dataset for object-centered robotic perception using two independently moving eye-in-hand manipulators positioned on opposite sides of a shared tabletop workspace. Each arm carries an Intel RealSense sensor that continuously records RGB, depth, and stereo infrared data while synchronized robot joint states are logged for pose recovery. Objects are placed without fixed poses or marked locations, and the acquisition procedure performs automatic localization, cross-arm confirmation, adaptive viewpoint generation, and continuous multimodal recording. DARP contains ten unique tabletop objects and preserves the original sensor recordings, robot-state logs, object-level metadata, and calibration information required to reconstruct camera trajectories in a shared metric frame. To evaluate the geometric consistency of the acquisition, we implement a deterministic multi-view fusion pipeline that converts calibrated RGB-D observations into complementary partial point clouds and measured surface meshes without using learned or generative completion methods. Evaluation on 224 held-out RGB-D keyframes comprising 1,563,466 three-dimensional query points yields a median point-to-mesh distance of 2.13~mm and an RMSE of 4.04~mm, with 96.56\% of points within 10~mm of the measured-surface mesh. DARP is intended as a reusable resource for multi-view reconstruction, collaborative robotic perception, multimodal fusion, active perception, and future learning-based reasoning over partial object observations.

articles.title_zh: DARP:用于多维机器人感知的校正双臂 RGB-D-IR数据集
articles.content_zh: 从单一角度看,机器人感知往往受到自我隔离和不完全的表面能见度的限制。 本文介绍DARP(Dal-Arm Robotic Perception) https://doi.org/10.21227/rmv3-be47,一个用于以物体为中心的机器人感知的校准双臂RGB-D-IR数据集,使用位于共享桌面工作空间对面的两台独立移动的手动眼操纵器. 每个手臂都携带一个Intel RealSense传感器,在同步机器人联合状态下不断记录RGB,深度和立体红外数据,以进行姿势恢复. 物体在没有固定姿势或标记位置的情况下放置,购置程序进行自动本地化、跨臂确认、适应视角生成和连续多模式记录。 DARP包含10个独特的平面对象,并保存了原始的传感器录音,机器人状态日志,对象级元数据,以及重建相机在共享的度量框中轨迹所需的校正信息. 为了评价获取的几何一致性,我们实施定型多视聚变管,将校正的RGB-D观测结果转化为互补的部分点云并测量出地表网,而无需使用已学到的或基因完成方法. 对包含1,563,466个三维查询点的224个被搁置的RGB-D键框的评价得出了2.13~mm和4.04~mm的RMSE中位点相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距 DARP是作为多视图重建,合作机器人感知,多模式聚变,活性感知,以及未来基于学习的推理相对于部分对象观测的可再利用资源.

articles.title: Multi-View Reflective Surface Inspection via Semantic-Saliency Cross-Verification
articles.content: Reflective smartphone cover glass is challenging to inspect from a single fixed viewpoint because defect visibility varies with viewing geometry and specular reflections. This gives rise to two practical challenges: defects may be weakly observable from certain viewpoints, while the available visual evidence may remain spatially ambiguous. To address these issues, we propose a multi-view inspection framework in which each RGB observation is processed by a shared per-view expert. A vision-language model (VLM) produces class-aware semantic boxes, while a normal-reference reconstruction branch provides class-agnostic saliency. Their spatial agreement is used as supporting evidence to rank semantic proposals without modifying their coordinates or treating saliency as ground truth. The resulting evidence records are combined at product level without cross-view registration. On 282 production-line images, semantic-saliency association improves $AP_{50}$ from 52.6% to 62.6% by re-ranking fixed semantic proposals. Across 94 products, cross-view evidence recall $R_{\rm prod}@0.5$ increases from 75.5% for the best single view to 88.3% using all three views. These results support the complementary roles of semantic-saliency cross-verification and additional optical observations in reflective-surface inspection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过语义-显著性交叉核查进行多维反射表面检查
articles.content_zh: 反射智能手机封面玻璃很难从单一固定的角度检查,因为缺陷的能见度因取景几何和光谱反射而异. 这引起了两个实际挑战:从某些观点来看,缺陷可能难以被观察到,而现有的视觉证据可能在空间上仍然模糊不清。 为了解决这些问题,我们建议建立一个多视图检查框架,由共享的每个视图专家处理每个区域数据库的观察。 一个视觉语言模型(VLM)产生有阶级意识的语义箱,而一个正常参考重建分支则提供阶级不可知的显著性. 它们的空间协议被作为辅助证据,用于对语义性建议进行排序,而无需修改其坐标或将显要性作为地面真理对待. 由此产生的证据记录在产品一级合并,没有交叉查看登记。 在282个生产线图像上,语义学协会通过重新排序的固定语义提案,将$AP_{50}从52.6%提高到62.6%. 在94个产品中,交叉视图证据可以回顾,使用所有三种观点,从最佳单一视图的75.5%增加到88.3%。 这些结果支持了语义 -- -- 显著性交叉核查和额外的光学观测在反射地表检查中的互补作用。

articles.title: MR-JEPA: A General Purpose Video Foundation Model for Cardiac MRI
articles.content: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) produces rich sequential data such as temporal cine videos and spatial LGE/mapping stacks, yet most deep learning approaches process individual 2D slices, discarding this context. We present MR-JEPA, a self-supervised video foundation model for CMR that extends LeJEPA to 3D spatiotemporal inputs through tubelet tokenization, spatiotemporal masking augmentation, and initialization from a 2D CMR foundation model. Unlike prior CMR video models limited to cine data, MR-JEPA is pretrained on multi-sequence data (cine, LGE, mapping) from 10,505 patients across two centers without annotations. We evaluate the frozen encoder on six downstream tasks using a unified multi-view gated attention architecture: LV ejection fraction, RV ejection fraction, three myocardial strains (GLS, GCS, GRS), and four-class disease detection. MR-JEPA outperforms other compared methods on all five regression tasks, including both a domain-specific CMR model pretrained on more data with text supervision and a natural-video foundation model, achieving an LV EF MAE of 4.79% (r =0.764) and a GLS MAE of 1.87 (r=0.805), with 21-27% MAE reductions over baselines on strain tasks. For disease detection, MR-JEPA achieved a macro AUG of 0.868, remaining competitive with the domain-specific baseline despite using a fully self-supervised pretraining objective. These results demonstrate the potential of a unified video encoder for robust, multi-view utilization of diverse CMR sequences in clinical cardiac quantification and diagnosis.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MR-JEPA:心动核磁共振通用视频基金会模型
articles.content_zh: 心电磁共振成像(CMR)产生丰富的相继数据,如时间焚化视频和空间LGE/映射堆,然而大多数深层学习方法处理单个2D切片,丢弃了这个上下文. 我们提出MR-JEPA,这是CMR的一个自我监督的视频基础模型,通过管状符号化,spatiopal 遮盖增强,以及从2D的CMR基础模型初始化,将LeJEPA扩展到了3D的spatiental输入. 与以往仅限于焚化数据的CMR视频模型不同,MR-JEPA在多序列数据(焚化,LGE,映射)上接受了预先培训,来自两个中心的10,505名患者,没有说明. 我们利用统一的多视门关注架构,对6个下游任务的冷冻编码器进行评估:LV弹出分数,RV弹出分数,3个心肌菌株(GLS,GCS,GRS)和4级疾病检测. MR-JEPA在所有五个回归任务上都比其他比较方法表现得更好,包括一个针对特定域的CMR模型在更多有文字监督的数据上预先训练,以及一个自然-视频基础模型,实现LV EF MAE为4.79%(r=0.764)和GLS MAE为1.87 (r=0.805),在压力任务上比基线减少21-27%的MAE. 在疾病检测方面,MR-JEPA实现了0.868的宏观AUG,尽管使用了完全自我监督的预训目标,但仍与特定域的基线有竞争力. 这些结果表明,一个统一的视频编码器有可能在临床心脏量化和诊断中有力、多视图地利用多种遗留集束弹药序列。

articles.title: Vision Models Predict Urban Scene Appraisal with Limited Neural Alignment
articles.content: Pretrained vision embeddings are increasingly used as general-purpose representations for modelling how people appraise urban scenes, and are validated almost entirely by how well they predict human ratings. High predictive accuracy does not establish that these embeddings organise scenes as human perception does. We test the two properties separately against brain data. Using openly released EEG from 63 adults who viewed and rated 56 Berlin street scenes, we estimate the representational geometry of the scenes over time, the proportion of that geometry that is explainable at all, and its correspondence with seventeen feature spaces spanning language-supervised, self-supervised, category-supervised and dense-prediction training, two orders of magnitude of scale, and interpretable controls. Correspondence is low throughout: the best representation, DINOv2 ViT-B, reaches 29.6% of the lower bound of the noise ceiling, the panel spans 11.0% to 29.6%, and a Gabor energy descriptor is indistinguishable from the best model while outperforming every language-supervised model tested. Within a model, deeper layers still match later neural responses, so the hierarchical correspondence found for object recognition survives even at this low overall level. The same embeddings predict held-out appraisal ratings well, up to r = 0.87, and the two measures do not track each other across models; reweighting features towards the neural geometry lowers appraisal prediction for every model tested, against a control of matched dimensionality. Predicting how a street is appraised is therefore weak evidence that a model represents the street as the brain does. The benchmark uses only public data and requires no training, so evaluating a new representation needs only its embeddings for 55 images.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 具有有限神经调节功能的城市环境预测评估
articles.content_zh: 预先训练好的视觉嵌入器越来越多地被作为一般目的的表示,用于模拟人们如何评价城市场景,并且几乎完全通过他们对人类评级的预测得到验证。 高预测精度并不能确定这些嵌入物会像人类感知那样组织场景. 我们用大脑数据分别测试这两个特性。 我们利用63个成人公开发布的、观看和评分56个柏林街头场景的EEG, 估计了这些场景随时间推移而具有代表性的几何特征, 该几何比例是完全可以解释的, 以及它与17个功能空间的对应, 这些空间跨越了语言监督, 自我监督, 类别监督和密集的预测性训练, 两个规模级, 以及可解释的控制。 整个通信率都很低:最佳代表DINov2 VIT-B达到噪声天花板下限的29.6%,面板跨度为11.0%至29.6%,加博尔能描述符与最佳模型无法区分,同时比测试的每个语言监督模型都出色. 在一个模型中,更深层仍然与后期神经反应相匹配,因此为对象识别而发现的分级函证即使在这种较低的整体水平上也能活下来. 同样的嵌入法能很好地预测被搁置的评价评级,最高为r=0.87,而两个计量法并没有在模型之间相互跟踪;在对匹配维度的控制下,对每个被测试模型的神经几何学评价预测值降低。 因此,预测街道是如何被评估的,是表明模型与大脑一样代表街道的薄弱证据。 该基准只使用公共数据,不需要培训,因此,评价新代表只需嵌入55个图像即可。

articles.title: LOCI: A Locator-Critic with Refinement Loop
articles.content: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) still struggle on tasks requiring complex visual understanding. We argue that the core issue is not high-level reasoning, but instead failing to locate critical details in the image. Due to this shortcoming, VLMs generate often plausible but incorrect reasoning based on flawed perceptual grounding. To address this, we propose Locator-Critic (LOCI), a training-free framework that decouples visual search from evidence verification. LOCI employs a Locator agent to propose candidate visual evidence and a separate Critic agent to evaluate its relevance and sufficiency. These agents engage in an iterative refinement loop, progressively improving the evidence until it is adequate to answer the given question. This decoupled, self-correcting process yields substantial performance gains, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple complex visual benchmarks. LOCI improves accuracy for both open-weight models like Qwen3-VL (+12.1 on V*, +5.8 on HR-Bench and +11.2 on VisualProbe-Hard) and proprietary models like Gemini 2.5 Pro (+8.9 on V*, +4.3 on HR-Bench, +4.8 on VisualProbe-Hard).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LOCI: 定位器- 带有完善循环的批评
articles.content_zh: Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)仍然在需要复杂的视觉理解的任务上挣扎. 我们辩称,核心问题不是高级别推理,而是未能在图像中找到关键细节。 由于这一缺陷,自愿终止措施往往在有缺陷的观念基础上产生合理但不正确的推理。 为了解决这个问题,我们提议Locator-Critic(LOCI),这是一个将视觉搜索与证据核实脱钩的无培训框架. LOCI雇用一名定位员提出候选的视觉证据,另派一名批评员来评价其相关性和充分性. 这些代理人进行反复的完善循环,逐步改进证据,直到足以回答特定问题。 这种脱钩的自纠正过程产生了巨大的性能收益,在多种复杂视觉基准上取得了最先进的成果. LOCI提高了Qune3-VL(V*上+12.1,HR-Bench上+5.8和VisualProbe-Hard上+11.2)等开口量级模型和双子座2.5 Pro(V*上+8.9,HR-Bench上+4.3,VisualProbe-Hard上+4.8)等专有型号的精度.

articles.title: Audio-Driven Adversarial Defense for 3D Talking Face Generation with totally Visual Fidelity Preservation
articles.content: The rapid development of generative portrait models has raised growing concerns about privacy leakage and identity misuse. In particular, audio-driven 3D talking face generation can reconstruct a reusable 3D portrait of a target person from a monocular video and animate it with arbitrary speech, making realistic identity impersonation alarmingly practical. Existing proactive defenses mainly operate in the visual domain by injecting subtle perturbations into acial regions to disrupt identity acquisition. However, such perturbations often compromise visual quality due to the strong structural priors and social sensitivity of human faces, and are easily weakened by common real-world transformations such as resizing. To overcome these limitations, we propose an imperceptible audio defense for audio-driven 3D talking face generation by shifting protection from the visual modality to the audio modality. Specifically,we exploit psychoacoustic masking to hide protective perturbations within perceptually masked frequency regions of the speech signal, thereby reducing perceptual distortion while suppressing reliable facial animation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method effectively degrades 3D talking face generation while preserving favorable perceptual quality. These findings highlight psychoacoustically guided audio perturbations as a practical and promising direction for privacy-preserving portrait protection.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用于3D 面部对话的音频驱动反面防御, 完全可视的 Fieldity 保存
articles.content_zh: 基因肖像模型的迅速发展引起了人们对隐私被泄露和身份被滥用的日益关注. 特别是由音频驱动的3D语音面部生成可以从单相机视频中重建可重复使用的目标人物的3D相片并用任意的语音动画,使得现实身份冒用惊人的实用性. 现有的主动防御主要在视觉领域运作,将微妙的扰动注入到空地地区来干扰身份获取. 然而,这种扰动往往会因为人类面相的强烈结构前科和社会敏感性而损害视觉质量,并容易被重塑等常见的现实世界转变所削弱. 为了克服这些限制,我们提议通过将保护从视觉模式转向音频模式,为音频驱动的3D语音面相生成提供难以察觉的音频防御. 具体地说,我们利用心理声学口罩来将保护性扰动隐藏在语音信号的感知被遮蔽的频率区域,从而在压制可靠的面部动画的同时减少感知扭曲. 广泛的实验表明,拟议方法有效地降解了3D说话的面部生成,同时保持了有利的认知质量。 这些调查结果突出表明,心理引导的音频干扰是保护隐私的实用和有希望的方向。

articles.title: Uncertainty-Aware Trajectory Forecasting from Imperfect Tracking
articles.content: Most trajectory forecasting models are trained on clean annotated histories, and are often evaluated under the same idealized assumption, although practical deployments rely on trajectories produced by imperfect multi-object trackers. The real-world observations exhibit localization jitter, missed or unstable detections, and data-association ambiguity, which are usually either ignored or removed through denoising. This paper instead treats tracking-derived reliability cues as an informative signal to be propagated to the predictor. We propose a plug-in uncertainty-aware formulation in which each observed state is encoded as an uncertain state representation, modeled by a Gaussian distribution whose covariance combines detection-level localization uncertainty and association-level ambiguity through the law of total variance. Existing backbones are adapted with minimal architectural changes: input trajectories are represented as Gaussian observations, and predicted trajectories are produced as Gaussian forecasts rather than deterministic coordinates. To train predictors that remain robust under structured observation noise, we combine temporally correlated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck perturbations with response-based knowledge distillation from a teacher trained on clean trajectories. Experiments on Oxford Town Centre and VIRAT using real tracker outputs, together with a complementary ETH/UCY pseudo-detection protocol, show that the proposed formulation improves displacement accuracy and the reliability-sharpness trade-off of probabilistic forecasts.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 从不完全跟踪得到的未知- 知觉轨迹预测
articles.content_zh: 大多数轨迹预测模型都经过了清洁的注释历史的训练,并且常常在同样理想化的假设下得到评价,尽管实际部署依赖于不完善多对象跟踪器产生的轨迹. 现实世界的观测显示了局部化的焦虑,缺失或不稳定的检测,以及数据关联的模糊性,这些通常要么被忽略,要么通过去诺来去除. 本文将追踪产生的可靠性提示视为向预测者传播的信息信号。 我们提出一种插入不确定性意识的配体,其中每个观测到的状态被编码为不确定的状态代表,由高斯分布模型所建模,其共变通过完全差异定律将检测层次局部化的不确定性和关联层次的模糊性结合在一起. 现存的骨干被以最小的建筑变化来进行改造:输入轨迹被以高斯观测为代表,而预测轨迹被产生为高斯预测而不是确定坐标. 为了训练在有条理的观测噪声下仍然坚固的预测器,我们把时间相通的奥恩施泰因-乌伦贝克扰动与接受过清洁轨迹培训的教师基于反应的知识分解结合起来。 在牛津市中心和VIRAT进行实验,利用真实的跟踪器输出,加上补充的ETH/UCY伪检测协议,表明拟议的配方提高了迁移精度和概率预测的可靠性-精确性权衡。

articles.title: Rad-R: A Raw-ADC Radar Dataset and Capture-Invariant SSM for Hardware-Fault Diagnosis
articles.content: Automotive mmWave radar can develop vibration, antenna misalignment, radome blockage, and receive-channel degradation that corrupt the signal before perception begins. Data for these faults are scarce because each condition must be induced and measured on physical hardware. We introduce Rad-R, a raw-ADC dataset captured with a 4-chip 77GHz TI MMWCAS-RF-EVM cascade (192 virtual channels). Unlike existing raw-radar datasets, Rad-R pairs each recording with a controlled hardware fault at a calibrated severity, an independent physical severity measurement, and frame-synchronised IMU, temperature, GPS, and camera streams. Rad-R is a single-session dataset, so our generalisation claims are confined to a controlled cross-severity protocol in which train and test use physically distinct captures. A reproducible benchmark evaluates seven representative vision backbones and the proposed raw-IQ Mamba SSM (RadrNet) under within-clip, chirp-wise anytime, few-shot cross-capture, and controlled cross-severity protocols. Within-clip performance is near-saturated ($>0.98$ macro-F1), whereas cross-severity generalisation remains difficult: the absolute-phase RadrNet-DS falls to $0.49$ macro-F1. RadrNet-DS-CI replaces absolute phase with per-frame-standardised magnitude and relative chirp-to-chirp phase and ranks first on the controlled benchmark ($0.663$ vs. $0.628$ for the strongest RD-CNN; three seeds); the RadrNet family also leads on the anytime and few-shot budgets. A descriptive cross-modal analysis further finds that radar micro-Doppler covaries with independently measured IMU vibration energy (pooled Spearman $ρ=0.41$ across conditions). The complete dataset and code will be released publicly under permissive licences.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 拉德- R: 一个 Raw- ADC 用于硬件-故障诊断的雷达数据集和捕获-Invariant SSM
articles.content_zh: 汽车mmWave雷达可以发展出振动,天线错配,radome阻塞,以及接收-通道分解,在感知开始前腐蚀信号. 这些断层的数据很少,因为每个条件都必须被物理硬件所诱导和测量. 我们引入了Rad-R,一个原始的ADC数据集,用4芯片77GHz TI MMWCAS-RF-EVM级联(192个虚拟通道)捕获. 与现有的原始雷达数据集不同的是,Rad-R每段录制时会以受控的硬件断层进行校正,独立的物理重度测量,以及帧同步的IMU,温度,GPS,相机流. Rad-R是一个单会话数据集,所以我们的泛化主张仅限于一个控制的跨高度协议,其中列车和测试使用物理上截然不同的捕获. 一项可复制的基准评价了7个具有代表性的远景主干线和拟议的生-IQ-Mamba SSM(RadrNet)在内部-clip、hirp-whenever、几发相接和可控的跨高度协议下。 圆柱内性能接近饱和(大于0.98美元宏观-F1美元),而交叉性一般化仍然很困难:绝对相的RadrNet-DS降到了0.49美元宏观-F1。 RadrNet-DS-CI用每帧标准尺寸和相对的鸣叫相取代绝对相,并在控制基准上排名第一(最强的RD-CNN为0.663美元与0.628美元;种子为3个);RadrNet家族也在任何时间和少数情况下的预算上领先。 一项描述性的跨模式分析进一步发现,有独立测量的IMU振动能的雷达微多普勒相接器(集合了Spearman $ 0.41美元跨条件). 完整的数据集和代码将在许可下公开发布。

articles.title: A Controlled Evaluation of Model Rankings and Input Reliance in Surface Water Segmentation
articles.content: Performance evaluation for surface-water segmentation commonly uses an aggregate metric such as global intersection-over-union (IoU) to rank model configurations. However, a configuration ranking does not by itself establish why one system performs better, whether a close ordering is stable, or how strongly predictions rely on individual inputs. We examine these distinctions primarily on Sen1Floods11 through repeated configuration comparisons, paired test-chip analysis, fixed-checkpoint input stress tests, and geographic reweighting, with a targeted secondary evaluation of supervised input configurations on GEOID-Flood. The cross-modal student achieves the highest three-seed mean IoU on Sen1Floods11, but close orderings vary across seeds and geographic weighting, while ancillary-input rankings differ between Swin-UNet and U-Net. The GEOID-Flood evaluation shows substantial agreement in supervised ancillary-input effects, although the exact architecture ordering remains configuration dependent. Fixed-checkpoint tests further establish reliance on terrain and WorldCover without establishing a clean-input performance benefit, while target semantics and the later WorldCover prior restrict the evaluation to retrospective all-water segmentation. These results show that aggregate metrics remain useful for ranking complete configurations, but ranking stability, component attribution, input reliance, and deployment scope require distinct evidence. Performance evaluation should therefore match the evidence reported to the claim being made.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 对表层水分的分级模型和输入依赖性进行控制评价
articles.content_zh: 地表水分化的性能评价通常使用全球相交-相交(IoU)等综合度量表来排列模型配置. 然而,配置排名本身并不能确定一个系统为什么表现更好,一个近距离订购是否稳定,或者预测如何强烈依赖个人投入. 我们主要通过重复的配置比较、配对测试芯片分析、固定检查点输入压力测试和地理再加权,对GEOID-Floud上的监督输入配置进行有针对性的二级评价,来审查这些区别。 跨模式学生在Sen1Flouds11上实现了最高的"三种子"平均IoU,但收尾顺序因种子和地理权重而有差异,而辅助输入排名则因斯温-UNet和U-Net而有差异. GEOID-Floud评价显示,在监督的辅助投入效应方面基本一致,尽管确切的架构顺序仍然取决于配置。 固定检查点测试进一步确立了对地势和WorldCover的依赖,但没有确立清洁输入性能效益,而目标语义学和后来的世界Cover之前将评价限制在回溯全水分化. 这些结果表明,总的衡量尺度对于排列完整的配置仍然有用,但排列稳定性、组件归属、投入依赖和部署范围需要明确的证据。 因此,业绩评价应当与所报告的证据相匹配。

articles.title: SurgSkill-Bench: A Benchmark for Multimodal Surgical Skill Assessment
articles.content: Objective assessment of surgical technical skill is important for surgical training and structured feedback, but current workflows remain dependent on labor-intensive expert review. Existing automated approaches primarily focus on visual inputs and provide limited support for jointly studying operative performance, structured skill scores, and evaluator feedback. We introduce SurgSkill-Bench, an initial video-score-text benchmark-style dataset containing 214 surgical training simulation videos, six-dimensional OSATS scores, and expert free-text comments. We define two evaluation settings: video-only OSATS prediction for automated assessment and post hoc expert-comment-assisted prediction, where evaluator comments are available as auxiliary information. We provide controlled baseline experiments using representative frozen visual backbones, content-adaptive key-frame sampling, and a simple video-text co-attention fusion module. Under internal video-level validation, content-adaptive sampling improves video-only performance in this dataset, while evaluator comments provide additional score-related signal in the assisted setting. The best mean AUROC reaches 0.88 under dataset-specific median dichotomization. We further discuss evaluation constraints related to dataset scale, metadata completeness, and the interpretation of comment-assisted prediction. Code will be released publicly at a later date.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SurgSkill-Bench:多式联运外科技能评估基准
articles.content_zh: 对外科技术技能进行客观评估对于外科培训和结构化反馈十分重要,但目前的工作流程仍然取决于劳力密集型专家审查。 现有的自动化方法主要侧重于视觉投入,为联合研究业务业绩、结构化技能分数和评价者的反馈提供有限的支持。 我们介绍了SurgSkill-Bench,这是一个最初的视频-分数文本基准式数据集,包含214个外科训练模拟视频,六维OSATS分数,以及专家的自由文本评论. 我们界定了两个评价设置:用于自动评估的仅视频的OSATS预测和作为辅助信息提供评价评论的特设专家意见辅助预测。 我们利用具有代表性的冷冻视觉骨干、内容适应性关键框架取样和简单的视频文本共通性聚变模块进行控制基线实验。 在内部视频层面的验证下,内容适应性取样会改善本数据集中仅视频的性能,而评价者的评论则在辅助设置中提供额外的分数相关信号. 最佳平均值AUROC在数据集特有中位分化下达到0.88. 我们进一步讨论与数据集尺度、元数据完整性和解释评论辅助预测有关的评价制约因素。 守则将在稍后公布。

articles.title: VCAR: Training-Free 3DGS Segmentation via View Completeness and Axis-Aware Boundary Refinement
articles.content: Semantic segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is crucial for advancing 3D scene understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on feature distillation, which incurs substantial per-scene training overhead and often yields blurred segmentation boundaries. We identify that these boundary artifacts are driven in part by insufficient viewpoint coverage and boundary overflow of anisotropic Gaussian primitives. To address these challenges, we propose VCAR, a training-free coarse-to-fine segmentation strategy based on View Completeness and Axis-aware Boundary Refinement. In the coarse stage, a visibility-based weighted multi-view voting scheme rapidly localizes the target. In the fine stage, an object-centric sphere derived from the coarse result generates supplementary viewpoints via Spherical Spiral Sampling (SSS), allowing multi-view voting on the augmented views to precisely refine object boundaries and suppress irrelevant 3D Gaussians. Moreover, we introduce Axis-aware Boundary Refinement (ABR) to mitigate artifacts from anisotropic primitives. By decomposing the projected 2D covariance into per-axis contributions, ABR identifies the dominant axis responsible for boundary leakage and applies targeted anisotropic compression exclusively along that axis. Extensive experiments on NVOS and LERF demonstrate that VCAR achieves state-of-the-art segmentation accuracy and efficiency without training. Our code is available at https://github.com/DDKK0526/VCAR.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VCAR: 通过视图完整性和轴心-智能边界优化进行无培训 3DGS分区
articles.content_zh: 3D高斯平板电脑(3DGS)中的语义分解对于推进3D场景理解至关重要. 现有方法主要依靠地物蒸馏,这需要大量的每层培训费,而且往往产生模糊的分界线。 我们发现,这些边界文物部分是由于视线不足和异同性高斯人原始人的边界溢出造成的。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提议采用VCAR,这是一种基于 View Complete和轴感边界优化的无训练粗细分化战略。 在粗糙的阶段,基于能见度的加权多视图投票计划能使目标迅速本地化. 在精细的阶段,由粗细的结果所衍生出的一个以物体为中心的球体通过球状螺旋抽样(SSS)产生补充观点,允许多视图对被扩展的观点进行投票,以精确地细化对象边界并压制无关的3D高斯人. 此外,我们引入了轴感边界优化(ABR)来减轻异同位素原始人出产的文物. 通过将预测的二维共振分解为一轴贡献,ABR确定了造成边界渗出的主要轴并完全沿着该轴进行定向同位素压缩。 关于NVOS和LERF的广泛实验表明,VCAR在没有培训的情况下实现了最先进的分化精度和效率. 我们的代码见https://github.com/DDKK0526/VCAR。

articles.title: GAFT: Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning for Hazard Identification from Rare Failures
articles.content: Off-road navigation can fail when physical structures induce irrecoverable states such as high-centering or entrapment, requiring human interventions. Identifying these structures is crucial, yet challenging. Such failure events are rare and costly to collect, resulting in limited training data. Moreover, the collected data associate frames with outcomes, but do not indicate the visual cues responsible for the failure. Learning directly from these data can therefore exploit scenario-specific visual cues, leading to poor generalization. We propose \textbf{Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning (GAFT)}, a parameter-efficient method that adapts a vision foundation model with a geometry-derived prior. It guides LoRA adaptation by aligning a spatial attention-rollout map with the geometry prior, while preserving pretrained representations. On an intervention-verified forest hazard benchmark, across ten independently trained adaptations, GAFT consistently outperforms frozen DINOv2 and supervised PEFT baselines, improving the repeated leave-one-scenario-out mean $F_2$ from 0.0607 to 0.3757 with statistical significance under paired analysis. Within these independently trained models, the best-performing GAFT model achieves a repeated-LOSO $F_2$ of 0.570. Code and benchmark: https://github.com/Xu-Yanran/geo_anchored_fine_tuning
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GAFT:地质勘探 对罕见故障的危险识别进行罚款
articles.content_zh: 当物理结构诱发无法恢复的状态,如高浓度或诱饵,需要人类干预时,越野通航可能失败. 确定这些结构至关重要,但具有挑战性。 这种失败事件很少发生,收集费用也很高,导致培训数据有限。 此外,所收集的数据框架与结果相关联,但并不表明失败的可视提示。 因此,直接从这些数据中学习可以利用特定情景的视觉提示,导致一般化程度差。 我们提议\textbf{Geo-Anchored Fine-Tuning(GAFT)},一种参数效率高的方法,它用先出自几何学的视觉基础模型来适应. 它通过使空间注意力滚出图与前几何图相协调来指导LORA的适应,同时保留了预先训练过的表示. 关于经干预核实的森林危险基准,在经过独立培训的十项适应措施中,全球森林观测系统的绩效始终高于冻结的DINOv2和受监督的PEFT基线,使重复的一例停产意味着从0.0607美元增加到0.3757美元,在配对分析下具有统计意义。 在这些经过独立培训的模型中,业绩最佳的GAFT模型实现了重复LOSO $F_2美元0.570. 代码和基准:https://github.com/徐延兰/geo_anchored_fine_trouc.

articles.title: TAMI: Temporally Aligned, Missingness-Aware, and Interpretable Multimodal Fusion for Mental Health Assessment in Older Adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment
articles.content: Depression and anxiety in older adults with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI) are frequently underdiagnosed due to limited access to care. Multimodal analysis of remote clinical interviews is a scalable screening approach, but existing methods have three limitations. First, they do not correct temporal misalignment across multimodal features extracted at different resolutions, inducing spurious cross-modal associations. Second, remote recordings exhibit uneven modality dropout, but missing values are often zero-filled, making them indistinguishable from valid near-zero measurements. Finally, they do not jointly attribute predictions to modalities, questions, and interview moments, limiting fine-grained clinical interpretation. We propose a Temporally-Aligned, Missingness-Aware, Interpretable (TAMI) multimodal fusion framework. TAMI aligns speech, language, facial, and physiological features within question-answer segments on a shared timeline, encodes modality-level missingness over time, and conditions fusion on question context. In interviews with 49 older adults with MCI, TAMI achieved area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) scores of 0.68 (depression) and 0.69 (anxiety). Fine-grained temporal alignment of multimodal features produced the largest performance gain ($Δ{\geq}0.1$). Multi-level interpretability analysis revealed that depression classification relied on eyegaze and open-ended questions, while anxiety classification depended on eyegaze and head pose, with attribution uniformly distributed across questions. Using only responses to the open-ended questions (5.1min), the depression model achieved an AUROC score of 0.67, which was not significantly different from using the full interview (19min) ($p>0.05$). Our findings support designing interview protocols centered on open-ended questions for depression screening in older adults with MCI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TAMI: 暂时适应、失踪-了解和可解释的多模式组合,用于对患有弱视的老年人进行心理健康评估
articles.content_zh: 患有弱视症(MCI)的老年人的抑郁症和焦虑症往往因获得护理的机会有限而得不到诊断。 远程临床访谈的多式分析是一种可扩展的筛选方法,但现有方法有三个局限性. 首先,它们无法纠正不同决议所提取的多式联运特征之间的时间错位,从而诱发虚假的跨模式协会。 第二,远程录音显示模式的退出不均衡,但缺失的值往往被零填充,使其与有效的近零度测量无法区分. 最后,它们并没有将预测归结为模式、问题和访谈时刻,限制了精细的临床解释。 我们提出一个临时的、相通的、缺失的、可解释的(TAMI)多式联运框架。 TAMI将语音,语言,面部,和生理特征在共享时间段的问答部分中相协调,编码模式层次随时间推移的缺失,以及问题上下文的条件融合. 在接受49名患有MCI的老年人的采访时,TAMI在接收器操作特征曲线(AUROC)下取得了0.68分(压抑)和0.69分(焦虑)的分数. 对多式联运特征进行精细的时间调整,产生了最大的性能收益($Δ{\geq}0.1美元)。 多层次可解释性分析显示,抑郁症分类依赖于眼罩和开放式问题,而焦虑症分类则依赖于眼罩和头部姿势,归属在问题之间统一分布. 低气压模式仅使用对无限制问题的答复(5.1min),实现了AUROC的分数为0.67分,与使用全采访(19min)(p>0.05美元)没有显著区别. 我们的调查结论支持设计访谈程序,其中心是开放式问题,用于对患有MCI的老年人进行抑郁症检查。

articles.title: Pretrained, Curriculum-Tuned, and Ensembled: A Tracer-Aware Interactive Segmentation Pipeline for AutoPET V
articles.content: Interactive lesion segmentation in whole-body PET/CT requires a model to provide a strong initial prediction while also responding efficiently to sparse corrective scribbles during inference. This setting is particularly challenging because tracer distributions, physiological uptake patterns, lesion appearance, and acquisition characteristics differ substantially between FDG and PSMA studies. We present TRIAGE, Tracer-aware Refinement via Interactive Anatomy-Guided sEgmentation. The core backbone is a 3D STU-Net initialized through masked autoencoding pre-training with an asynchronous masking strategy, aiming to learn transferable anatomical and cross-modal representations before task-specific fine-tuning. In parallel, we train an auxiliary organ segmentation model whose predictions provide explicit anatomical context and help distinguish physiological uptake from malignant lesions. A dedicated tracer classifier first routes each study to an FDG- or PSMA-specific branch. Within each branch, a first-stage segmentation model consumes CT, PET, and organ context to generate an initial lesion mask. The initial prediction is then combined with cumulative foreground/background scribbles and refined by a second interactive segmentation network. The FDG and PSMA branches share the same overall processing pipeline but are trained independently to account for tracer-specific appearance and error modes. We additionally employ curriculum-style training and model ensembling to improve robustness across interaction steps and heterogeneous cohorts. Experiments are conducted using the official AutoPET V data and ten-fold split; quantitative results, ablations, and final test-set performance are left as placeholders to be completed after the challenge evaluation. Code: https://github.com/Liiiii2101/AUTOPET2026-MEDAI.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 预训、课程设置和组合: 自动PET 的追踪器- 智能交互分块管道 五、结 论
articles.content_zh: 在全身PET/CT中相互作用的损伤分解需要一种模型,以提供强有力的初步预测,同时在推论中有效地应对少量的矫正分解. 这种设置尤其具有挑战性,因为FDG和PSMA研究之间的痕量分布、生理吸收模式、损伤外观和获取特征差别很大。 我们通过互动解剖学指导的分离法 呈现TRIAGE, Tracer-aware 改进。 核心骨干是一款由3D STU-Net通过蒙面自编码预训初始化而成,并采用同步蒙面策略,目的是在任务特定微调前学习可转移解剖和跨模式表达. 同时,我们培训一种辅助器官分解模型,其预测提供了明显的解剖背景,有助于区分生理吸收和恶性损伤。 专用的追踪器将每次研究的第一条路线分类到一个FDG或PSMA特定分支. 在每个分支内部,一个第一阶段分化模型会消耗CT,PET,和器官上下文来产生初始损伤口罩. 最初的预测再与累积的前地/后地分解结合,再由第二个交互分解网络来完善. FDG和PSMA分支共享相同的整体处理管道,但经过独立培训,以核算跟踪器特有的外观和出错模式. 此外,我们还采用课程式的培训和模式式的组合,以提高互动步骤和不同群体之间的稳健性。 实验使用官方AutoPET V数据和10倍分数进行;量化结果,分数,以及最后的测试设置性能作为占位符留待质疑评价后完成. 代码:https://github.com/Liiiii2101/AUTOPET2026-MEDAI.

articles.title: Physical Adversarial Examples for Person Detectors in Thermal Images Based on 3D Modeling
articles.content: Thermal Infrared detection is widely used in autonomous driving, medical AI, etc., but its security has only attracted attention recently. We propose infrared adversarial clothing designed to evade thermal person detectors in real-world scenarios. The design of the adversarial clothing is based on 3D modeling, which makes it easier to simulate multiangle scenes near the real world compared to 2D modeling. We optimized the black patch layout pattern of 3D clothing based on the adversarial example technique and made physical adversarial clothing using the aerogel. The idea is to paste a set of square aerogel patches, which display black squares in thermal images, in the inner side of clothing at specific locations with specific orientations. To enhance realism, we propose a method to build infrared 3D models with real infrared photos and develop texture maps for 3D models to simulate varied infrared characteristics over time and location. In physical attacks, we achieved an attack success rate of 80.11\% indoors and 76.85\% outdoors against YOLOv9. In contrast, randomly placed patches yielded much lower success rates (26.53\% indoors and 23.03\% outdoors). The adversarial clothing also showed good transferability to unknown detectors with an ensemble attack method, demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于 三维建模的热成像中人物探测器物理反常实例
articles.content_zh: 热红外探测被广泛用于自主驾驶,医疗AI等,但其安全性最近才被人们所关注. 我们提出红外对抗性服装, 设计在现实世界中避开热能探测器。 对抗性服饰的设计以3D模型为主,与2D模型相比,更便于模拟现实世界附近的多角场景. 我们优化了基于对抗性实例技术的3D服装的黑色补丁布局模式,并用气凝胶制成物理对抗性服装. 其理念是贴上一组正方形的气凝胶补丁,在有特定取向的特定地点,用热成像显示黑色正方形,在衣物内侧. 为加强现实性,我们提出一种方法,用真实的红外相片来构建红外3D模型并开发出3D模型的纹理图来模拟不同时间和地点的红外特征. 在人身攻击中,我们取得了80.11分室内和76.85分室外对YOLOv9的攻击成功率. 相比之下,随机放置的补丁成功率低得多(室内26.53分和室外23.03分)。 对抗性服装也表现出了良好的可转移性,可以使用全能攻击方法的未知探测器,证明了我们的方法的有效性.

articles.title: Reliable Benchmarking of Artifact Detection in Computational Pathology: A Reproducibility and Uncertainty Analysis
articles.content: Background and Objective: Quality control is a prerequisite for whole-slide image analysis, yet the benchmarks on which quality-control methods are compared share four properties that make their reported differences hard to interpret: few independent slides, annotation concentrated in a minority of them, pooled ratio metrics with no closed-form standard error, and a single inherited train/test partition. We propose a reliability protocol for such benchmarks. Methods: The protocol quantifies four sources of variability - test-set sampling, training stochasticity, partition composition, and undocumented preprocessing - a claim is reportable only if it survives all four; three of the four cost minutes of compute. We apply it to an independent reconstruction of a published diffusion-based artifact detector, evaluated on the original 24-slide partition and against a supervised baseline. Results: The method's central mechanism reproduces: the auxiliary contrastive term improves pooled F1 from 0.673 to 0.688 and replicates under a second seed (+0.0156, p = 0.031; +0.0190, p = 0.005), although it acts on pen marking rather than the artifact types cited to motivate it. Its comparative claims do not: differences between design variants, and against the supervised baseline, fall inside the uncertainty of the evaluation. Four of 24 slides carry 70% of scored annotated pixels, giving an effective sample size of 6.2, and the inherited partition sits at the 7th percentile. An unreported tissue-restriction step excludes 41.4% of out-of-focus annotation against 2.6% of air bubble; such a gate is confounded with blur by construction. Conclusions: Small-cohort benchmarks support far weaker conclusions than current reporting implies. The four checks are cheap enough to accompany any evaluation on such a resource and separate reproducible effects from differences the evaluation cannot resolve.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 计算中人工活性探测的可靠基准 病理学:可复制性和不确定性分析
articles.content_zh: 背景和目标:质量控制是全滑图像分析的前提,然而,比较质量控制方法的基准共有四个属性,使得它们所报告的差异难以解释:独立幻灯片很少,注释集中在其中的一小部分,集合比率计量,没有封闭格式的标准错误,以及一个单一的被继承的列车/测试分区. 我们提出了这种基准的可靠性议定书。 方法: 协议对四种可变性来源进行量化 -- -- 测试集取样、培训花样结构、分区组成和无记录的预处理 -- -- 索赔只有在四分之一的情况下才能报告;在计算的四个成本分钟中,有三分之一可以报告。 我们把它用于独立地重建一个公布的以扩散为基础的文物探测器,该探测器在最初的24个滑坡分区上并根据一个受监督的基线进行评估。 结果: 该方法的中心机理再现:辅助对比词将集合F1从0.673改进为0.688并复制到第二种子下(+0.0156,p=0.031;+0.0190,p=0.005),虽然它的作用是用笔标识而非所引用的文物类型来激励. 其比较索赔不属于评估的不确定性范围:设计变体之间的差异,以及相对于监督基准的差异。 24个幻灯片中有4个搭载了70%的有分数的注解像素,给出了6.2的有效样本尺寸,所继承的分区坐落于7分之. 未经报告的组织限制步骤不包括41.4%的焦点外注和2.6%的气泡;这种门因构造而模糊不清。 结论:小口径基准比当前报告所暗示的要弱得多。 4项检查费用低廉,足以配合对此类资源的任何评价,并且从评价无法解决的差异中分离出可复制的效果。

articles.title: Whole-Body MRI Classification via Prompt-Based Clinical Conditioning
articles.content: Combining whole-body magnetic resonance imaging (WB-MRI) with clinical variables has the potential to improve systemic disease diagnosis by leveraging complementary sources of patient information. However, structured clinical variables are often incomplete or missing, limiting the applicability of conventional multimodal fusion methods that assume fixed inputs. In this work, we propose TACTIC (Tabular-Attribute Conditioned Transformer for Image Classification), a prompt-based multimodal framework that integrates WB-MRI and structured clinical data through conditional visual feature learning. By encoding clinical attributes as prompts, TACTIC supports an arbitrary number of tabular inputs and naturally handles missing data without requiring imputation or fixed input structures. We evaluate TACTIC on five WB-MRI classification tasks spanning systemic and oncologic applications, including diabetes, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), breast cancer, prostate cancer, and metastasis diagnosis. Across all tasks, TACTIC consistently improves performance over image-only baselines when clinical information is available while maintaining strong predictive capability under incomplete tabular inputs. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of prompt-based models as a flexible approach for improving WB-MRI analysis using clinical context. The model weights and code are available at https://github.com/lauradaza/TACTIC
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 整个Body磁共振 通过快速临床条件分类
articles.content_zh: 将全身磁共振成像(WB-MRI)与临床变量相结合,有可能通过利用病人信息的补充来源来改进系统疾病诊断. 然而,结构化的临床变量往往不完整或缺失,限制了假定固定投入的常规多式聚变方法的适用性. 在这项工作中,我们提出TACTIC(图象分类的图象属性条件变换器),这是一个快速的多模式框架,通过有条件的视觉特征学习,将WB-MRI和结构化的临床数据相融合. TACTIC通过将临床属性编码为快取,支持任意数量的表格输入,并自然地处理缺失的数据而不需要估算或固定输入结构. 我们评价TACTIC的五项WB-MRI分类任务,涉及系统和肿瘤学应用,包括糖尿病、慢性阻塞性肺病、乳腺癌、前列腺癌和元病诊断。 在所有任务中,TACTIC在获得临床信息时,始终在图像基线上提高性能,同时在不完整的表格输入下保持强大的预测能力。 我们的结果显示,快速模型作为利用临床环境改进WB-MRI分析的灵活方法,是有效的。 模型重量和代码见https://github.com/lauradaza/TACTIC。

articles.title: Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling
articles.content: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated individually. Existing pipelines decompose the task into three steps---parse the observations into instances, generate an asset for each, and place each asset back---but every step presumes an input that a cluttered capture rarely provides: accurate instance geometry, unoccluded views, and assets that accurately match the observations. We propose Lucida, which keeps this order but redistributes the requirements, so each step consumes only what a real capture reliably provides and precision is reached at the end of the pipeline rather than demanded at its start. Lucida parses the video into a scene graph whose nodes carry per-instance multi-view evidence, generates a complete asset for each instance from its evidence, and places assets with GizmoAct, a VLM policy that casts placement as multi-turn GUI interaction, manipulating the object's gizmo in a closed loop and deciding itself when alignment is reached. Across scene-level 3D object detection, object pose estimation, and scene reconstruction, Lucida improves mAP over Boxer by 69% on R2S-Scene, raises ADD-SB@0.05 from 57.8% to 83.4% on CA-1M, and increases scene F-Score from 0.794 for SAM3D to 0.924.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Lucida: 解析、生成和可编译真实到图像场景建模位置
articles.content_zh: 可编译的场景建模旨在将一个真实的室内场景作为完整,可编辑的被观测到的物体资产来取回,给予机器人模拟,并体现AI一个模拟准备的可复制品,其物体可被单独操纵的真实环境. 现有的管道将任务分解为三个步骤 -- -- 将观测结果分为实例,为每个步骤生成一个资产,并将每个资产放回 -- 但每个步骤都假定一个拼凑的捕获很少提供的投入:准确的实例几何、未遮蔽的视图以及准确匹配观测结果的资产。 我们建议Lucida,它维持这个秩序,但重新分配要求,因此每个步骤只消耗真正能够可靠地获取的东西,在管道末端达到精确,而不是在管道开始时要求达到精确. Lucida将视频解析成一个场景图,其节点携带了每集多视图证据,从其证据中为每个实例生成一个完整的资产,并将资产与GizmoAct(GizmoAct)一起放置,这是一种VLM政策,它将放置为多回合GUI交互,在闭环中操纵对象的gizmo并实现对齐时自行决定. 在整个场景级别3D物体检测,物体平面估计,以及场景重建中,卢西达在R2S-Scene上将MAP比Boxer改进了69%,将ACA-1M上的ADD-SB@0.05从57.8%提高到83.4%,将场景F-Score从SAM3D的0.794提高到了0.924.

articles.title: RealOOB: A Definition-Consistent Real-World Oriented Occlusion Boundary Benchmark
