articles.content: Occlusion boundaries (OBs) are pixel-level image boundaries corresponding to surface visibility discontinuities caused by occlusion. Through precise boundary localisation and occlusion orientation, OBs encode local surface layout and depth ordering, providing geometry-driven mid-level cues for scene understanding. However, progress in pixel-level OB estimation has been limited by fragmented supervision: Existing benchmarks often suffer from limited coverage, category-specific designs, missing self-occlusion annotations, or inconsistent annotation definitions. Meanwhile, modern edge detectors and monocular depth estimators have become strong boundary and geometry predictors, yet their relationship to definition-consistent OBs remains underexplored. We introduce RealOOB, a carefully annotated real-world benchmark with 4.26M definition-consistent, geometry-grounded OB labels covering both inter-object and self-occlusion boundaries, together with validity-aware occlusion-orientation maps that restrict supervision to pixels whose cross-boundary depth ordering is reliably measurable. Based on RealOOB, we evaluate forty OB estimators and edge detectors alongside six monocular depth estimators. Our evaluation reveals a clear gap in occlusion reasoning: modern edge detectors perform competitively with OB methods in localisation, whereas orientation prediction remains challenging for all evaluated methods. Meanwhile, even strong depth estimators often fail to exhibit measurable geometry at true OBs. We believe RealOOB provides a strong reference benchmark for the OB estimation community and a real-world testbed for assessing depth discontinuities and geometry fidelity in broader low-level vision tasks. Dataset and code will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RealOB: 定义一致 以实际世界为方向的占领边界基准
articles.content_zh: 闭塞分界(OBs)是像素级图像分界,与闭塞引起的表面能见度不连续相适应. 通过精确的边界定位和隔离取向,OBs将局部地表布局和深度顺序编码,提供几何驱动的中层提示来进行场景理解. 然而,像素级OB估计的进展受到分散监督的限制: 现有基准往往因覆盖面有限、具体类别设计、缺少自我包容说明或注释定义不一致而受到影响。 同时,现代边缘探测器和单相向深度估计器也成为了强大的边界和几何预测器,然而它们与定义相容的OB的关系仍然没有得到充分的探索. 我们采用了RealOB,这是经过精心注释的现实世界基准,有4.26M定义一致、有几何基础的OB标签,既包括对象间界限,也包括自我隔离界限,还有有效性认识的隔离导向地图,这些地图将监督限制在像素上,其跨边界深度顺序可以可靠地测量。 基于RealOOB,我们评价了40个OB测距器和边缘探测器,同时评估了6个单向深度测距器。 我们的评价揭示了隔离推理方面的明显差距:现代边缘探测器在本地化中以OB方法进行竞争,而定向预测对所有被评价的方法来说仍然具有挑战性。 同时,即使是强烈的深度估计器也往往无法在真实的OB上显示可衡量的几何. 我们认为,RealOOB为OB估算界提供了一个强有力的参考基准,并为评估在更广泛的低水平愿景任务中的深度不连续性和几何忠诚度提供了一个现实世界测试床。 将发布数据集和代码。

articles.title: A Composition-Aware Pretraining Framework for Geospatial Foundation Models
articles.content: Geospatial foundation models have emerged as state-of-the-art methods for downstream Earth observation tasks. However, existing pretraining methodologies process imagery through a single-concept lens, failing to capture the highly compositional nature of complex satellite scenes. We propose a composition-aware pretraining framework that explicitly encodes fractional land-cover mixtures. Each satellite image cell is mapped to a histogram representing its fractional land-cover distribution, which we term the "composition target". These targets serve as the primary prediction objective and are distilled into the backbone using Earth Mover's Distance. Experimental evaluation shows that composition-aware pretraining yields substantial gains on region-level understanding tasks requiring semantic similarity judgment, including zero-shot image retrieval and scene classification, while remaining competitive on tasks requiring fine-grained spatial precision, such as segmentation and object detection. With a 36.8M-parameter backbone, our framework outperforms SatMAE and Prithvi-EO-2.0, which contain 303M and 600M parameters, respectively, in most retrieval and scene classification settings. On the fine-grained ForestNet-12 dataset, a rigorous testbed for compositional discrimination, our method boosts baseline mAP@10 from 0.279 to 0.434, a 55.6% relative improvement, providing direct evidence for the effectiveness of explicit composition modeling. The code implementation can be found at https://github.com/05kashyap/GFM_Composition_Pretraining
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 地理空间基础模型的构成 -- -- 了解预训框架
articles.content_zh: 地理空间基础模型已成为下游地球观测任务的最新方法。 然而,现有的预训方法通过单一概念透镜处理图像,未能捕捉复杂卫星场景的高度组成性质. 我们提出了一个具有成分意识的预训练框架,明确编码分量土地覆盖混合物。 每个卫星图像细胞被映射到一个直方图上,代表其分数土地覆盖分布,我们称之为"组合目标". 这些目标是首要的预测目标,并被用"地动"(Earth Morror's District)分馏入骨干. 实验评价显示,认识到成分的预训在需要语义相似性判断的区域一级理解任务,包括零镜头图像取回和场景分类,同时在需要精细的空间精度,如分化和物体检测等任务上仍然具有竞争力。 有了36.8M参数主干线,我们的框架业绩超过了SatMAE和Prithvi-EO-2.0,在大多数检索和场景分类设置中,它们分别包含303M和600M参数. 在精细的ForestNet-12数据集上,一个严格的成分歧视测试床,我们的方法将mAP@10的基准从0.279提升到0.434,相对改进了55.6%,为明确成分模型的有效性提供了直接的证据。 守则的执行可在https://github.com/05kashyap/GFM_Composition_Pretraining上查阅。

articles.title: Camera trap classification with deep learning under ground truth uncertainty
articles.content: Supervised deep learning methods enable the rapid processing of ecological image data, but depend on a costly annotation process. Consequently, training labels are commonly derived from volunteer citizen science projects. However, disagreement among volunteers introduces uncertainty in the "ground truth" data that are assumed to be correct for model training and validation. Using two datasets containing camera trap images with associated volunteer and expert classifications, we investigated the effects of training under higher ground truth uncertainty. We observed improved overall test accuracy, particularly for images that were more difficult for volunteers. Species-level accuracy also generally improved, but generalisation to a different dataset did not. The benefits of ground truth uncertainty were enhanced by pre-training on ImageNet. Pre-training also reduced the number of training epochs required; further reductions in computational cost, but not gains in accuracy, resulted from additional pre-training on other camera trap images. With unbalanced training data, we still observed a clear benefit of increased ground truth uncertainty for overall accuracy, especially on difficult images. Class imbalance improved accuracy for common species, reduced rare species accuracy, and changed patterns of misclassification to more closely resemble mistakes made by volunteers. Our findings have implications for applying deep learning across ecological image types with multiple labels. Practitioners can improve accuracy, especially on difficult examples, by including moderate levels of label disagreement during training and using models pre-trained on general image data. In addition to improving the use of citizen science-derived labels in model training, our study suggests avenues for more effectively integrating human and deep learning classifications in combined workflows. (abridged)
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 摄像机陷阱分类,在地面真相不确定的情况下进行深层学习
articles.content_zh: 监督的深层学习方法能够快速地处理生态图像数据,但取决于代价高昂的注释过程. 因此,培训标签通常取自志愿公民科学项目。 然而,志愿者之间的分歧在"地上真相"数据中引入了不确定性,这些数据被假定为正确用于模型培训和验证. 我们利用两个包含相机陷阱图像的数据集,将相关志愿者和专家分类,调查了在较高地真相不确定性下培训的效果. 我们看到总的测试准确度有所提高,特别是对于志愿人员比较困难的图像。 物种水平的准确性也普遍得到提高,但是对不同数据集的概括没有提高。 通过对ImageNet进行预先培训,增加了地面真相不确定性的好处。 培训前培训还减少了所需的培训时间;由于对其他相机陷阱图像进行了额外培训,计算费用进一步降低,但准确性没有提高。 由于培训数据不平衡,我们仍然看到,地面真相的不确定性明显增加,特别是在困难的图像方面。 阶级不平衡提高了常见物种的准确性,降低了稀有物种的准确性,并改变了错误分类的模式,更接近志愿者所犯的错误. 我们的研究结果对将深刻的学习应用到多种标签的生态图像类型有影响。 从业人员可以提高准确性,特别是在困难的例子方面,方法是在培训期间纳入适中程度的标签分歧,并使用对一般图像数据进行预先培训的模型。 除了在示范培训中改进使用公民科学的标签之外,我们的研究还提出了将人和深层学习分类更有效地纳入综合工作流程的途径。 (缩写)

articles.title: PixelIR: Fidelity-Perception Decoupling via Pixel-Space Image-Residual Flow Matching for Efficient One-Step Real-World Super-Resolution
articles.content: Real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) aims to preserve structures supported by the degraded observation while reconstructing perceptually realistic details. However, existing Real-ISR methods largely optimize fidelity and perceptual quality within a shared network, causing the two objectives to interfere throughout training and making their balance difficult to control. Recent one-step methods reduce sampling steps, yet often inherit both this coupled optimization behavior and the expensive high-resolution backbone of their multi-step predecessors. We argue that efficient Real-ISR requires not only a shorter sampling trajectory, but also specialized modeling of faithful reconstruction and perceptual detail synthesis. Based on this insight, we propose PixelIR, a fidelity-perception decoupling framework built upon pixel-space image-residual flow matching. PixelIR first learns an image flow that maps the degraded observation to a faithful reconstruction. Then, a residual flow synthesizes the missing perceptual details from noise without repeatedly relearning or overwriting the complete restoration solution. We further distill the teacher into a deployment-oriented one-step student within a coarse-to-fine pyramid architecture. Extensive experiments show that PixelIR achieves leading PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS on both RealSR and DRealSR. The final model completes pixel-space restoration in a single evaluation with only 32.9M parameters, 89.7G MACs, and 8.5ms latency, demonstrating a strong practical fidelity-perception-efficiency balance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 像素IR:Fidelity-Perception 通过像素-空间图像-响应流相匹配以高效的一阶真人-世界超级解析
articles.content_zh: 真实世界的图像超分辨率(Real-ISR)旨在保存被退化观测所支持的结构,同时重建概念上现实的细节. 然而,现有的Real-ISR方法在共享网络中基本优化了忠诚度和知觉质量,使两个目标在整个培训过程中受到干扰并难以控制其平衡. 最近的一步法减少了采样步骤,但往往既继承了这种组合优化行为,又继承了多步前作昂贵的高分辨率骨干. 我们认为,有效的Real-ISR不仅需要缩短采样轨迹,还需要对忠实的重建和感知细节综合进行专门的模型制作。 基于这种洞察力,我们提出PixelIR,一个建立在像素-空间图像-剩余流相匹配基础上的忠心-感知脱钩框架. 像素 IR首先学习了将已退化的观测图映射到忠实重建的图像流. 然后,一个剩余流会从噪音中合成缺失的知觉细节而无需再反复学习或覆盖完整的还原解决方案. 我们把老师进一步提炼成 一个面向部署的一步学生 在粗糙的金字塔建筑中。 广泛的实验显示,PixelIR在RealSR和DRealSR上都实现了领先的PSNR,SSIM和LPIPS. 最终的模型在一次评价中完成像素-空间恢复,只有32.9M参数,89.7GMAC,和8.5ms的耐久性,显示出了强大的实际忠诚-感知-效率平衡.

articles.title: CORAL: A Benchmark for Structure-aware and Brain-wide Neuron Reconstruction in Light Microscopy
articles.content: Automatic neuron reconstruction from light microscopy images is a central problem in computational neuroanatomy. While recent methods have achieved encouraging results on local image blocks, it remains unclear whether such progress translates to reconstruction that is both structurally accurate and scalable to the whole-brain scale. We present CORAL, the first benchmark for structure-aware evaluation of automatic neuron reconstruction from light microscopy images at both local and whole-brain scales. Built on a high-quality whole-brain fMOST dataset with carefully curated annotations, CORAL establishes two progressive tasks: block-level reconstruction, which evaluates reconstruction methods under limited spatial context, and brain-wide reconstruction, which assesses complete neuron reconstruction at the whole-brain scale. To account for topological correctness beyond geometric distance similarity, we introduce a structure-aware metric based on fiber prediction. To further achieve complete neuron reconstruction across the entire brain, we develop a brain-wide neuron tracing framework that extends arbitrary local reconstruction methods to the whole-brain scale through an iterative local-to-global process. Using this benchmark, we provide the first structure-aware comparison of mainstream methods for local neuron reconstruction and further evaluate their performance in brain-wide reconstruction. Our results underscore the importance of structure-aware evaluation and the need for more robust methods for complete neuron reconstruction.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CORAL:轻度显微镜结构意识和全脑神经重建基准
articles.content_zh: 从光显微镜图像中自动进行神经元重建是计算神经外科的一个中心问题. 虽然最近的方法在当地图像块上取得了令人鼓舞的成果,但目前仍不清楚这种进展是否转化为结构上准确和可扩展至整个大脑规模的重建。 我们提出CORAL,这是从光显微镜图像和全脑图像对自动神经元重建进行结构意识评价的第一个基准。 CORAL建立在高质量的全脑FMOST数据集上,并配有精心编排的注释,它确立了两项进步的任务:一是块级重建,在有限的空间范围内评价重建方法;二是全脑重建,在全脑范围内评价完整的神经元重建. 为了说明地理上的正确性 超越了几何距离的相似性 我们采用了基于纤维预测的结构感知度量 为了在整个大脑中进一步实现完整的神经元重建,我们开发了一个全脑神经元追踪框架,通过本地到全球的迭接过程,将任意的局部重建方法扩展到整个大脑的规模. 利用这一基准,我们提供了地方神经元重建主流方法的第一次结构认识比较,并进一步评价其在全脑重建中的表现. 我们的成果突出表明,必须进行结构意识评价并需要采用更强有力的方法来进行完整的神经元重建。

articles.title: ChessQueries: Toward Better Chess Board Recognition
articles.content: Chess board recognition is the task of mapping the image of a chess board to the information of which piece is on which square. So far this task has two established benchmarks: ChessCog is synthetic, and ChessReD comes from smartphone pictures of a single chess board setup. We introduce ChessQueries, a new method combining a ViT encoder with a DETR-style decoder, which outperforms existing methods. On the ChessReD benchmark, we improve the state of the art from 15.3% to 99.2%, and demonstrate strong capabilities on out-of-distribution datasets. Our method saturates the task on the two datasets, with an average 0.01 wrong squares per board (vs. SotA: 3.4 / 0.15 respectively). We also share a new, harder public dataset, parsed from broadcasted top-level chess tournaments. Code, model weights and the SLCC data will be released.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 国际象棋查询:争取更好的国际象棋棋盘识别
articles.content_zh: 棋盘识别是将棋盘的图像映射到哪个棋盘的信息上的任务. 迄今为止,这项任务有两个既定基准: ChessCog是人工合成的,而ChessReD则出自一款棋盘设置的智能手机相片. 我们引入了"国际象棋查询"(ChessQueries),这是一种结合了ViT编码器和DETR式解码器的新方法,它超越了现有的方法. 在"国际象棋ReD"基准上,我们提升了从15.3%到99.2%的先进水平,并展示了出发数据集的强大能力. 我们的方法饱和了两个数据集上的任务,每个板平均有0.01个错误的平方(v.SotA:3.4/0.15). 我们还分享了一个新的,更难的公共数据集,从播出的顶级围棋比赛中解析出来. 代码,模型重和SLCC数据将发布.

articles.title: CheXGround: Anatomical Region Tokens for Grounded Longitudinal Chest X-ray Interpretation
articles.content: Recent radiology multi-modal language models have made substantial progress in chest X-ray report generation, visual question answering, and temporal reasoning. While longitudinal chest X-ray interpretation compares sequential examinations to describe change, visual grounding aims to connect clinical language with localized image evidence. Although longitudinal modeling and visual grounding have each advanced radiology language models, how localized visual evidence can support longitudinal interpretation remains under-explored. We introduce CheXGround, a region-grounded longitudinal chest X-ray language model that represents paired studies through corresponding anatomical regions. CheXGround extracts anatomical regions from current and prior radiographs, encodes them as temporally enhanced Region-of-Interest (ROI) tokens, and combines them with global temporal image context during generation. To connect these region tokens with clinical text, we propose Temporal Region--Phrase Alignment, a pretraining objective that aligns temporal anatomical representations with localized report phrases. We evaluate CheXGround on single-study and longitudinal Visual Question Answering (VQA), longitudinal findings generation, temporal grounded VQA, and anatomical grounding. Across these tasks, CheXGround improves clinical language quality, temporal reasoning, and localization accuracy over recent baselines. Our results suggest that organizing longitudinal evidence at the anatomical level is a strong representation for grounded radiology language modeling. Project page: https://adonaydem.github.io/chexground-website
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CheXGround: 解剖区,用于地基纵向胸X射线
articles.content_zh: 最近的放射学多模式语言模型在胸X射线报告生成,视觉问题回答和时间推理等方面取得了实质性进展. 虽然纵向胸X射线判读比较相继检查来描述变化,但视觉地平面旨在将临床语言与局部图像证据相接. 虽然纵向建模和视觉地基都有每一个先进的放射语言模型,但局部的视觉证据如何支持纵向解释仍然没有得到充分探讨. 我们引入了CheXGround,一种以区域为基础的纵向胸X射线语言模型,它通过相应的解剖区域代表了对等研究. ChEXGround从当前和以前的射电图中取出解剖区域,将其编码为时间上增强的"兴趣区域"(ROI)符号,并在生成时将其与全球时间图像上下文结合. 为了使这些区域标志与临床文本相连接,我们提出Tempolar Region-Phrase Region-Presentation,这是一个预先训练的目标,将时间解剖表述与局部报告短语相协调。 我们评价CheXGround的单项研究和纵向视觉问题回答(VQA),纵向发现生成,时间上基于的VQA,以及解剖地基. 在这些任务中,CheXGround比最近的基线提高了临床语言质量、时间推理和本地化精度。 我们的结果表明,在解剖层面组织纵向证据是基础放射学语言建模的有力体现。 项目网页:https://adonaydem.github.io/chexground-website

articles.title: Autoregressive Mosaics: Probing 2D Spatial Reasoning in Text-Only Language Models
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) trained only on text and code can sometimes generate programs that draw recognizable images. However, it is unclear whether this reflects an internal representation of 2D spatial layout or simply the ability to translate spatial descriptions into code. We introduce Autoregressive Mosaics (AM-Bench), a benchmark that separates these factors: First, a translation task gives a model a fully specified geometry of a picture in words as a prompt and asks for the code that produces it. Second, a layout task requires the model to compose an image from an underspecified prompt. Across eight open-weight text-and-code-only models, all models reliably translate specified geometry into code, but their open-ended layout performance differs substantially, indicating that these differences are not explained by code-generation ability alone. An output-medium ablation further shows that the interface or medium of expression that the model uses matters: replacing procedural code with raw SVG improves layout scores across all models. Finally, probing model activations shows that a coarse layout plan is present before generation, but reflects only the layout implied by the prompt. During generation, models track the evolving geometric state instead of executing an initially fixed plan. Overall, these results show that 2D spatial performance in text-only LLMs depends on both the model and the output medium, and is not explained by code-generation ability alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 自动回转 Mosaics:在文本-仅语言模型中测试 2D 空间原因
articles.content_zh: 仅接受过文字和代码培训的大型语言模型(LLM)有时可以生成可以绘制可识别图像的程序. 然而,目前还不清楚这是否反映了2D空间布局的内部表现,或者仅仅是将空间描述转化为代码的能力. 我们引入了自递性 Mosaics(AM-Bench),这个基准将这些因素分开: 首先,一个翻译任务给一个模型一个完全指定的字形相片几何来作为快取并请求生成它的代码. 第二,一个布局任务需要模型从一个不精确的提示来作成一个图像. 在整个8个开口量的文本和只用代码的模型中,所有模型都可靠地将指定的几何学转换为代码,但其开口量的布局性能差别很大,表明这些差异并非仅由代码生成能力来解释. 一个输出-中度的通缩进一步表明,模型使用的界面或表达介质很重要:用原始的SVG来取代程序代码可以改善所有模型的布局分数. 最后,探测模型活化显示在生成前存在粗糙的布局计划,但只反映由快取所隐含的布局. 在生成过程中,模型跟踪不断发展的几何状态,而不是执行最初固定的计划. 总体而言,这些结果显示,仅文本LLMs中的2D空间性能既取决于模型,也取决于输出介质,而并非仅由代码生成能力来解释.

articles.title: RailGen: Improving Railway Intrusion Detection via Agent-Guided Small-Scale Foreign Object Generation
articles.content: Small-object detection under long-tailed data distributions is a fundamental yet challenging problem in multimedia. Railway Foreign Object Detection (RFOD) epitomizes this challenge with easily confused small intrusions and scarce samples. To address these issues, we propose a generative-augmented detection paradigm that leverages multimodal image generation to enrich the feature space of rare and small objects. We first construct RailGen, a multimodal image generation agent based on large models. Under semantic constraints, RailGen automatically invokes tools to generate railway scenes, calibrate intrusion positions, extract foreign objects, and fuse them into realistic intrusion effects. This process produces high-quality synthetic samples that effectively densify the feature representations of tail classes and complete the small-object feature space. Within this paradigm, we further propose FocalDEIM, a detection framework designed to enhance training with generated data. FocalDEIM improves dense matching with Focal Modulation for better small-object discrimination and adopts Focal Loss to emphasize hard samples, thereby alleviating blurred inter-class boundaries in complex railway scenes. Experimental results demonstrate that RailGen can generate high-quality small-scale foreign objects, reducing the object pixel area by up to 58x and 13.85x on average. Equipped with these challenging samples, our paradigm surpasses the baseline DEIM by 5.6% and 7.5% in mAP@50 and mAP@(50-95), respectively, and outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies verify RailGen's feature-space enrichment and FocalDEIM's boundary discrimination. The paradigm provides an effective multimodal generative solution for long-tailed small-object detection in safety-critical applications.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RailGen:通过代理指导的小型外国物体生成改进铁路入侵探测
articles.content_zh: 在长尾数据分布下进行小对象检测是多媒体中一个根本性但具有挑战性的问题. 铁路外国物体探测(RFOD)以容易混淆的小入侵和稀少的样品来说明这一挑战。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出了一种基因强化的探测范式,利用多式联运图像生成来丰富稀有和小物体的特征空间。 我们首先构建了RailGen,一种基于大型模型的多式联运图像生成代理. 在语义限制下,RailGen会自动引用工具来生成铁路场景,校准入侵位置,提取外来物体,并使它们与现实的入侵效应相融合. 这个过程产生高质量的合成样品,有效地去除尾类的特征表示,完成小对象特征空间. 在这一范式内,我们进一步提出ConferenceDEIM,这是一个检测框架,旨在用生成的数据加强培训。 ConferenceDEIM改进了与Conference Moduction的密集匹配,以更好的小对象歧视,并采用Confer Loss来强调硬样品,从而减轻了复杂铁路场景中的阶级间界限模糊. 实验结果表明,RailGen可以产生高质量的小型异形物体,使物体像素面积平均减少58x和13.85x. 与这些具有挑战性的样本相比,我们的范式在mAP@50和mAP@(50-95)中分别超过了基线DEIM的5.6%和7.5%,并且超过了现有的最新方法。 校对研究验证了RailGen的特征-空间浓缩和ConferenceDEIM的边界区别. 该范式为长尾小物体在安全关键应用中的探测提供了有效的多模式基因化解决方案.

articles.title: SocialReasonBench: A Video-QA Benchmark for Social Reasoning with Counterfactual Narrative Videos
articles.content: Recent advances in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have greatly improved video understanding, yet their ability to reason about human-centered social situations remains limited. Existing benchmarks typically rely on videos with a single observed trajectory, making it difficult to determine whether models truly understand social dynamics or merely exploit recurring narrative patterns. We introduce SocialReasonBench, a video multiple-choice QA benchmark for evaluating socially grounded reasoning in scenarios derived from interactive narratives. Built from gameplay videos of Detroit: Become Human, the benchmark leverages branching storylines where player decisions lead to alternative social outcomes that can be checked against the game's own script, flowchart, and recorded branches. We develop a multi-agent curation pipeline that localizes socially meaningful clips, grounds answer labels in game-state signals, and generates theory-guided questions with diagnostic distractors. SocialReasonBench covers seven reasoning dimensions, including intent recognition, emotional empathy, moral dilemma, counterfactual reasoning, and causal antecedent. Experiments on contemporary LMMs show that models perform reasonably well on basic social understanding but struggle with counterfactual and causal reasoning. Further ablation and diagnostic error analyses reveal that models often depend on incomplete modality cues and fall into reasoning traps such as visual shortcuts, highlighting a gap between observable event recognition and deeper reasoning over latent social states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 社会思想 座席:用反事实描述视频进行社会理性分析的视频-QA基准
articles.content_zh: 大型多式联运模式(LMMs)最近的进展大大提高了对视频的了解,然而,它们对以人为中心的社会状况进行解释的能力仍然有限。 现有基准通常依靠具有单一观测轨迹的视频,因此很难确定模型是真正理解社会动态还是仅仅利用反复出现的叙述模式. 我们引入了SocialReason Bench,这是一个多选择的视频QA基准,用于评价从互动叙事衍生出来的情景中基于社会理由的推理. 由底特律:成为人类(Betroit: Become Human)的游戏游戏视频所建,基准杠杆是分支故事线,玩家的决定导致替代社会结果,可以对照游戏自己的脚本,流程图,以及录制的分支来检查. 我们开发了一个多剂解析管道,将具有社会意义的剪辑本地化,游戏状态信号中的地面解答标签,并生成带有诊断分心器的理论指导问题. SocialReason Bench涵盖了七个推理层面,包括意向识别,情感共鸣,道德困境,反事实推理,以及因果前因. 对当代LMMs的实验表明,模型在基本的社会理解上表现得相当好,但与反事实和因果推理斗争. 进一步的衰减和诊断错误分析显示,模型往往依赖于不完全的模式提示,并落入视觉捷径等推理陷阱,凸显了可观测事件识别与潜伏社会状态的更深层次推理之间的差距.

articles.title: SegWave: Wavelet-Driven Segmentation of Tampered Regions
articles.content: Verifying image authenticity is increasingly difficult, posing serious risks across journalism, law enforcement, and political domains. Most existing forensic methods rely on high-level visual artifacts and treat frame detection as a simple binary task. To address this, we propose SegWave, a hybrid framework that jointly leverages spatial and frequency-domain cues for image tampering detection. SegWave integrates a transformer-based architecture with the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) to capture localized, multi-scale frequency inconsistencies indicative of manipulation. To further improve localization effectiveness, we introduce an Adaptive Sub-band Attention module (ASA) that dynamically highlights the informative high-frequency wavelet components. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that SegWave consistently outperforms state-of-the-art tampering detection methods in challenging evaluation settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SegWave: 坦佩雷地区分治
articles.content_zh: 核实图像真实性越来越困难,对新闻、执法和政治领域构成严重风险。 大多数现有的法证方法依赖于高水平的视觉文物,并将帧检测视为简单的二进制任务. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议使用SegWave这个混合框架,联合利用空间和频率域提示进行图像篡改检测。 SegWave将基于变压器的架构与Discrete Wavelet Transform(DWT)整合,以捕捉显示操纵的局部,多尺度频率不一致. 为了进一步提高本地化的效能,我们采用了一个适应性子波段注意模块,动态地强调信息丰富的高频波段组件。 对多个基准数据集的广泛实验表明,SegWave在具有挑战性的评价环境中,其业绩始终超过最新技术的篡改检测方法。

articles.title: RailSyn: Diagnosis-Guided Image Generation for Traceable Data Completion in Railway Foreign Object Detection
articles.content: Railway foreign object detection (RFOD) is critical to safe railway operation, yet scarce real positive samples incompletely represent task-relevant variations in object scale, intrusion relation, railway scene, illumination, and adverse weather. Existing synthetic augmentation can improve RFOD detection, but its gains lack an explicit account of the task-relevant deficiencies complemented by the generated data. We therefore introduce RailSyn, a diagnosis-guided framework comprising a real-referenced Inspector and a requirement-aligned Generator. The Inspector constructs a variable-radius empirical cover from finite real observations to localize candidate completion regions and profile synthetic pools. The resulting audit identifies railway-context, intrusion-semantic, and visual-consistency requirements; the Generator addresses them through domain adaptation, agent-planned placement and physical contact relations, and plan-consistent conditional refinement. Using the Inspector, we further trace representation-space changes across generation variants; the complete system attains a local-shell occupation of $C_{gap}$ to 13.64%, which measures generated coverage of real-derived completion regions. Extensive experiments show AP50--95 gains of up to 4.9 points and consistent improvements across nine mainstream detectors, demonstrating broad cross-architecture utility.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RailSyn:在铁路外物体检测中为可追踪数据完成而诊断-引导图像生成
articles.content_zh: 铁路外国物体探测对铁路安全运行至关重要,但极少的真阳性样品不完全代表物体规模、入侵关系、铁路场景、照明和不利天气方面与任务相关的变化。 现有的合成增强作用可以改进对RFOD的检测,但其成果缺乏对与任务有关的缺陷的明确说明,并辅之以生成的数据。 因此,我们采用了RailSyn,这是一个诊断指导框架,包括一名真正参考的检查员和一个符合要求的发电机。 检查专员从有限的实际观察中构建了一个可变射线经验覆盖,使候选完成区域和剖面合成库本地化。 由此产生的审计确定了铁路内容、侵入语义和视觉一致性要求;发电机通过域域调整、代理人计划放置和物理接触关系以及符合计划的条件改进来解决这些要求。 利用检查专员,我们进一步追踪各代变体之间的代表空间变化;整个系统达到13.64%的当地壳位($C_{gap}美元),衡量尺度使实际产生的完成区域得到覆盖。 广泛的实验显示AP50-95的得分高达4.9分,9个主流探测器的不断改进,显示出广泛的跨结构用途.

articles.title: VisLens: Single-Pass Interpretable Visual Search for Multimodal LLMs
articles.content: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with fine-grained Visual Search, the task of locating small or rare objects in high-resolution images. Existing remedies fall into two families: (1) Training-free methods based on attention or confidence scores are accurate but slow, since they require multiple MLLM queries per example. (2) Reinforcement Learning (RL) trained tool-use models are faster at inference but opaque, since their tool calls remain uncontrollable and hard to interpret. To overcome this, we propose \emph{VisLens} (Visual Focus via Logit Lens), a Visual Search method built on the logit lens, which decodes the semantics held in a hidden state by projecting it through the LLM head. VisLens further uses a lightweight tuned-lens that maps early hidden states into the final hidden state space, so visual tokens can be read out from early layers. These tokens are matched to target words in the query to generate a crop of the relevant region, which is fed back in alongside the original image to produce the final answer. The whole process, from decoding to the final answer, completes in a single forward pass without repeated queries. VisLens matches or exceeds prior baselines while delivering a substantial latency advantage, running $8.5$--$9.9\times$ faster than Thyme and up to $22.2\times$ faster than training-free multi-pass search methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: VisLens: 单页可解释 对多式联运有限责任公司进行视觉搜索
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)与精细的视觉搜索(Visual Search)挣扎,在高分辨率图像中定位小或稀有对象的任务. 现有补救办法分为两个家庭: (1) 基于注意力或信心分数的无培训方法准确但缓慢,因为每个例子都需要多次MLLM查询. (2)强化学习(RL)训练有素的工具使用模型在推论上较快但不透明,因为其工具调用仍然无法控制,难以解释. 为了克服这一点,我们提议\emph{VisLens}(视觉焦点通过Logit Lens),一种基于logit镜头的视觉搜索方法,它通过LLM头投影来解码隐藏状态的语义. VisLens还进一步使用轻量级调制成的Lens,将早期隐藏状态映射到最终隐藏状态空间,因此视觉符号可以从早期的地层读出. 这些符号与查询中的目标单词相匹配,以生成相关区域的作物,这些作物与原始图像一起反馈,生成最终答案. 整个过程,从解码到最后的答案,在一次前传中完成,而不重复询问. VisLens匹配或超过先前的基线,同时提供相当的耐久优势,运行速度比Thyme快8.5美元-9.9\时,运行速度比免训练的多通道搜索方法快22.2\时.

articles.title: TUE-Detector: A Tool-Using Expert MLLM-Based Detector for AI-Generated Videos
articles.content: AI-generated video detection, which aims to distinguish AI-generated videos from real ones, has recently received increasing research attention. To perform this task reliably, a key challenge lies in accurately identifying subtle-yet-measurable unnatural artifacts. In this work, we address this challenge from a novel perspective of tool-mediated evidence discovery and propose Tool-Using Expert MLLM-based AI-generated Video Detector (TUE-Detector), a novel framework for AI-generated video detection. TUE-Detector trains a general MLLM into a task-tailored tool-using expert detector that learns to invoke suitable tools, collect concrete evidence of unnaturalness, and reason over the evidence for reliable detection. Meanwhile, TUE-Detector further introduces novel designs to equip the expert detector with high-quality and suitable tools. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our framework.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TUE-检测器:用于AI-Gened Video的基于MLLM的工具使用专家检测器
articles.content_zh: AI生成的视频检测旨在将AI生成的视频与真实的视频区分开来,最近研究得到了越来越多的关注. 要可靠地完成这项任务,关键的挑战在于准确确定一些微妙的、有待测量的非自然文物。 在这项工作中,我们从工具调解证据发现的新角度来应对这一挑战,并提出了基于工具Using 专家MLLM的AI生成视频检测器(TUE-Detectionor),这是AI生成视频检测的新框架. TUE-探测器将一般的MLLM训练成一个任务专用的工具使用专家探测器,学习如何引用适当的工具,收集不自然性的具体证据,以及可靠的探测证据的理由. 同时,TUE-探测器进一步引入了新的设计,为专家探测器配备高质量和合适的工具. 广泛的实验表明我们的框架是有效的。

articles.title: Can Video World Models Track Unobserved World States?
articles.content: Video world models are increasingly used as simulators, yet visual fidelity alone does not show that a model maintains the hidden state of the world. We examine this gap with an action-conditioned video Shell Game, a visual analog of $S_5$ state tracking that decouples visual rendering from compositing the hidden state underneath. Bidirectional and autoregressive Transformers, Mamba, and linear attention restricted to nonnegative transition eigenvalues all fit the training horizon of 5 swaps and then fall toward chance on longer swap chains (extrapolation) while still rendering plausible video with additional denoising steps providing no benefit. The pixel-based diffusion target never supervises the unseen hidden state, so the generated frames cannot carry it and the state has to live inside the architecture rather than in the tokens. For a Transformer, that architectural state is only an append-only KV cache, so the model has to re-derive the hidden arrangement from the whole history at every chunk. We find two mechanisms that do extrapolate, and both carry a state across chunks and revise it in place. Linear attention succeeds once its transition eigenvalues may be negative, and TTT with a nonlinear fast weight succeeds by updating the feature map through which it reads its own state. We further examine harder cases in dynamic world exploration tasks, and discuss the broader implications for building stateful video world models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 视频世界模式能否追踪未观察世界国家?
articles.content_zh: 视频世界模型被越来越多地用作模拟器,然而光是视觉忠实并不能表明一个模型维持了世界的隐藏状态. 我们用一个有动作条件的视频壳牌游戏来检查这个缺口,一个以$S_5美元状态跟踪的视觉模拟,将视觉渲染与下面的隐藏状态混为一谈. 双向自动变换器(Mamba)和线性注意力限制在非负向过渡的eigenvalue上, 基于像素的传播目标从不监督隐蔽的隐藏状态,因此生成的帧无法携带,状态必须生活在架构内而不是符中. 对于一个变形器来说,这种建筑状态仅仅是一个仅附加的 KV 缓存,所以模型必须从整个历史中从每个块重新找到隐藏的安排. 我们发现有两种机制可以推断, 两种机制都把状态带过块并修正出来。 线性注意一旦其过渡的eigen值可能为负值就成功,具有非线性快重的TTT通过更新其读取自身状态的特征图而成功. 我们进一步研究动态世界探索任务中的更难案例,并讨论建立状态视频世界模型的更广泛影响.

articles.title: Failure or Drift? Evaluating Monocular SLAM under Synthetic and Real-World Corruptions
articles.content: Visual SLAM is commonly evaluated on clean trajectories, although deployment failures are often caused by adverse weather, illumination, blur, and sensor artifacts. Controlled corruptions are attractive because they isolate such factors, but a synthetic stress test is useful only when it leads to the same engineering conclusion as the condition it is intended to approximate. This work examines that question for monocular SLAM. We evaluate a classical feature-based system and two learned trackers under image-space, geometry-aware, and compound corruptions, and compare their behavior with adverse conditions from 4Seasons. Rather than reducing robustness to a single trajectory error, the evaluation separates explicit tracking failure from drift accumulated by methods that remain active. The results show that learned trackers largely replace catastrophic loss with sustained, and sometimes severe, drift. More importantly, the apparent ordering of the learned systems changes with the physical fidelity of the corruption: structured rain and fog proxies preserve the real-world ordering, whereas a simple illumination proxy does not. Code is available at: https://github.com/abhaythomas/master_thesis_vslamlab_robustness.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 失败还是漂流? 在合成和现实世界腐败下评价单体SLAM
articles.content_zh: 视觉SLAM通常在清洁的轨迹上进行评估,尽管部署失败往往是由恶劣的天气,照明,模糊,以及感应文物引起的. 受控制的腐败之所以有吸引力,是因为它们孤立了这些因素,但合成压力测试只有在导致与它所要估计的条件相同的工程结论时才有用。 这项工作为单一的SLAM研究了这个问题。 我们评价一个基于古典特征的系统,以及两个在图像空间,几何意识和复合腐败下学习的跟踪器,并将其行为与4Seasons的不利条件进行比较. 评价没有将稳健性降低为单一的轨迹错误,而是将明确的跟踪失败与仍然活跃的方法所累积的漂移区分开来。 结果显示,有学识的追踪器基本上用持续的、有时是严重的漂移来取代灾难性的损失。 更重要的是,所学系统的明显秩序随着腐败的物理忠实性而变化:结构化的雨和雾代理保持了现实世界的秩序,而简单的照明代用则没有。 代码可见于:https://github.com/abhaythomas/master_thesis_vslamlab_robustness. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-21.

articles.title: CANVAS: Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling for Long-Context Text-to-SVG Generation
articles.content: Autoregressive large models have recently advanced Text-to-SVG generation from simple icons to complex, long-context graphics, yet standard autoregressive decoding often fails to maintain global consistency across geometry, layout, occlusion, and composition. We introduce CANVAS (Consistency-Aware Navigation via Visual Adaptive Sampling), a training-free, render-aware inference framework that combines power-sharpened trajectory likelihood with visual feedback from rendered futures and derives a stroke-wise navigation rule. It effectively estimates each candidate stroke's future value under a limited generation and rendering budget and adaptively allocates samples according to candidate uncertainty, decision influence, and rollout cost. Experiments across multiple autoregressive SVG backbones and complementary benchmarks demonstrate improvements in global consistency, which includes sound geometric relationships, spatial layouts, occlusion ordering, and overall composition, without additional training, demonstrating the effectiveness and generalization ability of our framework.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CANVAS: 一致性- 通过可视化适应性取样进行智能导航,用于长文本对SVG 生成
articles.content_zh: 自动回转的大型模型最近将文本到SVG的生成从简单的图标升级到复杂的,长的文本图形,然而标准自动回转的解码往往无法在几何,布局,封存,和组成方面保持全球的一致性. 我们引入了CANVAS(一致性-通过视觉适应性取样的智能导航),这是一个没有训练的、可渲染的推论框架,将电源断裂轨迹的可能性与所渲染的未来的视觉反馈结合起来,并产生中风导航规则。 它有效地估计了每一次候选中风在有限一代人中的未来价值,并根据候选不确定性、决策影响和推出成本,进行预算并按具体情况进行分配。 跨越多种自旋式SVG主干线和补充基准的实验表明全球一致性有所改进,这包括健全的几何关系、空间布局、隔离命令和总体构成,而没有增加培训,显示了我们框架的有效性和概括性能力。

articles.title: UFPR-PEs: A Brazilian Face Recognition Benchmark with Self-Declared Race/Color Labels
articles.content: While face recognition systems are widely deployed, ensuring their demographic reliability and robustness under uncontrolled visual conditions remains a critical challenge. To bridge this gap, we present UFPR-PEs, a benchmark for face recognition bias evaluation using public videos of elected Brazilian politicians annotated with official self-declared race/color categories. The dataset adopts the Brazilian census taxonomy, including the parda category, which has no direct equivalent in the U.S.- or Europe-centric schemas commonly used in prior benchmarks. Our benchmark is built from compressed public video and preserves difficult samples so that performance can be analyzed under realistic conditions. We describe the construction pipeline, report dataset statistics, and evaluate face recognition performance across verification and (closed- and open-set) identification settings, including subgroup analysis by race/color and difficulty level. The results show that recognition performance varies substantially with image quality, and that subgroup gaps must be interpreted jointly with visual difficulty rather than in isolation. Overall, UFPR-PEs provides a reproducible and demographically grounded setting for studying face recognition bias under challenging public video conditions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: UFPR-PEs:巴西自评种族/彩色标签的面部识别基准
articles.content_zh: 面对识别系统得到广泛部署,但确保其在不受控制的视觉条件下的人口可靠性和稳健性仍然是一个重大挑战。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出UFPR-PE,这是使用巴西民选政治人物的公开录像进行脸部识别偏差评价的基准,并附有官方自行宣布的种族/肤色类别。 数据集采用巴西人口普查分类法,包括parda分类法,该分类法在以往基准中常用的以美国或欧洲为中心的方案中没有直接的等同性。 我们的基准是用压缩的公开视频构建的,并保存困难的样本,以便在现实条件下分析性能. 我们描述施工管道,报告数据集统计数据,并评估各种核查和(封闭和开放的)识别设置的面部识别性能,包括按种族/肤色和难度水平进行分组分析。 结果显示,识别性能因图像质量而有很大差异,分组差距必须结合视觉困难而不是孤立地解释. 总体而言,UFPR-PE为在挑战性公共视频条件下研究脸部识别偏差提供了一个可复制和基于人口的环境。

articles.title: InfraOcc: An Infrastructure Occupancy Benchmark with Static-to-Dynamic Reasoning
articles.content: Fixed-viewpoint infrastructure sensors repeatedly observe the same traffic space, making roadside 3D occupancy structurally different from ego-vehicle perception: a near-persistent static scaffold is overlaid with sparse, short-lived dynamic events. Existing occupancy benchmarks and methods, however, are built around moving ego vehicles and neither measure nor exploit this structure, instead treating occupancy as flat one-shot voxel classification. We address this gap from both data and model perspectives. We build InfraOcc, to our knowledge, the first real-world infrastructure-side semantic occupancy benchmark, with dense voxel annotations for 290 multi-modal sequences in a fixed roadside frame, a static-dynamic decoupled annotation pipeline, unified camera-only, LiDAR-only, and multi-modal evaluation, and diagnostics for static and dynamic occupancy. InfraOcc shows that static infrastructure fills 97.3% of occupied voxels and persists across frames, whereas dynamic participants have a median occupied-frame ratio of only 1.8% per location, revealing a structural static-dynamic asymmetry beyond semantic long-tailedness. We further propose ProSD-Occ, which reformulates occupancy as progressive static-to-dynamic evidence reasoning: it explains persistent layout, exposes residual dynamic evidence under static-confidence guidance, and recomposes static, dynamic, and free-space evidence into a unified field. ProSD-Occ ranks first in overall, dynamic, static, and geometric occupancy on every track, e.g., a 23.5% relative camera-only dynamic-mIoU gain over the strongest baseline and 65.87 multi-modal overall mIoU, establishing fixed-viewpoint roadside occupancy as a distinct problem with its own reasoning paradigm. The benchmark and code will be publicly available at https://github.com/yanglei18/InfraOcc
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基础设施占用基准
articles.content_zh: 固定视点基础设施传感器多次观测到相同的交通空间,使得路边3D占用与自我车辆感知结构不同:一个近乎持久的静态脚手架被零星,短暂的动态事件所覆盖. 然而,现有的占用基准和方法是围绕自驾车制定的,既不衡量也不利用这一结构,而是将占用作为一发光的单倍体分类。 我们从数据和模型的角度来处理这一差距。 据我们所知,我们建造了InfraOcc,第一个现实世界基础设施侧语义占用基准,在固定的路边框架内对290个多式联运序列进行了密集的voxel注释,一个静态动力解码管道,统一只摄像头,LiDAR,以及多种模式的评价,以及对静态和动态占用的诊断。 InfraOcc显示,静态基础设施填充了97.3%的被占用的阴道,并持续跨帧,而动态参与者的中位占用帧比仅为每个位置的1.8%,揭示出结构静态动力不对称,超出了语义长尾. 我们进一步提出ProSD-Occ,它将占用重新定型为渐进的静态对动态证据推理:它解释持续的布局,在静态自信指导下暴露残余的动态证据,并将静态,动态,自由空间的证据重新组成一个统一的领域. ProSD-Occ在每个赛道上在整体,动态,静态,几何占用中排名第一,例如,23.5%的相机专用动态-mIoU比最强的基线增高,65.87的多式联运总体mIoU,将固定视点路边占用确定为自身推理范式的一个明显问题. 该基准和代码将在https://github.com/yanglei18/InfraOcc上公布。

articles.title: APT: Anchor-aligned Perturbations for Tamper Localization in Fully Regenerated Images
articles.content: Proactive tamper localization embeds an imperceptible signal into an image prior to distribution, enabling pixel-level manipulation detection. Existing methods assume a spliced (SP) setting, where synthesized regions are composited onto the original background, leaving embedded signals intact. However, real-world diffusion-based inpainting operates in a fully regenerated (FR) setting, where the entire image undergoes denoising, disrupting background signals and rendering existing frameworks ineffective. We propose APT, a semi-fragile latent-space perturbation that embeds a dense, vector-wise localization signal. By aligning each spatial feature vector toward a fixed anchor direction, APT localizes tampering via the alignment disparity between synthesized foreground and anchor-aligned background features after inpainting. The proposed hard negative mining loss and noisy perturbation branch further enforce uniform alignment. Experiments on COCO demonstrate that APT achieves an FR IoU of 0.92, outperforming the strongest baseline (WAM, 0.84), while existing methods collapse to near-random performance (AUC 0.5), establishing APT as a practical forensic framework generalizable across tampering types unknown at test time.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: APT: 完全重生图像中坦佩尔本地化的锁定- 连接扰动
articles.content_zh: 主动的篡改本地化在发行前将一个无法识别的信号嵌入到图像中,使得像素级的操纵检测成为可能. 现有方法假设一个拼接(SP)设置,将合成区域合成到原始背景上,使嵌入式信号完好无损. 然而,基于现实世界的传播的涂料在完全再生成(FR)的环境下运作,整个图像都经过去诺化,破坏背景信号,使现有框架无效. 我们提出APT,一种半脆弱的潜在空间扰动,它嵌入了密集的,向量的本地化信号. 通过将每个空间特征矢量向固定锚定方向对齐,APT在涂抹后通过合成前缘特征与锚定相匹配背景特征的对齐差异,将篡改本地化. 提议的硬负式采矿损失和噪音扰动分支进一步实行统一调整。 关于COCO的实验表明,APT实现0.92的FRIoU,超过了最强基线(WAM,0.84),而现有方法崩溃到近随机性能(AUC,0.5),将APT确定为适用于测试时未知的篡改类型的实际法医学框架。

articles.title: Fine-Grained Multi Image Object Hallucination Benchmark
articles.content: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-image scenarios requiring complex reasoning across visual contexts. However, current MLLMs remain fundamentally limited by object hallucination-generating plausible yet factually inconsistent descriptions about objects. Existing benchmarks, designed primarily for single-image settings or providing only high-level multi-image assessments, cannot systematically diagnose how visual complexity and reasoning demands trigger hallucination. To address this gap, we introduce MIOH, a fine-grained multi-image object hallucination benchmark that systematically evaluates object hallucination across four foundational tasks (existence, counting, attribute, position) through three multi-image reasoning patterns (comprehensive, comparative, selective) under three controlled adversarial pressures (visual context scale, perceptual difficulty, contextual bias). Through evaluation of 29 models, we reveal that even state-of-the-art systems like GPT-5 and Gemini-2.5-Pro exhibit distinct failure patterns across different reasoning patterns and tasks. Our evaluation reveals that hallucination stems not merely from perceptual failures but from integration-stage limitations when maintaining object representations across multiple images. MIOH provides a controlled framework for analyzing multi-image object hallucination and serves as a critical evaluation tool for developing more reliable multimodal AI systems.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 精细的多图像对象迷幻基准
articles.content_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)越来越多地用于需要跨视觉背景复杂推理的多图像情景. 然而,目前的MLLMs仍然受到物体产生幻觉的、令人信服但事实上不一致的物体描述的根本限制。 现有基准主要针对单一图像设置,或只提供高水平的多图像评估,无法系统地判断视觉复杂性和推理要求触发幻觉的方式. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了MIOH,这是一个精细的多图像对象幻觉基准,通过三种受控对抗压力(视觉上下文尺度,感知难度,上下文偏差)下的三种多图像推理模式(综合,比较,选择性),系统地评价四个基本任务(存在,计算,属性,位置)的物体幻觉. 通过对29种模型的评价,我们揭示出,即使是最先进的系统,如GPT-5和双子座-2.5-Pro,在不同的推理模式和任务中也表现出明显的失败模式. 我们的评价显示,幻觉不仅源于感知的失败,还源于在维持多个图像的物体表示时的集成阶段限制。 MIOH为分析多图像对象幻觉提供了控制框架,并成为开发更可靠的多式联运AI系统的重要评价工具.

articles.title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 身份生活:本地化、保留自由身份 不学习多种大语文模式
articles.content_zh: 从多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)中移除特定个人的信息,在部署后往往需要,但现有方法依赖于一个保留集,这在当时最难获得,并重建它重新创造出未学会去除的隐私曝光. 仅仅从遗忘中忘记,反而损害共同的视觉语言计算,损害认知。 我们把无保留无学习作为一个本地化问题:因果追踪,重量移植,费舍尔重叠都指向早期到中间的解码器MLP作为存储身份信息的层,与其他模块家族不同,可以修改而不会严重干扰视觉. 我们把它变成Pathway-Aware视觉属性安乔林(PAVA), 将更新限制在这些层, 在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem上,PAVA给出了最强的忘却-保留取舍方法,并且仍然具有基于保留的基线的竞争力.

articles.title: Quantum-Grassmann-Plucker Token Mixing for Deep Learning-Based Post-Disaster Damage Assessment
articles.content: Timely post-disaster building damage assessment from satellite imagery is a critical engineering decision support task, yet it remains constrained by class imbalance, ambiguous intermediate damage states, and limited cross-event transferability. This study presents, to our knowledge, the first application of Grassmann-Plucker (GP) token mixing to computer vision and introduces two extensions for image classification: the Quantum-inspired Grassmann-Plucker (QGP) head and the Hybrid Quantum Machine Learning Grassmann-Plucker (HQML-GP) head. The GP head represents multiscale relationships among image patch tokens by encoding subspaces formed by token pairs with Plucker coordinates; QGP enriches these coordinates with amplitude-derived probability features, whereas HQML-GP incorporates expectation values generated by a simulated quantum circuit into the geometric token representation. Paired pre- and post-event image patches from the xBD tornado dataset were processed using a frozen six-channel Vision Transformer base encoder with 16 x 16-pixel patches. The three GP-based heads were compared with multilayer perceptron and Transformer baselines under identical training, checkpoint selection, and evaluation protocols. Joplin and Moore tornado samples were used for model development and seen-event testing, while Tuscaloosa was reserved for unseen-event evaluation. QGP led both test sets in accuracy and macro-F1: 83.46% and 64.50% for the seen events, and 66.45% and 52.70% for the unseen event. Although HQML-GP obtained the highest validation macro-F1 of 65.63%, it did not surpass QGP on either test set and required substantially more training time per epoch. These results establish GP token mixing as a competitive attention-free alternative to conventional Transformer-based token mixing for paired satellite image damage classification.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 量子-格拉斯曼-普勒克·托肯混合用于深层基于学习的后灾难 损害评估
articles.content_zh: 及时从卫星图像中评估灾后建筑破坏情况是一项关键的工程决策支持任务,但仍受到阶级不平衡、中间损害状态模糊不清和跨活动可转移性有限的制约。 这项研究向我们介绍了Grassmann-Plucker(GP)符号混合到计算机视觉的第一个应用,并引入了图像分类的两个扩展:量子启发的Grassmann-Plucker(QGP)头和混合量子机器学习Grassmann-Plucker(HQML-GP)头. GP头代表图像补丁符号之间的多尺度关系,方法是用Plucker坐标的符号对组成子空间进行编码;QGP用振幅衍生概率特性丰富这些坐标,而HQML-GP则将模拟量子电路产生的期望值纳入几何符号表示. XBD龙卷风数据集的Paired事前和事后图像补丁是使用一个有16×16像素补丁的冷冻六通道Vision Transformer基础编码器处理的. 在相同的训练、检查站选择和评价协议下,将三个基于全科医生的主管与多层感官和变形器基线进行比较。 乔普林和摩尔龙卷风样本被用于模型开发和目视事件测试,而图斯卡卢萨则被保留用于秘密事件评价. QGP在精确度和宏F1中都领先了测试集:见事件为83.46%和64.50%,看不见事件为66.45%和52.70%。 虽然HQML-GP获得了65.63%的最高验证宏-F1,但在两个测试集上都没有超过QGP,并且每个时代需要大量的培训时间. 这些结果确立了GP符号混合,作为传统的变形器符号混合的无竞争注意替代方法,用于对成对卫星图像进行破坏分类。

articles.title: Cost-efficient Active Learning for Referring Image Segmentation and Grounding
articles.content: Collecting natural-language referring expressions along with region annotations, such as masks or boxes, is a major bottleneck in visual grounding (VG), as annotators must write descriptions that distinguish target regions from visually similar ones. We tackle this by formulating active learning (AL) for VG under the realistic setting where only raw images are available without accompanying text. Since ground-truth text is unavailable, sample selection must estimate which images contain ambiguous regions that would require discriminative referring expressions. To address this, we generate auxiliary region-text pairs using foundation models, and introduce Referred Region Ambiguity, a new acquisition function that measures whether the model's confidence collapses onto a single region or disperses across multiple candidates. It allows our method to prioritize images with strong cross-region competition, which are more informative due to their visual ambiguity. We also design a referring-expression annotation interface that helps annotators quickly focus on writing discriminative language with a few clicks. Experiments on RIS and REC benchmarks show that our AL framework consistently outperforms several AL baselines, while a user study shows up to 1.6X faster description labeling of ours.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 成本效益 积极学习参考图像分割和定位
articles.content_zh: 收集自然语言的参考表达以及区域说明,如口罩或盒子,是视觉地面(VG)中的一个主要瓶颈,因为注释者必须写出区分目标区域与视觉相似区域的描述. 在现实环境中,只有原始图像可用,没有随附文本,我们通过为VG制定积极学习(AL)来解决这个问题。 由于没有地面真实文本,样本选择必须估计哪些图像含有模糊区域,需要歧视性的引用表达方式。 为了解决这个问题,我们利用基础模型生成辅助区域文本配对,并引入了“参考区域假象”这一新的获取功能,该功能用于衡量模型的信心是崩溃到一个单一区域还是分散到多个候选人之间。 这使得我们的方法可以以强烈的跨区域竞争来优先排列图像,由于图像的视觉模糊性,它们的信息性更高. 我们还设计了一个参考-表达式注释界面,帮助注释者用几下点击快速专注于写歧视语言. 有关RIS和REC基准的实验表明,我们的AL框架的业绩一贯超过若干AL基线,而用户研究显示,对我们的描述更快,达到1.6X。

articles.title: AQ3D: Adaptive Query Transformer for 3D Instance Segmentation
articles.content: Transformer-based decoders for 3D instance segmentation typically commit to a fixed number of queries and positional modeling calibrated on the training distribution rather than on the scene at hand. Indoor scans vary widely in spatial extent and object count, so a fixed query set over-initializes small scenes and under-initializes large ones, while learned absolute and relative encodings are bound to the training scenes' extents and can saturate. We present AQ3D, which is designed to handle scenes of various sizes during training and inference. Queries are instantiated at a fixed ratio of the scene's superpoints, forming an overcomplete set whose background rejection is entirely left to the decoder. Positional information is encoded using 3D RoPE over quantized metric coordinates, replacing learned bounded lookup tables of prior decoders. Further, we improve the decoder itself by using attribution-based superpoint pooling, a mask refinement branch, and a cosine classifier for background rejection. Experiments show our method sets a new state-of-the-art on validation and hidden test splits across the datasets ScanNetV2, ScanNet200, and ScanNet++V2 among decoder methods trained without additional data augmentation. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/kenomo/aq3d}{github.com/kenomo/aq3d}.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: AQ3D: 3D 实例分割的可适应性查询变换器
articles.content_zh: 基于变形器的3D实例分区解码器一般会承诺在训练分布上而不是在手边的场景上校准固定数量的查询和位置模型. 室内扫描在空间范围与物体计数上差异很大,所以固定的查询设置超初始化小场景,低于初始化大场景,而所学的绝对编码和相对编码则与训练场景的深度紧密相连,可以饱和. 我们介绍的是AQ3D,它旨在处理培训和推论期间各种大小的场景. 查询以场景超点的固定比例进行即时化,形成一个过度完整的集,其背景拒绝完全留给解码器. 位置信息使用3D RoPE在量化的度量坐标上进行编码,取代先前解码器的已学习到的边框查找表. 此外,我们通过使用基于归属的超点集合,一个面具完善分支,以及一个背景拒绝的余弦分类器来改进解码器本身. 实验显示,我们的方法在验证和隐藏测试方面设置了新的最新技术,并划分了ScanNetV2、ScanNet200和ScanNet++的数据集。 在没有增加数据的情况下培训解码方法中的V2。 代码为\href{ https://github.com/kenomo/aq3d}{github.com/kenomo/aq3d] (英语).

articles.title: RealCAD: Towards Real-World Image-to-CAD Reconstruction under Domain Shift and Parameter Bias
articles.content: Reconstructing editable Computer-Aided Design (CAD) models from images is essential for downstream modification, manufacturing, and design reuse. However, existing image-to-CAD methods are developed predominantly on synthetic renderings and face two coupled obstacles: a substantial appearance domain gap between synthetic and real images, and a previously overlooked parameter bias in widely used CAD data. We show that the local normalization adopted by DeepCAD concentrates several geometric parameters around a few discrete values while encoding substantial information in a single scale factor. Consequently, a model can achieve deceptively high parameter accuracy by exploiting these frequent values rather than inferring geometry from the input image. In this paper, we propose RealCAD, a unified framework that addresses these limitations at the representation, image, and feature levels. At the representation level, we redistribute scale information to the corresponding geometric parameters, producing less concentrated parameter distributions in a shared scale space. At the image level, geometry-constrained translation converts synthetic renderings toward the real-image domain while conditioning on object contours. At the feature level, a multi-positive contrastive objective aligns representations of the same CAD model across viewpoints and image domains, enabling CAD sequence prediction from each individual view. We further introduce OpenRealCAD, comprising four-view photographs of 392 3D-printed objects paired with ground-truth command sequences. Experiments show that the revised representation substantially reduces the accuracy attainable from parameter-frequency priors, making parameter accuracy a more reliable measure of image-conditioned geometric inference. RealCAD further improves real-domain command and parameter accuracy, while retaining competitive synthetic-domain performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: RealCAD:走向真实世界的图像对CAD 域移和参数比亚斯下的重建
articles.content_zh: 从图像中重建可编辑的计算机辅助设计模型对于下游的修改、制造和设计再利用至关重要。 然而,现有的图像到CAD方法主要是在合成渲染上开发的,并面临两个并存的障碍:合成图像与真实图像之间巨大的外观域间隙,以及之前被广泛使用的CAD数据忽略的参数偏差. 我们显示,DeepCAD采用的局部正常化将若干几何参数集中在几个离散值上,同时将大量信息编码成一个尺度系数。 因此,一个模型可以通过利用这些频繁的数值而不是从输入图像中推断几何来达到欺骗性高的参数精度. 在本文中,我们提出RealCAD,这是一个统一的框架,在代表性、形象和特征层面解决这些局限性。 在表示层面,我们将尺度信息重新分配到相应的几何参数,在共享尺度空间中产生比较集中的参数分布. 在图像层面,几何紧凑的翻译将合成渲染转换成真实图像域,同时在对象轮廓上调节. 在特征层面,一个多阳性对比性目标将同一CAD模型在观点和图像域之间的表达相协调,使CAD从每个个体角度进行序列预测成为可能. 我们还引入了OpenRealCAD,由392个3D打印对象与地面真实指令序列对齐的四景照片组成. 实验显示,修改后的表示法大大降低了参数频率前期可达到的精度,使参数精度成为图像条件几何推论的更可靠的度量. RealCAD进一步提高了真域指令和参数精度,同时保留了竞争性的合成域性能.

articles.title: OCR-Based Field Extraction for Archaeological Pottery Metadata: The CENTURIA Dataset
articles.content: Pottery is a primary source for reconstructing the chronological and economic dimensions of past societies. Archaeologists often document ceramic finds through technical drawings and handwritten metadata. This metadata is critical for dating, provenance attribution, and cross-site comparison, but remains inaccessible to computational analysis, requiring manual transcription of every record. We investigate whether state-of-the-art document analysis models can address this task, and introduce CENTURIA, a dataset of 507 pottery records from the Roman site of Carnuntum, providing transcriptions, bounding boxes, and structured field-level labels across seven metadata categories. Benchmarking five OCR models reveals a substantial domain gap: zero-shot transcription error reaches 15-32% SpACER-M, far exceeding rates on printed archival documents, with domain-specific fields recovered in fewer than 3% of cases. LoRA fine-tuning on just 57 samples, reflecting a realistic archival annotation budget, closes this gap, reducing transcription error to below 1.5% and recovering overall field-level accuracy above 87%. Our results show that a small expert-validated fine-tuning set suffices to convert handwritten pottery documentation into structured, searchable metadata ready for archaeological databases.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 基于OCR的考古实地采掘 波特语元数据 : CENTURIA 数据集
articles.content_zh: 波特利是重建过去社会的时间顺序和经济层面的主要来源. 考古学家经常通过技术图纸和手写元数据记录陶瓷发现. 这种元数据对于约会、来源归属和跨地点比较至关重要,但计算分析仍然无法进行,需要人工复制每份记录。 我们调查最先进的文件分析模型是否能够处理这项任务,并介绍CENTURIA,这是从卡农图姆罗马站点收集的507个陶器记录的数据集,提供抄本,边框,以及结构化的实地级标签,跨越七个元数据类别. 以5个OCR模型为基准揭示了一个巨大的域间隙:零镜头抄录误差达到15-32%的SpACER-M,远远超过印刷档案文件的速率,在不到3%的案例中恢复了特定域. LORA对57个样本进行了微调,反映了现实的档案注释预算,缩小了这一差距,将抄录误差降至1.5%以下,并恢复了87%以上的实地一级整体精度。 我们的结果显示,一个经过专家鉴定的微调装置足以将手写陶器文件转换成结构化、可搜索的元数据,供考古数据库使用。

articles.title: DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation
articles.content: Robust estimation is a core computer vision task frequently tackled using sample consensus. However, traditional methods suffer from inefficient sampling as they struggle to identify effective minimum sets before hypothesis evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation (DiffSAC) framework. DiffSAC introduces a diffusion model to learn the distribution of effective minimum sets. It refines the confidence for each data point, indicating whether it belongs to a good minimum set, rather than ranking the data points as in previous work. This significantly reduces the need to process numerous bad sets. To constrain the refinement direction, geometric features are incorporated as conditions within our diffusion model. Consequently, DiffSAC outputs a small number of high-quality minimum sets, enabling identification of the best hypothesis via consensus evaluation. Notably, compared to previous works requiring evaluating over ten thousand hypotheses, DiffSAC achieves state-of-the-art performance with only dozens, significantly boosting efficiency. Extensive experiments across five classic computer vision tasks demonstrate the superiority of DiffSAC. The diffusion model's sampling accelerators enable real-time operation, and DiffSAC can be used as a plug-and-play module to improve existing sample consensus methods.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DiffSAC:基于共识的强力估计传播指导抽样
articles.content_zh: 强有力的估计是一项计算机远景核心任务,经常利用抽样共识来处理。 然而,传统方法在假设评价前难以确定有效的最低限度数据集,因此其抽样效率低下。 为了应对这些挑战,我们提出了一个以传播指导为主的“基于共识的强力估计”新框架。 DiffSAC引入了传播模式,以学习有效最小集的分布. 它完善了每个数据点的置信度,表明它是否属于一个良好的最小集,而不是像以前的工作那样对数据点进行排名. 这大大减少了处理众多坏片的需要. 为了限制完善方向,几何特征被作为条件纳入我们的传播模式. 因此,DiffSAC提供了少量高质量的最低成套数据,从而能够通过共识评价确定最佳假设。 值得注意的是,与以前需要评价一万多个假设的作品相比,DIffSAC仅实现了数十项最先进的性能,大大提高了效率. 跨越五个经典的计算机视觉任务的广泛实验显示了DiffSAC的优越性. 扩散模型的采样加速器可以进行实时操作,DiffSAC可以作为插件和游戏模块,改进现有的采样共识方法.

articles.title: Context-Aware Interleaved Batching for WhisperX
articles.content: While WhisperX accelerates speech transcription via intra-audio batching, it isolates audio segments, losing the historical context needed for coherent punctuation and terminology transcription. Conversely, standard Whisper retains context sequentially but suffers from slow inference and hallucination loops. To achieve the best of both worlds, we propose Context-Aware Interleaved Batching. By using VAD-derived segment boundaries, our algorithm stabilizes Whisper's text conditioning, allowing us to safely maintain continuous historical context across batched audio segments. As demonstrated on long-form audio benchmarks, this approach reduces Word Error Rate (WER) and improves proper noun transcription, all while maintaining high-throughput inference speeds.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 上下文预览互页 为 WhisperX 剪辑
articles.content_zh: 低声 X通过音频内部批量来加速语音转录,它隔离音频片段,失去了连贯的转录和名词转录所需的历史背景. 相反,标准Whisper按顺序保留上下文,但受到推论缓慢和幻觉循环的影响. 为了实现两个世界中最好的,我们提议上下文-Aware Interleaved Batching. 通过使用 VAD 衍生的片段边界,我们的算法稳定了Whisper 的文本条件,使我们能够安全地保持连续的历史背景跨批次的音频片段. 如长式音频基准所示,这种方法降低了Word错误率(WER),并改进了适当的名词转录,同时保持高通量推断速度.

articles.title: Configurable Semantic Chunking for Biomedical Information Extraction in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: BioMedRAG introduced retrieval-augmented generation with a learned chunk scorer for biomedical information extraction. However, it relies on fixed-size chunking which can fragment semantic evidence. We propose a configurable semantic chunking framework that addresses this limitation by combining entity-preserving windows, trigger-centered chunking, proposition-first extraction, tiered trigger prioritization, and hierarchical relation resolution. The framework integrates with BioMedRAG by replacing only the chunk construction stage while preserving the embedding model, learned chunk scorer, generator, and evaluation protocol. We evaluate the framework on biomedical relation extraction benchmarks (GM-CIHT, DDI, ChemProt) and adverse event classification (ADE). On GM-CIHT, the full hybrid configuration achieves 82.6% F1, improving over the fixed-size baseline (74.2% F1) by 8.4 points under our experimental setup. Cross-dataset analysis shows that semantic chunking improves extraction datasets with explicit relation cues, such as GM-CIHT and DDI, while fixed chunking remains competitive or stronger for dense biochemical extraction and binary classification settings such as ChemProt and ADE. By externalizing chunking logic into configuration files, the framework provides an interpretable and adaptable alternative to rigid fixed-size chunking for biomedical RAG pipelines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 生物医学信息提取工具
articles.content_zh: BioMedRAG引进了具有生物医学信息提取学分仪的检索加载一代。 然而,它依赖于固定大小的块,这些块可以分割语义证据。 我们提出了一个可配置的语义分类框架,通过结合实体保全窗口、以触发为中心、命题第一提取、分级触发优先排序和分级关系分辨率来解决这一限制。 该框架与BioMedRAG结合,仅取代块构造阶段,同时保留嵌入模型、学习的块计分器、发电机和评价协议。 我们评价生物医学关系提取基准(GM-CIHT、DDI、ChemProt)和不良事件分类框架。 在GM-CIHT上,全混合配置实现82.6%的F1,比我们实验设置下的固定尺寸基线(74.2%的F1)提高了8.4分. 跨数据集分析显示,语义块化改进了具有明确关系提示的提取数据集,如GM-CIHT和DDI,而固定块化对于密集的生化提取和二进制分类设置,如ChemProt和ADE,仍然具有竞争力或更强. 通过将块逻辑外部化为配置文件,框架为生物医学RAG管道提供了一个可解释和可适应的固定尺寸块的替代方案。

articles.title: DIASENTINEL: An Auditable Multi-Agent System for Guideline-Grounded Diabetes Risk Screening
articles.content: Large language models (LLMs) offer promising clinical decision support but remain vulnerable to hallucinated facts, unsupported recommendations, and citation errors. We present DIASENTINEL, a fully on-premise multi-agent system for one-year type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) risk screening and guideline-grounded report generation from electronic health records (EHRs). The system integrates calibrated risk prediction, deterministic clinical signal extraction, Reciprocal Rank Fusion over American Diabetes Association (ADA) guidelines, and a hybrid verification layer combining rule-based checks with LLM entailment. The demonstration provides a real-time batch-screening dashboard and an interactive patient report interface with cited recommendations, verification results, and raw EHR comparison. DIASENTINEL demonstrates a practical framework for reliable, auditable, and privacy-preserving LLM-based clinical decision support.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: DIASENTINEL:可审计的多剂治疗系统,用于诊断糖尿病的风险
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)提供了有希望的临床决策支持,但仍容易受到幻觉事实,无支持的建议和引用错误的影响. 我们介绍DIASENTINEL,这是一个完全精准的多剂系统,用于对2型糖尿病进行一年期风险筛查,并从电子健康记录中生成有指导依据的报告。 该系统整合了校准风险预测、确定性临床信号提取、美国糖尿病协会准则之上的对等Rank Fusion,以及结合基于规则的检查和LLM内含的混合核查层。 演示提供了一个实时的批量筛选仪表板和病人报告互动界面,与引用的建议、核查结果和原始的EHR比较。 DIASENTINEL展示了可靠、可审计和保全隐私的基于LLM的临床决策支持的实用框架。

articles.title: PaperGym: Rubric-Centered Evolution for Research-Plan Generation
articles.content: Research planning is the decisive capability of AI scientists. Yet a research plan admits no verifiable answer, so reinforcement learning lacks the environment it requires: tasks paired with a critic. Rubrics extracted from scientific papers can supply the critic. Existing pipelines, however, draw the question and the criteria from the same content, so the reward can be earned by paraphrase. The rubric is further compressed into a single scalar per rollout. We introduce PaperGym, a unified framework that turns each research paper into a complete training environment. PaperGym exploits the structure of a paper: the question is synthesized from the research goal and background, while the criteria are derived from the method and experiments. The criteria span methodological innovation and experimental design, and criterion leakage falls to 3.7%, versus 11.90% to 34.10% in existing datasets. Training uses the rubric twice: first as privileged context for OPSD's self-teacher, then as the reward for GRPO. Across Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B, this schedule outperforms supervised fine-tuning, either stage alone, and the reverse ordering, improving five-benchmark averages by +5.6, +5.0, and +4.8 points. With the recipe held fixed, models trained on PaperGym-20k win 58.1% of three-way comparisons, against 28.2% for RubricHub Science. The trained Qwen3-8B reaches 73.48 on ResearchQA, above the far larger Kimi K2.6. We release the pipeline, the 20,000-instance corpus PaperGym-20k, and the benchmarks PaperGym-Innov and PaperGym-Design.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PaperGym:以Rubric-Center 进化为研究-计划生成
articles.content_zh: 研究规划是AI科学家的决定性能力. 然而一个研究计划却不承认任何可核查的答案,因此强化学习缺乏它所需要的环境:任务与批评者配对. 从科学论文中提取的Rubrics可以提供评论家. 然而,现有的管道则从相同的内容中引出问题和标准,因此奖励可以通过句法来获得. 面额在每次推出时会进一步压缩成一个单一的scalar. 我们引入了 PaperGym,一个统一的框架,将每份研究论文变成一个完整的训练环境. PaperGym 利用论文的结构:问题从研究目标和背景综合,而标准则从方法和实验中推导出来. 该标准涵盖方法创新和实验设计,现有数据集中标准泄漏率降至3.7%,而11.90%至34.10%。 训练两次使用标题:首先作为OPSD自我老师的特权背景,然后作为GPRO的奖励. 纵观Quen3-1.7B/4B/8B,这个时刻表的表现超过了监督的微调,无论是单阶段,还是反方向顺序,提高了+5.6,+5.0和+4.8分的5个基准平均值. 随着食谱的固定,PaperGym-20k的模型获得了58.1%的三程比较,而RubricHub Science则获得了28.2%。 训练有素的Qwen3-8B在研究QA上达到73.48,高于更大的Kimi K2.6. 我们释放了输油管, 20000-Instancebas Gym-20k, 和基准 PaperGym-Innov 和 PaperGym-Design。

articles.title: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
articles.content: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. We introduce ASPIRE, a benchmark for vague-goal-driven self-evolution. ASPIRE provides only a natural-language capability goal while downstream evaluation tasks remain hidden. The agent must operationalize the goal by choosing data and update methods, constructing training and validation signals, and deciding when to evaluate. ASPIRE supports both model-weight and agent-harness evolution in a unified interactive environment and evaluates the resulting systems on a hidden, expert-authored set of 520 items spanning six goals. Our experiments show that vague goals redirect search effort toward goal interpretation. Current agents routinely complete training and harness-editing loops, but weight-level gains remain sparse and unstable, and the strongest evolved harness remains below the engineered Qwen-Agent reference. Agents often train on mismatched data and trust narrow self-evaluations, so local gains fail to transfer to hidden evaluation and continued search and training can erase earlier improvements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Aspire: 罐头模型 阴暗目标中的自我发展?
articles.content_zh: 许多重要的人类学习形式开始于一个模糊的目标,例如"成为更好的物理学家"或"在研究上得到改进". 学习者必须解释目标,找出能力差距,决定如何学习,并确定他们是否确实得到了改进. 相反,关于LLM自我演化的现有工作通常从人类规定的任务和评价指标开始,减少自我演化到优化一个明确的目标,而不是决定什么以及如何学习。 我们引入了ASPIRE,是模糊目标驱动的自我演变的基准. ASPIRE只提供自然语言能力目标,而下游评价任务仍然隐藏. 代理商必须通过选择数据和更新方法,构建培训和验证信号,以及决定何时评估,实现目标. ASPIRE支持在统一的互动环境中的模型重量和代理强度演化,并在一套涵盖六个目标的520个隐藏的、由专家撰写的项目上评价由此产生的系统。 我们的实验表明,模糊的目标将搜索工作转向目标解释。 目前的特工人员例行完成训练和调用编辑循环,但重量级收益仍然很少且不稳定,最强进化的调用仍然低于工程的Quen-Agent参考. 代理常常对不匹配的数据进行培训,信任狭隘的自我评价,因此本地收益未能转移到隐藏的评价,持续搜索和培训可以抹去之前的改进.

articles.title: BLOOM-WILT: Logit Tilting for Behaviour Elicitation in Automated LLM Auditing
articles.content: Users of a deployed language model routinely encounter behaviours that testing almost never surfaces, since deployment puts the model through orders of magnitude more interactions than any evaluation can simulate. Automated auditors make testing cheap to scale and flexible enough to cover almost any specified behaviour, yet their lack of optimisation pressure makes them sample-inefficient. To address this shortcoming, we introduce BLOOM-WILT, a full auditing pipeline that elicits natural multi-turn instances of rare behaviours, without training cost or access beyond the target's next-token distribution. On the input side, WILT's auditor model revises its conversational strategy across rounds, learning from previous scored interactions. On the output side, WILT adaptively reweights the target's decoding using the model's own distribution conditioned on an elicitation prompt, so that behaviour-relevant generations are sampled ahead of others it finds equally probable when unprompted. We evaluate WILT across 4 target models and 8 behaviours, where it beats the baseline auditor in 30 of the 32 settings and overturns the previous model safety rankings. WILT raises average behaviour presence from 51% to 100% when eliciting self-harm encouragement from Qwen3.5-4B, beating every elicitation method we port into the same pipeline at matched compute, without pushing output probability below the baseline's.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BLOOM-WILT: 自动LLM中行为描述的逻辑倾斜 审计
articles.content_zh: 已部署语言模型的用户经常遇到几乎从未出现过测试的行为,因为部署使模型通过数量级进行的互动比任何评价所能模拟的都要多。 自动化审计师使测试成本低廉,而且足够灵活,几乎能够涵盖任何特定的行为,然而他们缺乏优化压力使其样本效率低下。 为了克服这一缺陷,我们引入了BLOOM-WILT,这是一个全面的审计程序,它引来罕见行为的自然多变事例,没有培训费用,也没有超出目标下一轮分配的准入。 在输入方面,WILT的审计员模式修改了跨回合的对话策略,学习了以往的得分互动. 在输出方面,WILT在诱导的提示下,利用模型本身的分布条件,对目标进行适应性的重新加权,这样,与行为有关的几代人比其他几代人先进行取样,在未发生时,它就会发现同样的可能性。 我们通过4个目标模式和8个行为对WILT进行评价,在32个环境中有30个环境比基线审计员强,并推翻了以前的示范安全排名。 WILT在从Quen3.5-4B获得自我伤害的鼓励时,将平均行为率从51%提高到100%,用匹配的计算将我们移植到同一管道的每一种诱导方法击败,同时不将输出概率推向基线以下。

articles.title: S3Gym: Can LLMs Turn Self-Testing and Self-Judging into Self-Improvement?
articles.content:
Large language models (LLMs) increasingly interact with external environments and accumulate substantial behavioral experience, yet existing agent benchmarks largely evaluate them as fixed policies. It therefore remains unclear whether an agent can actively test its behavior, judge the resulting experience, and use that experience to improve future decisions. We introduce \textbf{S\textsuperscript{3}Gym}, an interactive benchmark for evaluating LLM self-improvement through three coupled capabilities: \textbf{Self-Testing}, \textbf{Self-Judging}, and \textbf{Self-Improvement}. S$^3$Gym separates permissive exploration from strict held-out evaluation and instantiates this protocol in seven text-based games with executable environment verifiers. We evaluate three pathways for incorporating interaction experience: direct History ICL, score-conditioned Summary Memory, and parameter Training.
  Our experiments reveal that self-improvement is neither automatic nor uniform. Context-level experience improves performance for several model--game pairs, but the most effective pathway depends strongly on the task structure: summaries are beneficial when experience can be compressed into reusable strategic rules, yet often underperform raw history when success depends on precise, state-contingent information. Parameter training produces substantial gains on some tasks, but also exhibits unstable improvement and severe negative transfer on others. These findings show that recognizing successful actions is insufficient; agents must also transform feedback into executable and transferable policies. S$^3$Gym provides a unified framework for diagnosing this process and identifying the bottlenecks that prevent agents from translating interaction experience into reliable self-improvement.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: S3Gym:LLMS能将自我测试和自我判断转化为自我改进吗?.
articles.content_zh:
大型语言模型(LLMS)越来越多地与外部环境互动,积累大量的行为经验,然而现有的代理基准基本上将其评价为固定政策. 因此,目前还不清楚代理人是否能够积极测试其行为,判断由此产生的经验,并利用这些经验来改进未来的决定。 我们引入\ textbf{ S\ text superscript{ 3} Gym}, 一个交互式基准, 通过三种结合能力来评价 LLM 自我改进:\ textbf{ 自试},\ textbf{ 自判},和\ textbf{ 自判} 。 S$^3$Gym 将允许性探索与严格的搁置评价区分开来,并在7个文本游戏中以可执行环境验证器来即时处理这个协议. 我们评价了纳入互动经验的三种途径:直接历史的ICL、记分条件的简要记忆和参数培训。
我们的实验表明,自我改进既不是自动的也不是统一的。 上下文层面的经验改善了几个模型游戏对子的性能,但最有效的路径在很大程度上取决于任务结构:当经验可以压缩成可重复使用的战略规则时,总结是有好处的,但当成功取决于准确的,状态性的信息时,总结往往表现不佳原始历史. 参数培训在一些任务上取得了实质性成果,但也显示出不稳定的改善和对其他任务的严重负面转移。 这些调查结果表明,承认成功行动是不够的;代理人还必须将反馈转化为可执行和可转让的政策。 S$^3$Gym提供了一个统一的框架,用于诊断这一过程,并找出阻碍代理人将互动经验转化为可靠的自我改进的瓶颈.

articles.title: The First Token Is a Clue: Verbalizing Multi-Token Concepts from the J-lens
articles.content: The Jacobian Lens (J-lens) is a recent tool for interpreting LLMs. It reads a hidden state as a ranked list of vocabulary tokens, leaving multi-token concepts without a representation of their own. The original J-lens work addresses this limitation with Template Lens, which precomputes vectors for a fixed phrase vocabulary, and Oracle Lens, which fine-tunes components to propose phrases and reconstruct phrase vectors. We ask whether multi-token concepts and their vectors can instead be recovered directly from J-lens and the frozen model. We find that the first token of a multi-token concept is about as readable as a single-token concept. Given the correct first token and source prompt, the frozen model recovers the second token in 88.3% of two-token cases. We show that a vector for the complete concept can be recovered from subsequent hidden states in a single forward pass. We therefore use J-lens to propose first tokens and let the frozen model complete candidate concepts. We then recover a vector for each candidate and score it alongside the complete vocabulary. Across 496 multi-hop clozes on Gemma-3-12B-IT, Llama-3.1-8B, and Qwen3-14B, our method achieves an average $\mathrm{Rank@}10$ of 43.1%, compared with 27.6% for Template Lens. Without the J-lens clue, performance drops to 21.6%, showing that the first-token clue substantially improves readout. Causal concept swaps using the recovered vectors achieve an average $\mathrm{succ}@10$ of 61.4%, compared with 26.2% for Template Lens under the same intervention. These results show that first-token clues can guide multi-token concept recovery, while subsequent hidden states provide vectors for readout and intervention.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: "第一托肯"是一个Clue: 来自J-lens的变幻多托肯概念
articles.content_zh: Jacobian Lens(J-lens)是近期解释LLMS的工具. 它将隐藏状态读作词汇符号的排名列表,使得多托肯概念没有自己的表示. 最初的J-lens工作用模板Lens(预算一个固定短语词汇的矢量)和Oracle Lens(微调组件以提出短语并重建短语矢量)来解决这个限制. 我们问,能否直接从J-lens和冷冻模型中恢复多键概念及其矢量。 我们发现,一个多键概念的第一个标志是,与一个单键概念一样,可以读取。 鉴于第一令牌和源码的及时性,冻结的模型在88.3%的两脚箱案件中收回第二令牌. 我们显示,一个完整的概念的矢量可以在一个单一的前进通道中从后来的隐藏状态中恢复. 因此,我们利用J-Lens提出先兆,让被冻结的模型完成候选概念. 然后,我们回收每个候选人的矢量,并用完整的词汇来计分。 在Gemma-3-12B-IT、Llama-3.1-8B和Qune3-14B上,我们的方法平均达到43.1%的$\mathrm{Rank==10美元,而模版Lens为27.6%。 没有J-lens线索,性能下降至21.6%,表明第一手线索大大改善了读取. 利用回收的矢量进行因果概念互换,平均达到 $\ mathrm{succ}@10 $,为 61.4%,而同一干预下Template Lens为26.2%。 这些结果显示,第一键线索可以指导多键概念的恢复,而后续的隐藏状态为读出和干预提供了矢量.

articles.title: Token-Efficient Data Reasoning Agents via Adaptive Structuring of Unstructured Data
articles.content: Valuable data remains embedded in unstructured sources: web pages, reports, contracts, filings, earnings calls, and PDFs. The big bet in enterprise AI is deploying LLM agents that reason over this data to answer complex questions for every knowledge worker. Agents can do this today, but at prohibitive cost. Each question repeatedly opens large documents to recover scattered evidence, consuming up to a million tokens. However, if the data were already structured, the same question would reduce to a cheap database lookup. For example, on FanOutQA benchmark, reasoning over an ideal pre-structured store is 28X cheaper, and the gap grows to orders of magnitude as questions fan out over more documents. Yet structuring everything in advance is not viable: documents hold vastly more possible structure than any workload will use, and the useful structure and documents are unknown until queries arrive. We propose agentic data cracking, a method that structures unstructured data adaptively and speculatively as a byproduct of reasoning itself. Structuring is adaptive because observed queries decide when it happens and what matters, and speculative because it goes beyond the current question. Whenever the agent opens a document to answer, a cracking sub-agent forks from the already-loaded context at marginal cost and extracts grounded structure likely to serve related future queries. Over time, an increasing share of queries is fully covered by structured data and answered without opening a document, keeping agentic accuracy at close to RAG cost. On FanOutQA, extended with merely one related question per test question, cracking cuts cost by 53% while preserving accuracy. Agentic data cracking is a first step toward next-generation data infrastructure for agentic reasoning over unstructured data: a shared substrate beneath the model where knowledge that reasoning already paid to uncover accumulates.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 切换功能 通过对非结构数据进行适应性结构结构化的数据解释代理
articles.content_zh: 有价值的数据仍然嵌入不结构的来源:网页、报告、合同、档案、收入呼叫和PDF。 企业AI的大赌注是部署LLM代理商, 探员今天可以这么做 但代价太高了 每个问题反复打开大量文件以收回分散的证据,耗值高达100万令牌. 然而,如果数据已经结构化,同样的问题将减少到廉价的数据库检索。 例如,在FanOutQA基准上,对一个理想的预结构商店的推理是28X更便宜的,随着更多的文件被质疑,差距会扩大至数量级. 然而,预先安排所有文件是不可行的:文件的结构比任何工作量都可能使用,在查询到来之前,有用的结构和文件是未知的。 我们提议了代理数据破解,一种方法 结构不结构的数据 适应性和投机性 作为推理本身的副产品。 结构是适应性的,因为观察到的询问决定了何时发生和什么重要,而投机性则因为超出了当前的问题. 当代理打开一个文档回答时,一个从已经装入的上下文中以边际成本解开的子代理叉,并提取出可能服务于未来相关查询的基于结构. 随着时间推移,越来越多的查询被结构化数据充分覆盖,并在不打开文件的情况下得到答复,使代理准确性接近RAG成本. 在FanOutQA(FanOutQA)上,每个测试问题只有一个相关问题,在保持准确性的同时破解了53%的削减成本. 代理数据破解是迈向下一代数据基础设施的第一步,用于代理推理而不是非结构数据:一个共享的基底,在模型下,推理已经为发现而付出了代价。

articles.title: Learning to Evaluate Before Improving: Automatic Rubric Induction for Automatic Research Agents
articles.content: Autonomous scientific research agents are increasingly applied to end-to-end scientific workflows, including literature review, data analysis, experimentation, and report generation. However, open-ended research tasks often do not clearly specify the analyses, methods, and success criteria required to complete the task. As a result, agents may miss important analyses, use inappropriate methods, or draw conclusions that are insufficiently supported by evidence. To address the problem, we present AutoSciRub, an evaluation-first framework that induces a task-specific executable rubric before research execution, and uses it to guide execution, criterion-level verification as well as iterative revision. AutoSciRub decomposes an underspecified instruction into atomic scientific goals, grounds them in relevant literature and task-visible data, and synthesizes specific, actionable, and verifiable criteria. The resulting rubric makes implicit experimental and evidential requirements explicit, providing guidance for experiments and analyses. During revision, rubric-guided verification identifies unmet criteria and enables targeted refinement of the research report and its supporting artifacts. On ResearchClawBench, AutoSciRub consistently improves all tested configurations, with an average gain of 2.08 points across three backbone LLMs under the fixed Codex harness and 2.95 points across three agent harnesses using a fixed DeepSeek-V4-Flash backbone. On a randomly sampled 20-task subset of AstaBench E2E Discovery, AutoSciRub further achieves an average improvement of 16.8 points across three agent harnesses, while maintaining or increasing the number of successfully completed tasks. These results demonstrate that evaluation-first guidance provides an effective and generalizable control mechanism for autonomous scientific research (Code: https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoSciRub).
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 学习在改进前进行评估:自动研究代理的自动Rubric介绍
