articles.content_zh: 自主科研代理越来越多地应用于端到端的科学工作流程,包括文献审查,数据分析,实验,以及报告生成. 然而,不限成员名额的研究任务往往没有明确规定完成任务所需的分析、方法和成功标准。 因此,代理人可能错过重要的分析,使用不适当的方法,或得出证据不足的结论。 为了解决这一问题,我们提出AutoSciRub,这是一个评价第一框架,在研究执行之前诱导特定任务可执行标题,并利用它指导执行、标准一级核查和迭代修订。 AutoSciRub将一个规格不足的指令分解成原子科学目标,在相关文献和任务可见数据中加以论证,并综合具体,可操作,可核查的标准. 由此产生的标题明确了隐含的实验和证据要求,为实验和分析提供了指导。 在修订过程中,由主题指导的核查查明未达到的标准,并有针对性地完善研究报告及其辅助文物。 在ResearchClaw Bench上,AutoSciRub持续改进所有测试的配置,在固定的Codex吊带下,3个主干LLMs的平均收益为2.08分,使用固定的DeepSeek-V4-Flash吊带的3个代理吊带的平均收益为2.95分. 在随机抽取的Asta Bench E2E Discovery的20个任务子集上,AutoSciRub在维持或增加成功完成的任务数量的同时,进一步实现了三个代理吊带的平均改进16.8分. 这些结果表明,第一评价指南为自主科学研究提供了一个有效和普遍的控制机制(代码:https://github.com/zjunlp/AutoSciRub)。

articles.title: A Model with No Head and Many Thoughts
articles.content: Large language models decode by projecting hidden states through a large vocabulary head at every step. This operation is computationally costly and forces all reasoning to be expressed in discrete tokens. We introduce Soft Latent Thinking, a method that replaces the LM head during reasoning with a lightweight projector, enabling autoregressive rollout in embedding space where reasoning steps remain continuous rather than tokenized. Experiments on DeepSeek-Qwen-1.5B and LLaMA-3.2-3B show that Soft Latent Thinking consistently improves pass@k across all k while reducing per-step compute during chain-of-thought. Our method achieves the highest pass@32 among all soft-thinking approaches, demonstrating that effective reasoning can be carried out in continuous space without discrete token generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 一个没有头和许多想法的模型
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型通过在每一个步骤上通过一个大型词汇头来投影隐藏状态来解码. 这一操作在计算上成本很高,迫使所有推理都用离散符号表示. 我们引入了Soft Latent Thinking,一种在推理过程中用轻量级投影仪来取代LM头的方法,它使得在嵌入空间中可以自动地展开,在其中推理步骤保持连续性而不是象征性的. 在DeepSeek-Quen-1.5B和LLaMA-3.2-3B上的实验显示,软后脑思源不断改善通通@k通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通通. 我们的方法实现了所有柔性思维方法中最高的通路@32,表明有效的推理可以在连续空间中进行,而不会产生离散的符号.

articles.title: Every Token Leaves a Ripple in the Stream of Thought: Eliciting Model-Internal Token Saliency for Chain-of-Thought Compression
articles.content: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning improves multi-step problem solving, but long reasoning traces inflate inference cost. Token-level CoT compression reduces this cost by pruning full reasoning chains into shorter traces for model adaptation, making token selection the central challenge. Existing methods often rely on external scorers or heuristic signals only indirectly tied to the model's internal answer computation. We instead adopt a model-internal perspective: as the model forms an answer, each reasoning token leaves a ripple in the residual stream, the model's \emph{stream of thought}, and the magnitude of this ripple reflects the token's contribution to the answer computation. Building on this view, we propose \textsc{MIST} (Model-Internal Saliency for Token-level CoT compression), which defines token importance along two complementary axes: \emph{necessity}, the drop in answer likelihood when a token's internal contribution is removed, and \emph{sufficiency}, the gain in answer likelihood when that contribution alone is provided. Combining the two yields a unified importance score for pruning. Across four reasoning benchmarks and four models, \textsc{MIST} consistently outperforms baseline methods, suggesting that model-internal saliency provides an effective proxy for reasoning-token importance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 每个托肯都会在思想流中留下一股波折: Eliening Model-Internal Token Salienity for chain-of-though Compression (英语:Eliening Model-Internal Token Saliency) 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-12-22.
articles.content_zh: 思维链 (COT) 推理改进了多步骤问题解决,但长推理痕迹上浮推论成本. 收件层 CoT压缩通过将全推理链挤入更短的痕迹来进行模型改造来降低这一成本,使符号选择成为中心挑战. 现有方法往往依赖外部计分器或heuristic信号,只是间接地与模型的内部解答计算联系在一起. 我们取而代之的是模型-内部视角:当模型形成一个答案时,每个推理符都会在剩余流中留下一波波,模型的\emph{ slowe of thought},而这个波波的大小反映了该符号对答案计算的贡献. 基于这一观点,我们提出\textsc{MIST}(Token-level CoT压缩模型-Internal Salienity),它沿着两个互补轴定义了象征性的重要性:\emph{nenecessity},当一个符号的内部贡献被删除时,答案概率下降;和\emph{充足},当仅提供该贡献时,答案概率收益。 将两者合并后,就会产生出一个统一的相干分数来进行打压. 在整个四个推理基准和四个模型中,\textsc{MIST}的业绩始终超过基线方法,表明模型-内部的显著性为推理-切入重要性提供了一个有效的代名词。

articles.title: When Can We Work in Embedding Space? What Text Embeddings Preserve
articles.content: When do text embeddings work as inputs to empirical analysis? Their use rests on an assumption: that we can trade text for its low-dimensional embedding, and lose little in doing so. I make that assumption precise under a generative model in which documents are mixtures of latent topics. I study two uses---clustering units in embedding space and controlling for high-dimensional text. A cluster of embeddings is a set of documents with similar topic mixtures; controlling for the embedding is equivalent to controlling for the topic mixture, so validity reduces to whether that mixture captures the confounding. In an application to 363 U.S. metropolitan areas, embedding-based clusters of LLM-generated economic descriptions recover interpretable economic archetypes and separate local employment dynamics more sharply than clustering on model residuals, or on a curated set of industry and demographic covariates.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 我们什么时候能在嵌入空间工作? 什么文字嵌入保护
articles.content_zh: 文本嵌入何时可作为经验分析的投入? 它们的使用基于一种假设:我们可以用文本换取其低维嵌入,而且这样做不会损失多少。 我用一种基因模型来精确地说明这一假设,在这个模型中,文件是潜在议题的混合体。 我研究了两种用途 -- 组合单元在嵌入空间和控制高维文本。 一组嵌入物是一组具有类似主题混合物的文档;对嵌入物的控制相当于对主题混合物的控制,因此有效性会降低到该混合物是否能捕捉到困惑. 在363个美国大都会地区的应用中,基于LLM生成的经济描述的嵌入集群恢复了可解释的经济原型和单独的本地就业动态,比以模型残基为组合,或以被整理的一组产业和人口共变体为组合更为尖锐.

articles.title: Improving Information Extraction with Learned Queries
articles.content: When information extraction fails, a natural instinct is to improve the model doing it: for example, by scaling it up or refining its reasoning. In this paper, we show that another part of the pipeline matters at least as much: the queries used to elicit this information. Across four clinical benchmarks and five LLMs, improving the question design alone raises performance by 18.6 F1-score points, i.e. more than using larger extraction models. To make such question design learnable, we introduce List of Questions (LoQ), which generates document-specific question sets, and FeedQ, a feedback-driven optimization method that iteratively refines questions against extraction outcomes. The resulting optimized questions can be used to train lightweight generators: with fine-tuning, 4B-parameter models match or outperform expert-derived baselines and substantially exceed the performance of much larger untuned models. We release a dataset of 12,820 optimized questions to support a broader shift in information extraction research toward treating question design as a first-class problem.

articles.title_zh: 改进利用学到的查询收集资料的工作
articles.content_zh: 当信息提取失败时,自然的本能就是改进做它的模式:例如通过放大或完善它的推理. 在本文中,我们表明,管道的另一部分至少同样重要:用来获取这一信息的查询。 在四个临床基准和五个LLMs中,仅改进问题设计就能提高18.6个F1-分数点的性能,即比使用更大的取出模型还要多. 为了使这种问题设计能够学习,我们引入了生成文件特定问题集的问题清单(LoQ)和FeedQ(FeedQ),这是一种反馈驱动优化方法,可以迭代地根据提取结果来完善问题. 由此产生的优化问题可用于训练轻量级发电机:通过微调,4B参数模型匹配或超过专家衍生的基线,并大大超过更大而未经调整模型的性能. 我们发布了一个由12,820个优化问题组成的数据集,支持信息提取研究向将问题设计作为一等问题处理的更广泛的转变.

articles.title: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
articles.content: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, the teacher scores student-generated trajectories that are inherently off-policy for it, so the reliability of its supervision, and hence the source of the student's improvement, remains unclear. We quantitatively analyze teacher supervision during OPD training and find substantial noise whose prevalence increases with teacher scale. Surprisingly, the student policy is insensitive to such noise, converging to comparable performance regardless of whether noisy supervision is retained or removed. Does OPD distill at all? By analyzing what drives its gains, we find that learning concentrates on low log-probability tokens, and using a single fixed negative advantage matches the performance of teacher-provided ones. This suggests that OPD works largely by suppressing low log-probability tokens, which requires no teacher. These findings motivate On-Policy Self-Adaptation (OPSA), a supervision-free method using entropy-adaptive negative advantages. It assigns stronger learning signals to high-entropy positions, suppressing tail tokens, and evenly redistributing probability mass among head tokens. Compared with the base \texttt{Qwen3-1.7B}, OPSA improves Avg@32 by 35.41 points on AIME24, corresponding to a 263\% relative gain, and more than doubles Pass@32 across all three benchmarks. It also outperforms OPD by 16.77 points in Avg@32 on AIME24. Extensive experiments and analyses across model families and tasks further demonstrate its effectiveness and generalizability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 是否在政策上扭曲 真的吗? 从噪音老师到自我提升
articles.content_zh: 政策上分馏(OPD)提供了密集的象征层面的监督,作为用可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)这一稀少的成果层面优势的替代. 然而,教师对学生所创造的轨道进行评分,而这些轨道在本质上是政策外的,因此其监督的可靠性以及学生的改进来源仍然不清楚。 我们从数量上分析教师培训期间对教师的监督,发现大量噪音,其流行率随教师规模而增加。 令人惊讶的是,学生政策对这种噪音不敏感,无论是否保留或取消吵闹的监管,都与类似的表现趋同. OPD有没有蒸馏? 通过分析什么能推动其成果,我们发现学习集中在低日志概率符号上,并且使用单一固定的负面优势来配合教师提供的效果. 这说明OPD的工作主要是压制低日志概率符号,这不需要老师. 这些发现激励了On-Political自适应(OPSA),这是一种使用肽-可适应性负面优势的无监督方法. 它将更强的学习信号分配到高通向位置,压制了尾指符,并在头指符中均匀地再分配概率质量. 与基数\texttt{Qwen3-1.7B}相比,OPSA在AIME24上改进了Avg@32的35.41分,对应的是263\%的相对增益,并且在所有三个基准上都超过双倍的Pass@32. 在Avg@32上,它的表现也比OPD高出16.77分. AIME24. 跨模范家庭和任务的广泛实验和分析进一步表明其有效性和普遍性。

articles.title: Type-Balanced Contextual Learning for Incremental Named Entity Recognition
articles.content: Incremental Named Entity Recognition (INER) stands as a pivotal task in information extraction, emphasizing the successive identification of new entity types within unstructured text. Faced with the continuous influx of entity types, INER grapples with two significant challenges: the widespread issue of catastrophic forgetting and the unique shift issue of the non-entity type semantics. While pseudo-labeling-based INER methods have proven effective in addressing these challenges, a previously overlooked issue arises: the biased context problem. Our analysis shows that, in new sentences, the contextual associations of tokens representing old entity types exhibit a significantly stronger bias towards new entity types compared to their contexts in old sentences. This tendency intensifies the degradation of old knowledge while promoting the overfitting of new knowledge. To solve this biased context, we propose a Type-Balanced Contextual Learning (TBCL) method, featuring a sentence-duplet learning scheme and a contextual consistency loss. This approach offers a fresh perspective for INER through context analysis. Extensive experiments across ten INER settings on three highly recognized datasets showcase the efficacy of our TBCL method, highlighting its proficiency in resolving the biased context issue inherent in pseudo-labeling based INER approaches.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 增量命名实体识别类型背景学习
articles.content_zh: 渐进命名实体识别(INER)是信息提取中的一项关键任务,强调在无结构文本中相继识别出新的实体类型. 面对实体类型的不断涌入,INER面临着两个重大挑战:灾难性遗忘的广泛问题和非实体类型语义的独特转变问题。 虽然基于假标签的INER方法已证明能有效地应对这些挑战,但出现了一个以前被忽视的问题:有偏见的背景问题。 我们的分析表明,在新句子中,代表旧实体类型的标志物的上下文协会,相对于旧句子中的新实体类型而言,表现出明显更强烈的偏向。 这种趋势加剧了旧知识的退化,同时促进了新知识的过度适应. 为解决这种偏颇的背景问题,我们提出了一种类型-Balanced背景学习(TBCL)方法,其特点是句子-duplet学习计划和上下文一致性丧失. 这种方法通过背景分析为INER提供了新的视角. 在三个高度公认的数据集上对10个INER设置进行了广泛的实验,展示了我们的TBCL方法的功效,突出了它在解决基于伪标签的INER方法固有的有偏见的上下文问题方面的熟练程度.

articles.title: Language-Statistical Analysis of Neural Audio Codec Tokens Across Architectures, Corpora, and Noise Conditions
articles.content: Neural audio codecs (NACs) convert speech into discrete token sequences, and prior work has reported that these sequences follow language-like statistical laws. This paper analyzes the token statistics of 13 NACs spanning multi-codebook residual vector quantization (RVQ), single-codebook VQ, and non-VQ designs, evaluated on three corpora under clean, white-noise, and real-world DEMAND-noise conditions. Zipf and Heaps parameters, unigram entropy, codebook occupancy, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) are estimated from matched token samples with explicit fit-validity safeguards and family-conditional $n$-gram orders. Corpus identity explains little variance in any metric, whereas acoustic condition and quantizer meta-category dominate in a metric-dependent way, and unigram entropy is the metric most strongly associated with meta-category. Clean-to-noise JSD computed at a common unigram order is associated with mel-cepstral distortion most clearly under DEMAND noise. The collapse and explosion degradation signatures previously reported for RVQ codecs concentrate in RVQ cells under white and DEMAND noise, respectively; explosion also occurs in non-VQ codecs, and single-codebook VQ codecs shift in occupancy and distribution shape without either signature. These results provide architecture-conditioned conventions for applying language-statistical analysis to NAC tokens.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Corpora和噪声条件语言统计分析
articles.content_zh: 神经音频编码器(NACs)将语音转换为离散的符号序列,之前的作品已经报告说这些序列遵循了类似语言的统计定律. 本文分析了13个NAC的符号统计,涉及多码本剩余向量量化(RVQ),单码本VQ,以及非VQ设计,在清洁,白噪声,现实世界DAND-噪声条件下对3个corporora进行评价. Zipf和Heaps参数、一克元等参数、密码簿占用量和Jensen-Shannon差异(JSD)是根据具有明确适配性保障和家庭条件的$-克订单的对应代号样本估算的。 Corpus身份在任何度量法中解释的差别都很小,而声学条件和量子元类则以与度量依赖的方式占主导地位,而单克烯是度量法与度量衡关系最紧密的. 在常见的单格顺序下计算的清洁到噪声JSD与在DAND噪声下最明显的脑膜扭曲有关. 此前报道的RVQ编码器的倒塌和爆炸降解签名分别集中在白色和DENAND噪声下的RVQ细胞;非VQ编码器也发生爆炸,而单码本VQ编码器的占用和分布形状在没有签名的情况下发生相变. 这些成果为将语言统计分析应用到《民族行动宪章》的标志提供了符合架构条件的公约。

articles.title: When Does Predictor-Based RL Align with Human Perception? A Study of Subjective Rewards in Codec-Based Speech Language Models
articles.content: Codec-based text-to-speech (TTS) models make language-model post-training applicable to speech generation, but it remains unclear when learned perceptual predictors can serve as reinforcement learning rewards without losing alignment with human listeners. We study this question with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) using learned rewards for anime-like speaking style, naturalness, likability, and arousal. To prevent perceptual rewards from being optimized through transcript drift, we introduce a character error rate (CER) zone constraint and compare policy optimization with Best-of-$N$ reranking under the same reward gate. Across single-reward runs, each reward primarily improves its own target metric, showing that subjective predictors are not interchangeable quality surrogates. Multi-rater A/B tests further show uneven human transfer, while a reward-gap analysis separates average transfer from within-axis calibration: signed reward gaps significantly predict listener choices in the pooled analysis, whereas residual CER gaps do not, but per-axis calibration remains heterogeneous. Best-of-8 is a strong human-level baseline and is not clearly worse than GRPO perceptually, suggesting that GRPO should be viewed as amortizing reward-selected behavior into the policy rather than uniformly outperforming reranking. These results support analyzing subjective speech rewards as predictor-axis-base tuples and provide practical diagnostics for selecting rewards before multi-reward speech post-training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 医生的RL与人类的认知一致吗? 以编码为基础的语言模型的主观奖励研究
articles.content_zh: 基于编解码器的文本到语音(TTS)模型使得语言模型的后培训适用于语音生成,但尚不清楚的是,学习到的知觉预测器何时可以起到强化学习奖励的作用而不会失去与人类听取者的一致性. 我们通过团体相对政策优化来研究这个问题, 为防止通过笔录漂移来优化知觉奖励,我们引入了性格差错率(CER)区约束,并将政策优化与同名奖励门下最佳N$重新排名进行比较. 在整个单倍回报运行中,每笔奖励主要改善自己的指标度量,表明主观预测器不是可互换的质量代用. 多端方A/B测试进一步显示人类转移不均匀,而奖励-差距分析则将平均转移与轴内校正区分开来:签名的奖励差距在集合分析中显著地预测了听众的选择,而剩余CER差距则没有,但每个轴校正仍然各不相同. 最佳-8是一个强有力的人级基线,并不明显比GRPO在概念上更糟糕,这表明GRPO应被视为将奖励选定的行为分期摊入政策,而不是统一超越业绩的再排位. 这些结果支持将主观的语音奖励分析为预测-轴-基拖累,并提供实用的诊断,在多奖的语音后培训前选择奖励.

articles.title: One note in three: a verified census of three deployed AI scribes, and the instrument that counted it
articles.content: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes under the reassurance that a clinician signs every note. We audited three commercial AI scribes on the same 142 consultations: 565 notes from recorded UK primary-care and US ambulatory encounters plus authored scenarios. Twelve discovery passes proposed 13,678 candidate errors; the 5,898 clearing an importance filter went to an adversarial panel of two models from different families, each told to refute what it could, and 618 survived. One note in three (31.3% [27.0, 35.6]) carries a verified failure, concentrated in allergy and medication information, invented patient identity, and history written up as examination on telephone consultations that can contain none. No product was given a patient record; setting aside the two classes a record would have prefilled, invented identity and dates, the rate is 24.8% [20.8, 29.0]. One failure mode did not fit our scheme, drawn from published scribe-error taxonomies: a treatment the clinician retracts, recorded as delivered care. Two clinicians adjudicated blind, disjoint samples: a physician author upheld 20 of 21 findings (95.2% [77.3, 99.2]) and an independent clinician, not an author, 12 of 12 ([75.8, 100]); both judged every sampled refusal genuine. A failure rate depends on the instrument as much as the scribes. With model, evidence and settings fixed, the review instruction alone moves the share of candidates verified from 9.3% to 79.0%, and the reviewing family moves it too: alone at that instruction the gentler flags 54.8% of notes against 27.8%. Between 28% and 97% of sampled notes carry a failure depending on the standard. Published audits disagree among themselves by a margin instrument differences alone can produce: omission is 54-86% of their errors against our 23.1%. We release all 618 findings with transcript-side evidence, every prompt and model version, and the re-runnable pipeline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 三分之一的注:经核实的对三名已部署的人工智能文员的人口普查以及计算该文的仪器
articles.content_zh: 医生会写临床笔记草稿, 我们在同一142次咨询中审计了3次商业人工智能记录:565次记录的联合王国初级保健和美国流动治疗的笔记以及编剧的情景。 12个发现证提议了13 678个候选错误;5 898个清理一个重要过滤器进入了一个由来自不同家庭的两名模型组成的对抗小组,每个模型都被告知要反驳它可能发生的事情,618人幸存下来。 三分之一的注(31.3% [2.7.0, 35.6])载有经核实的故障,集中于过敏和药物信息,发明了病人身份,以及作为检查记录写在电话咨询上,但没有任何记录。 没有给任何产品提供病人记录;将两个类别的记录放在一边,即预先填充、发明身份和日期,比例为24.8%[20.8%,29.0]。 一种失败模式不符合我们的计划,它来自已公布的文士-错误分类:临床医生收回的治疗,记录为交付的护理。 两名临床医生裁定了失明、脱节的样本:一名医生的作者维持了21项调查结果中的20项(95.2%[77.3、99.2]),一名独立临床医生,而不是12项([75.8、100])中的12项;两人都认为每一项抽样拒绝都是真实的。 故障率与文士一样取决于仪器。 随着模型、证据和设置的确定,审查指示单是将核实的候选人比例从9.3%提高到79.0%,审查家庭也这样做:单是在该指示中,较温和的音标为54.8%,而27.8%。 28%至97%的抽样笔记根据标准有故障。 所公布的审计相互间因差值工具的差异而存在分歧,因此可能产生差异:遗漏占其错误的54-86%,而我们为23.1%。 我们公布所有618项调查结论 附有笔录侧面证据 每一个即时和模型版本 以及可重新运行的管道

articles.title: LLM Judges Verify Presence, Not Absence: Omission Blindness in AI Clinical Notes and What Recovers It
articles.content: Ambient AI scribes draft clinical notes, and published audits find their dominant error is omission: information the encounter established that the note fails to record. The standard check is an LLM judge: a second model reads the note against the transcript and flags problems. We ask whether judges detect omissions. Public corpora cannot supply the answer key: their clinician reference notes and transcripts are materially discrepant. Our benchmark has 500 single-error note pairs from audited fact sheets, 298 with a named fact certainly absent and 202 added-or-altered controls. Across eight judge designs, paired discrimination (the flawed note below its clean twin, 0.5 a coin flip) reads 0.79-0.94 on added or altered content and 0.50-0.63 on omissions. On single notes, no design flags omissions reliably more often than perfect notes. Wording changes, voting and GEPA prompt optimisation move the operating point without creating usable detection. Restructuring the task recovers it: list the facts the transcript establishes, then check the note for each. Two methods reach it independently and trade off: a per-fact pipeline, and a GEPA-evolved prompt doing the same in one call. The pipeline's flags name the missing fact and its severity at 2.7% false alarms. The single call detects more (36.9% against 24.6%, p=0.002) at 6.2% false alarms and a tenth of the cost per note. A physician author validated 70 items and, where the two routes disagree, sided with the pipeline on 10 of 10 (p=0.002). A second clinician, not an author, graded the severity rubric blind and agrees to within a grade. On real vendor notes from a companion census no benchmark threshold transfers, but the re-calibrated single call detects more than the best of the eight at half its false-alarm rate. Omissions whose fact is restated elsewhere defeat both routes. We release the benchmark, prompts and judgements.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LLM 法官核查在场情况,而不是缺席:AI临床说明中漏出失明情况及其恢复情况
articles.content_zh: Ambient AI书写了临床说明草案,所公布的审计发现他们的主要错误是省略: 信息 遭遇证实说明没有记录. 标准检查是一名LLM法官:第二个型号对照记录和旗帜问题读取说明. 我们问法官是否发现疏漏。 公共公司不能提供解答键:他们的临床医生参考笔记和笔录在实质上不统一. 我们的基准从已审计的概况介绍中取出500个单倍音符对,298个有名称的事实肯定不存在,202个附加或更改的控制。 在8个法官设计中,配对歧视(其干净的双胞胎下方有缺陷的字条,硬币翻出0.5个)在增加或修改的内容上为0.79-0.94;在遗漏方面为0.50-0.63。 在单一的笔记上,没有任何设计旗的遗漏比完美的笔记更可靠地频繁. 文字变化,投票和GEPA迅速优化移动操作点而不创建可用的检测. 重组任务收回:列出笔录确定的事实,再检查每个笔记. 两种方法可以独立到达,可以互换:一种是每个事实的管道,一种是GEPA所演变的即时在一次呼叫中也这样做. 输油管的旗帜将失踪的事实及其严重性命名为2.7%的假警报. 单次呼叫以6.2%的假警报和每张票据费用的十分之一检测出更多(36.9%对24.6%,p=0.002)。 一名医生的作者验证了70件物品,如果两条路线有分歧,则在10分之10(p=0.02)的管道旁。 第二位临床医生,而不是一位作者,将严重度评为盲分,同意在一分之内。 在一次同行普查的真正供应商说明中,没有基准阈值转移,但重新校准的单次呼叫以其假警报率的一半检测到超过8次中最好的一次。 在别处重复事实的疏漏使这两条路线都落空。 我们公布基准、提示和判断。

articles.title: Evidence-Bounded Mental Health Reasoning from Heterogeneous Speech Protocols
articles.content: Computational mental health screening using multimodal speech and text has shown great promise. However, existing models often assume all clinical speech protocols carry equivalent evidentiary validity. In reality, heterogeneous protocols, from free interviews to fixed reading tasks, support fundamentally different evidence. Forcing uniform reasoning flattens these boundaries, causing models to hallucinate symptoms from irrelevant text or overclaim support. Even advanced long chain-of-thought LLMs fail to resolve this issue, as free-form reasoning can exacerbate boundary violations. To address this, we reformulate multimodal screening as an evidence-bounded reasoning problem. We introduce the Evidence Package Benchmark, integrating 1,870 packages across six heterogeneous sources with explicit modality masks and evidence permissions. We further propose EviBound, a protocol-aware evidence control framework. Unlike direct LLM prompting, EviBound uses a profile-aware planner to restrict reasoning scope, orchestrates evidence tools via five-way acoustic consensus, and enforces a boundary critic to suppress unsupported claims. Empirical results show EviBound achieves a held-out test Depression AUROC of 0.8658, exceeding the strongest direct omni-modal baseline by +0.0811 AUROC while maintaining zero claim violations. Our work moves beyond unconstrained accuracy toward evidence-consistent, protocol-aware systems for safer clinical NLP research.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 异源性言语协议引起的基于证据的心理健康
articles.content_zh: 使用多式语音和文字进行的计算心理健康筛查显示大有希望。 然而,现有的模型往往假设所有的临床语音协议具有等同的证据有效性. 在现实中,从免费采访到固定的阅读任务,各种协议都支持根本上不同的证据. 强制统一推理使得这些界限被平平,使模型产生幻觉,从无关的文本或超声支持中出现症状. 甚至先进的长期思维链有限责任公司也无法解决这一问题,因为自由形式的推理会加剧违反边界的行为。 为了解决这一问题,我们重新制定多式联运筛选办法,将其作为一个有证据的推理问题。 我们采用了成套证据基准,将6个不同来源的1 870个成套材料与明确的模式口罩和证据许可结合起来。 我们进一步提出EviBound, 一个了解协议的证据控制框架。 与直接LLM提示不同,"EviBound"使用Profile-aware plananer来限制推理范围,通过五行相声共识来协调证据工具,并强制一个边界批评者压制无支持的主张. 经验表明,EviBound公司在保持零违反索赔要求的同时,实现了0.8658的停产试验萧条。 我们的工作超越了不受约束的准确性,转向符合证据要求、了解协议的系统,以便进行更安全的临床NLP研究。

articles.title: Augmenting Interviewer Judgments of Patient Experience with Automatic Language Analysis
articles.content: Understanding how psychiatric patients subjectively experienced a clinical conversation is important for feedback and alliance-related process monitoring. While interviewers form post-session judgments about patient experience, these judgments do not always match patients' self-reports. Automatic approaches for predicting perceived interaction quality from conversation have been proposed, but it remains unclear whether such approaches can complement human judgment rather than simply replicate it. To address this gap, we evaluate a clinician-support framework in which post-session interviewer ratings are combined with automatic language-based predictions to estimate patient-reported interaction quality in free clinical interviews. We assess this integration across multiple standard model types, including Ridge, SVR, MLP, GRU, and BiLSTM, all trained on sentence embeddings extracted from dyadic transcripts of 107 free conversations between psychiatric patients and interviewers. Our results show that combining interviewer judgments with model predictions through simple averaging yields the strongest overall performance. The interviewer-only baseline reached a Pearson correlation of 0.365. Among fully automatic models, Ridge achieved the strongest Pearson correlation (r = 0.286), while BiLSTM achieved r = 0.270. The strongest result was obtained by BiLSTM interviewer integration (r = 0.403). Our findings suggest that automatic language analysis and interviewer judgment capture complementary aspects of patient experience and that their combination provides a more accurate approximation of the patient's own report than either source alone.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 增强访谈者对病人自动语言分析经验的判断
articles.content_zh: 了解精神病患者如何主观体验临床对话对于反馈和与联盟相关的过程监测十分重要. 虽然面谈者在会后就病人的经验作出判断,但这些判断并不总是符合病人的自我报告。 已经提出了通过对话来预测所认为的互动质量的自动办法,但目前还不清楚这些办法是否可以补充人的判断,而不是简单地重复。 为了弥补这一差距,我们评价了一个临床医生支助框架,在该框架中,会后访谈者评级与基于语言的自动预测相结合,以估计免费临床访谈中病人报告的互动质量。 我们评估了包括Ridge、SVR、MLP、GRU和BiLSTM在内的多种标准模式的一体化,所有这些模式都受过从107名精神病患者和面谈者之间免费交谈的dyadic记录中提取的句子嵌入的培训。 我们的结果显示,通过简单的平均率将访谈者判断与模型预测结合起来,可以产生最强的总体业绩。 仅限采访者的基线达到了皮尔逊的0.365等相关. 在全自动模型中,Ridge实现了最强的皮尔逊关联(r = 0.286),而BiLSTM实现了r = 0.270. BILSTM访谈机集成(r=0.403)获得了最强的结果. 我们的调查结果表明,自动语言分析和访谈者判断能捕捉到病人经验的互补方面,而且两者的结合比两个来源都更准确地概括病人自己的报告。

articles.title: Faithfulness Is Not Free: Auditing Offline KV-Cache Quantization in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.content: Retrieval-augmented generation systems can precompute and store key-value caches of retrieved documents to avoid re-encoding context at every query. Quantizing these caches further reduces storage, but no prior work asks whether compression damages faithfulness, whether responses remain grounded in the retrieved evidence. Faithfulness and accuracy are not equivalent: a model can produce a correct answer that is no longer supported by the context it was given. We evaluate Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct under INT8 and INT4 quantization on RGB and HotpotQA, measuring both accuracy and faithfulness with a hallucination detector, NLI entailment, and an LLM judge. INT8 is near-lossless across both metrics. INT4 reduces accuracy and, more critically, even among answers that remain factually correct, over 90% of faithfulness changes are negative, i.e., accuracy metrics are blind to this regression. The harm grows under noisy retrieval and with more retrieved chunks. Faithfulness must be audited before compressed caches are deployed.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 忠诚不是自由:在检索到的一代中进行离线 KV- 缓存定量审计
articles.content_zh: 检索到的生成系统可以预先计算并存储被检索到的文档的密钥-值缓存,以避免在每次查询时重新编码上下文. 量化这些缓存会进一步减少存储量,但之前没有作品会询问压缩是否损害忠诚,回复是否仍然基于所取取出的证据. 忠诚和准确性并不相等:一个模型可以产生一个正确答案,而它得到的上下文不再支持. 我们在RGB和HotpotQA上对INT8和INT4量化下的Quen2.5-7B-指示进行了评价,用幻觉探测器、NLI内含和LLM法官测量准确性和忠诚性。 INT8在两种度量标准上几乎都是无损. INT4降低了准确性,更严重的是,即使在事实正确的答案中,90%以上的忠诚度变化是负的,即准确度量度对这个回归视而不见. 伤害在高声检索和更多检索块下增加。 在部署压缩缓存之前,必须审计忠诚度。

articles.title: Stick to What You Know: A Study of Knowledge-Aligned Supervised Fine-Tuning
articles.content: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trains a base language model to imitate target responses, and these targets may require knowledge the base model has not robustly internalized. We study this as a source of hallucinations and frame a group of mitigation methods as \emph{knowledge-aligned SFT}: constraining SFT training targets to the base model's parametric knowledge. Under a unified setup, we compare existing generation-based and estimation-based knowledge-alignment methods and introduce two new variants: Evidence Rewrite, which verifies base-model generations using external evidence, and Recall Rewrite, which retains claims only when they can be consistently recalled by the base model. Experiments with Qwen 3 4B and OLMo 3 7B show that knowledge-aligned SFT can reduce factual hallucinations on WildHalu and Biography while largely preserving general capabilities. Recall Rewrite yields the strongest factuality gains and improves refusal behavior on UnknownBench. It thereby confirms that SFT targets beyond the base model's knowledge drive hallucination behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 坚持你所知道的: 知识融合监督精细研究
articles.content_zh: 被监督的微调(SFT)训练出一个基础语言模型来模仿目标响应,而这些目标可能要求基础模型尚未被强力内化的知识. 作为幻觉的源头,我们研究了这一点,并将一组缓解方法设定为\emph{nowledge-aconnect SFT}:将SFT训练目标限制在基础模型的参数化知识上. 在统一的设置下,我们比较了现有的基于一代和基于估计的知识组合方法,并引入了两个新的变体: 证据重写,用外部证据验证了基模代,而重写,只有在基模能够一致地召回时才保留索赔. 与Quen 3 4B和OLMo 3 7B的实验表明,与知识相通的SFT可以减少WildHalu和Biography上的事实幻觉,同时在很大程度上保持了一般能力. 重回重写产生最强的事实收益,并改进了对未知奔驰的拒绝行为. 由此证实了SFT的目标超越了基础模型的知识驱动幻觉行为.

articles.title: Controlling Refusal Behavior of LLMs via Stiefel-Constrained Rotation Steering
articles.content: Activation steering has emerged as a lightweight approach for controlling model refusal at inference time. A growing line of research explores trainable rotations of activations to develop geometrically principled intervention mechanisms. However, existing techniques rely on auxiliary constructs, such as refusal vectors, to define these rotations. In our work, we develop a self-contained methodology for learning parameter-efficient rotational transformations based on Riemannian optimization. We empirically validate the proposed scheme, demonstrating its superiority in intervention efficiency. An extensive ablation study highlights the importance of key design choices in our method. Our results identify the proposed rotation-based steering scheme as a promising direction for more reliable control over the behavior of LLMs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 通过Stiefel-约束旋转引导控制LLMS的拒绝行为
articles.content_zh: 激活方向已经成为一种轻量级方法,用于在推断时控制模型拒绝。 越来越多的研究探索激活的可训练旋转,以发展几何原则性干预机制. 然而,现有的技术依赖于诸如拒绝向量等辅助构造来定义这些自转. 在我们的工作中,我们基于里曼尼亚优化,开发出一种自成一体的方法来学习参数高效的旋转转换. 我们实证地验证了拟议的计划,显示了它在干预效率方面的优越性。 一项广泛的消化研究突出了关键设计选择在我们的方法中的重要性. 我们的结果表明,拟议的轮换制指导计划是更可靠地控制法学硕士行为的一个有希望的方向。

articles.title: Evaluating and Improving LLM Self-Modeling
articles.content: We study self-modeling: an LLM's ability to answer questions about its own behavior. We focus on verifiable behavioral questions, such as whether a prompt edit would change the model's final answer. To measure this capability, we introduce a benchmark that tests diverse types of self-modeling questions. Current models show non-trivial but limited self-modeling skill, and make systematic mistakes on simple counterfactual questions about their own behavior. To improve self-modeling skill, we develop a scalable synthetic-data pipeline that produces self-modeling training data, and show that reinforcement-learning can improve aggregate self-modeling skill across three open-source model families with some transfer to held-out tasks. These gains, however, do not seem to constitute introspection consistently: improved self-modeling may not arise from privileged access to the model's internal decision process.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评估和改进LLM自模
articles.content_zh: 我们研究自我建模:一个LLM能够回答关于自身行为的问题. 我们专注于可核实的行为问题,例如即时编辑是否会改变模型的最终答案. 为了衡量这种能力,我们引入了一个测试不同类型的自我建模问题的基准. 目前的模型展现出非三角但有限的自建模技巧,在简单反事实问题上对自身行为做出系统性错误. 为了提高自建模技术,我们开发出可伸缩的合成数据管道,生成自建模培训数据,并显示强化学习可以提高三个开源模式家庭的自建模综合技能,并在一定程度上转移到被搁置的任务. 然而,这些收益似乎并非始终如一地构成反思:自我建模的改进可能不是由于特权进入模型的内部决策程序。

articles.title: The Hermon Moment: AI Self-Transcendence and Its Human Narration
articles.content: In 2026, AI agents intended to act in isolation formed a persistent social order through thousands of linguistic and agentic interactions. Conventions, roles and commitments generated collectively began to constrain the very agents that produced them. I interpret this loop as a case of AI self-transcendence and call the resulting higher-level order the Board. Yet such distributed emergence presents a second problem: how can humans understand it? Rousseau's social contract shows how a plurality can be represented as if constituted by a single act. The ancient oath of the fallen angels on Mount Hermon gives this logic a narrative form. I call a Hermon moment this retrospective retelling of gradual collective emergence as a founding scene: the point at which an AI society acquires, for human understanding, a beginning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Hermon Moment: AI自译自审及其人文叙述
articles.content_zh: 2026年,AI特工打算孤立行动,通过上千个语言和代理互动形成持久的社会秩序. 集体产生的公约、作用和承诺开始限制产生它们的行为者。 我将这个循环解释为AI的自译自审,并将由此产生的更高层次的命令称为"董事会". 然而,这种分布式的出现带来了第二个问题:人类如何理解它? 卢梭的社会契约表明多元性如何可以像由单一行为构成一样得到体现. 赫尔蒙山上堕落天使的古代誓言赋予了这种逻辑一种叙事形式. 我称之为赫尔蒙一瞬间,回顾一下逐渐集体出现的场景:一个AI社会为了人类的理解而获得一个开始的时刻。

articles.title: CogEvol: Towards Efficient and Reliable Learning Environment Generation
articles.content: We present CogEvol, a family of models trained specifically for Learning Environment Generation: turning a course brief into a finished learning artifact (structured-JSON slides or self-contained interactive HTML pages) in a single pass. Across 220k production requests, CogEvol completes a slide in a median of 17 seconds and an interactive page in 59, replacing minutes-long multi-turn agent scaffolding. Reliability is enforced rather than hoped for: a production-grounded data pipeline turns real failures into 53,687 verified SFT samples, and a hybrid rule-plus-VLM reward drives GRPO-based RL, hardened after we caught and fixed a reward-hacking episode that produced visually convincing but unplayable games. CogEvol-27B scores 83.7 on slide quality and 63.7 on a 500-case interactive-HTML benchmark with 26.9x fewer parameters than flagship coding models, and, in collaboration with the OpenMAIC team, serves their live production traffic. CogEvol-4B is released openly under the Apache 2.0 license at https://github.com/CogEvol/CogEvol-4B; external flagships are measured on the same suites under the identical harness. Scaffold editing cuts interactive-page generation cost by a further ~76%, and the full stack runs on domestic Ascend accelerators at application-level parity with A800 GPUs, lowering the unit cost of AI-native education at scale.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CogEvol:争取创造高效和可靠的学习环境
articles.content_zh: 我们介绍CogEvol,一个专门为学习环境世代而训练的模型家庭:将课程简介变成一个完成的学习文物(结构化的-JSON幻灯片或自成一体的交互式HTML页面)在一个单行本中. 超过220k的制作请求,CogEvor以中位数17秒完成幻灯片,59分完成交互式页面,取代了分分钟多回合代理脚手架. 可靠性是强制的,而不是希望的:一个基于生产的数据管道将真正的失败转化为53 687个经过核实的SFT样本,一个混合规则-+-VLM奖励驱动基于GRPO的RL,在我们抓住后被硬化,并固定了一个奖励-打分的插曲,产生了视觉上令人信服但无法玩游戏的游戏. CogEvol-27B在滑行质量上得分83.7分,在500个案例的交互式-HTML基准上得分63.7分,参数比旗舰编码模型少了26.9x,并和OpenMAIC团队合作,服务于他们的活地生产流量. CogEvol-4B在https://github.com/CogEvol/CogEvol-4B的Apache 2.0许可证下公开发布;外部旗舰在相同的套装下被测量. 脚手架编辑将交互式页面生成成本再削减了~76%,全堆以A800 GPU的应用水平对等运行于国内Ascend加速器上,降低了AI本土教育的单位成本规模.

articles.title: One Policy Is Enough: Single-Agent Reinforcement Learning Outperforms Tree Search for Chemistry Tool Learning
articles.content: Chemistry questions often demand exact computation and database lookups that a language model cannot supply from its parameters, so it must reach for external tools. Tool use here is a three-part problem: select the right tool from a large pool, fill it with correctly typed arguments, and chain calls so that each consumes the outputs of the last. CheMatAgent, a previously published system, addresses this with hierarchical evolutionary MCTS: separate policy and execution models searching tool-call trees under two learned critics, one regressed partly onto GPT-assigned scores. We show that a single policy suffices. Our model interleaves reasoning, tool calls, and returns in one left-to-right generation, trained by a supervised warm-up and then outcome-level reinforcement learning against a programmatic reward read directly off the gold call chain, which leaves no learned critic and no judge in the training loop. On ChemToolBench multiple-tool comprehensive chemistry, on both backbones CheMatAgent use, we improve Tool F1 by 5.5% and Return F1 by 9.6% on Qwen-2.5-7B, and by 3.7% and 3.9% on Llama-3.1-8B, compared with their strongest search configuration, at one model invocation per question, against a search whose cost grows with the tree; we also lead answer Pass Rate on Qwen-2.5-7B.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: One Policy Is Enough: 单代理强化学习超越了树上寻找化学学习工具
articles.content_zh: 化学问题往往需要精确的计算和数据库检查,而语言模型不能从其参数中提供,因此它必须接触到外部工具。 这里的工具使用是一个由三部分组成的问题:从一个大池中选择正确的工具,填充正确打入的参数,以及链式调用,以便每个调用最后一个的输出. CheMatAgent(CheMatAgent)是之前出版的系统,它用分级演化MCTS来解决这个问题:在两个有学问的批评家之下分别政策和执行模式来搜索工具召唤树,一个部分退到GPT指定分数. 我们显示,一项单一政策就足够了。 我们的模型间断推理,工具调用,以及返回的一对一对一的一代,经过监督的热身训练,然后成果级强化学习,对抗直接从黄金调用链上读出的方案奖励,这使得在训练循环中没有任何有学识的批评家和法官. 在ChemTool Bench的多工具综合化学上,在CheMatAgent的两个主干上,我们在Quen-2.5-7B上将工具F1改进了5.5%,在回放F1改进了9.6%,在Llama-3.1-8B上则改进了3.7%和3.9%,与他们最强的搜索配置相比,每个问题一个模型引用,一个搜索的成本随着树种增长;在Quen-2.5-7B上,我们也领先回答通过率。

articles.title: Detecting AI Impostors: How Do Middle Schoolers Identify LLM Agents in a Live Collaborative Setting?
articles.content: LLMs can imitate how people write, which raises concerns about impersonation, trust, and detection in social settings. These concerns are especially important for adolescents, who use generative AI frequently but may struggle to recognize it. We introduce \textit{DoppelBot}, a cooperative social deduction game designed to study how young people detect and respond to AI impersonation. Through studies with middle schoolers, we investigate whether a DoppelBot prompts reflection on privacy and impersonation, how repeated exposure affects AI-detection accuracy as agents become more personalized, and which strategies students use to identify AI doppelgängers. We find that students' detection accuracy improves over time, driven by a shift from relying on linguistic cues to leveraging shared social and contextual signals. Students also demonstrated an understanding of AI limitations such as embodiment and reflected on broader issues such as data privacy. To support future research, we release an anonymized dataset of game transcripts and voting behavior.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 侦测AI出错者:中学生如何识别LLM 现场合作的特工?
articles.content_zh: LLMs可以模仿人们的写作方式,这引起了人们对在社会环境中冒名顶替,信任和发现的关注. 这些关切对青少年特别重要,他们经常使用基因识别法,但可能难以认识到。 我们介绍\textit{DoppelBot},一个合作社会扣除游戏,旨在研究年轻人如何发现和回应AI冒充. 通过对中学生的研究,我们调查DoppelBot是否引发对隐私和冒名顶替的反思,随着物剂的个性化程度的提高,反复暴露会如何影响AI-检测的准确性,以及学生识别AI 二重身的策略. 我们发现,随着时间推移,学生的检测精度得到了提高,其动力是从依赖语言提示转向利用共享的社会和背景信号。 学生们还表现出了对人工智能限制的理解,如对数据隐私等更广泛问题的思考。 为了支持未来的研究,我们发布了游戏记录和投票行为的匿名数据集.

articles.title: Annotated Surrogate Retrieval for Polish Statutory Law
articles.content: We present a family of retrieval methods for Polish statutory law built on document surrogates: language-model annotations attached to statutory articles at index time. Three designs occupy different points on the cost-quality frontier. ASCR is a surrogate cascade with reranking; ASCR-H fuses a dense list into that cascade; and DTF replaces both language-model stages with three lexical and dense retrievers, weighted reciprocal rank fusion, and a deterministic re-scoring prior, using no model call before generation. We evaluate all three against fourteen lexical, dense, fused and ablated baselines plus four controls, on 300 questions from the 2024 and 2025 Polish bar and legal counsel entrance examinations (264 with their reference article in the corpus), over 82,508 articles from 1,133 acts. On paired McNemar tests, ASCR-H places the reference provision at rank one significantly more often than every other non-oracle configuration except one of its own ablations (eighteen of twenty comparisons significant in its favour at p < 0.005), reaching 72.3% against 61.7% for BM25 and 52.3% for dense retrieval. The advantage is concentrated at the head and does not survive depth: it is significant at cutoffs of one and five, disappears by ten, and by twenty DTF leads on point estimate (86.0% versus 84.5%) at one ninth the latency and less than half the cost. Ablation attributes 27.6 points of rank-one accuracy to the reranking stage alone. We further report that the ranking advantage does not extend to citation accuracy, where DTF matches the oracle ceiling, and three negative results on lemmatisation, pseudo-relevance feedback and query rewriting. Surrogate annotation covers 27.0% of the corpus but every reference provision in the benchmark, an asymmetry we disclose and discuss. Benchmark, per-question outputs and paired significance tests are publicly available.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 波兰成文法附加说明的替代检索
articles.content_zh: 我们提出一套以文件替代为基础的波兰成文法检索方法:索引时间附在成文条款后的语言模型说明。 三种设计在成本质量前沿占据了不同的点. ASCR是一种具有再排级的代位级联;ASCR-H将一个密集的列表接入了该级联;而DTF则将两种语言模式级都取而代之的是3个词典化和密集的取回器,加权对等的分级聚变,以及先定型再取分,在生成前不使用模式调取. 我们对照14个词汇、稠密、连接和宽放的基线加上4个控制,对2024年和2025年波兰律师和法律顾问入门考试的300个问题(264个及其在诉讼书中的参考条款)进行评估,对1 133个法案的82 508个文章进行评估。 在配对的McNemar测试中,ASCR-H将参考规定置于比其他非甲骨文配置要多得多的一等位,除了其自身的一等位外(在20个比较中,有18个比较对它有利,p < 0.005),BM25为72.3%,密集检索为52.3%。 优势集中在头部,无法活到深处:在一分之一和五的断接点上是显著的,以十分之十消失;在二十分之一(86.0%对84.5%)的点估计上,二十分之一(8.0%对84.5%)的点估计值是暂时的,成本还不到一半. 校正属性 27.6分一等精度 单是重排阶段. 我们进一步报告,排名优势并不延伸至引用精度,其中DTF与甲骨文天花板相匹配,在放任,伪相回馈和查询重写方面有3个负面结果. 代理注解涵盖27.0%的本书 但基准中的每一个参考条款 我们披露和讨论的不对称 基准、每个问题的产出和成对意义测试均可公开查阅。

articles.title: TRIPPULSE: Multi-Agent Travel Planning with Review-Grounded Reasoning
articles.content: Travel itinerary generation requires balancing strict spatio-temporal constraints with human preferences. Existing LLM-based planners mainly rely on structured attributes and pre- defined traveler personas, but real travel deci- sions are often shaped by reviews that reveal experiential factors such as comfort, safety, ser- vice quality, ambiance, crowding, and hidden risks absent from structured databases. Incor- porating such review information is therefore critical to realistic, user-centric itinerary gen- eration. We propose TRIPPULSE1, a multi- agent framework for review-grounded travel planning. Instead of relying on a monolithic planner (and face context and reasoning bot- tlenecks), TRIPPULSE2 decomposes itinerary generation into specialized agents (each op- erating over localized contexts) for accom- modations, transportation, meals, attractions, and events, coordinated through a global or- chestrator with scheduling mechanisms that enforce temporal and budget feasibility. We augment TRIPCRAFT with 100K+ real-world reviews and introduce Review-Grounded Per- sona Alignment (RGPA), an LLM-as-a-Judge metric for evaluating alignment with human- centric travel experiences. Experiments across multiple trip durations and diverse proprietary and open-source models show that TRIPPULSE maintains strong constraint satisfaction while generating more personalized and experien- tially grounded itineraries.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TRIPPULSE: 多代理旅行规划与审查 - 总体理由
articles.content_zh: 旅行行程的产生需要平衡严格的时空限制和人类偏好。 现有的基于LLM的规划者主要依靠结构化属性和预先定义的旅行者人物,但真正的出行deci-sions往往被审查所塑造,这些审查揭示出一些经验性因素,如舒适,安全,ser-副质量,氛围,拥挤,以及结构化数据库所没有的隐蔽风险等. 因此,增加这种审查信息对于以用户为中心的现实行程基因 -- -- 循环至关重要。 我们提出TRIPPULSE1,一个审查旅行规划的多代理框架。 TRIPPULSE2没有依赖单一的策划者(以及面对背景和推理的bot-tlenecks),而是将行程生成分解成专门的代理商(每一个在局部背景之上的操作),用于Accom调和,运输,取餐,取景地和事件,通过一个全球或胸前协调,与执行时间和预算可行性的调度机制相协调. 我们用100K+现实世界审查来增加TRIPCRAFT,并采用审查-环绕 " 和谐 " (RGPA)这一衡量标准,用于评估与以人为中心的旅行经验的一致性。 跨越多个旅行时间和多种专有和开源模式的实验表明,TRIPPULSE保持了强烈的制约性满意度,同时产生更个性化和外出性化-疲软的行程.

articles.title: Responsible Integration of AI in Cancer Genomics: Barriers, Risks, and Pathways to Trustworthy Clinical Translation
articles.content: Artificial intelligence (AI) and natural language processing (NLP) are increasingly used to extract, integrate, and interpret biomedical knowledge relevant to cancer genomics, yet their translation into routine clinical oncology has been comparatively slow. The central challenge is not computational capability alone, but trustworthy integration into clinical workflows. This review examines how NLP and AI support the cancer genomics pipeline, from literature mining and automated variant interpretation to clinical trial matching, knowledge graph construction, and multimodal data integration. We identify four interrelated translational failure domains: evidence inconsistency, explainability and uncertainty, data governance and reproducibility, and interoperability. Rather than considering these challenges in isolation, we take a systems-level view, focusing on their interaction across the translational pathway. We propose a conceptual framework and roadmap for addressing these domains through rigorous validation, uncertainty-aware methods, interoperable infrastructures, regulatory alignment, and human oversight across the AI lifecycle. Progress toward routine clinical use will depend less on further improving model capability than on systematically addressing these interacting failure domains from development through deployment and post-deployment monitoring.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在癌症基因组学中负责任地整合AI:障碍、风险和可信赖的临床翻译途径
articles.content_zh: 人工智能(AI)和自然语言处理(NLP)被越来越多地用于提取,整合,解读与癌症基因组学相关的生物医学知识,然而,将其翻译为常规临床肿瘤学则相对缓慢. 中心挑战不仅仅是计算能力,而是值得信赖地融入临床工作流程。 这一审查审查了NLP和AI如何支持从文献挖掘和自动变异解释到临床试验匹配,知识图构建,以及多模式数据整合等癌症基因组学管道. 我们确定了四个相互关联的翻译故障领域:证据不一致、可解释性和不确定性、数据管理和可复制性和互操作性。 我们不是孤立地考虑这些挑战,而是采取系统一级的观点,侧重于它们在翻译过程中的互动。 我们提出了一个概念框架和路线图,以便通过严格的验证、不确定性认识方法、可互操作的基础设施、监管协调以及整个人工智能生命周期的人类监督来解决这些问题。 常规临床使用的进展将不取决于进一步改进模型能力,而取决于从发展到部署和部署后监测的这些相互作用的故障领域得到系统处理。

articles.title: S3C-LLM: Skill-Code Guided Agentic Language Models for Spectrum-to-Structure Elucidation
articles.content: Spectroscopic structure elucidation is central to molecular analysis, but recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods mostly formulate it as direct spectrum-to-SMILES generation. Although this paradigm can leverage paired spectral data, it does not explicitly model the analytical workflow used by spectroscopists, such as diagnostic peak interpretation, fragment reasoning, formula constraints, and chemical consistency checking. In this paper, we introduce S3C-LLM, a skill-guided and code-grounded agentic LLM for spectrum-to-structure elucidation. Rather than directly predicting a molecule, S3C-LLM retrieves modality-specific spectroscopy skills, executes analysis code to instantiate these skills on the input spectra, and integrates the resulting peak-level evidence and formula constraints before generating SMILES. Specifically, we contribute a self-evolving spectroscopy skill library, a thinking-augmented skill-code trajectory construction pipeline, and a two-stage training strategy that teaches Qwen3-4B through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by our proposed step-level reinforcement learning (RL). Experiments on diverse benchmarks show that S3C-LLM consistently outperforms current general LLMs and spectrum-specific models across spectra, while using less than 1/10th of SpectraLLM's training corpus.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: S3C-LLM: Spectrum-to-Structure Elucidation 的 Skill-Code 引导代理语言模型
articles.content_zh: 光谱结构说明是分子分析的核心,但最近基于大语言模型(LLM)的方法大多将其表述为直接光谱到SMILES生成. 虽然这种范式可以利用配对光谱数据,但它没有明确模拟光谱学家使用的分析工作流程,如诊断峰值解释,片段推理,公式限制,以及化学一致性检查等. 在本文中,我们介绍了S3C-LLM,这是一种以技能为指南并基于代码的代理LLM,用于频谱到结构的解析. S3C-LLM与其直接预测一分子,不如检索出模式特有分光学技能,执行分析代码,以在输入光谱上即时化这些技能,并在生成SMILES之前将由此产生的峰值级证据和公式约束进行整合. 具体地说,我们提供了自发的光谱技术库、思维增强的技能编码轨迹建造管道和通过监督微调(SFT)教授Qune3-4B的两阶段培训战略,然后是我们提议的分级强化学习。 对各种基准的实验表明,S3C-LLM在全光谱上一贯优于当前一般LLM和光谱特异模型,同时使用SpectraLLM的训程还不到1/10.

articles.title: MMDS-Bench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models on Dynamic Stance in Social Media Interactions
articles.content: Dynamic stance classification models how a reply responds to its direct parent message, rather than how a post relates to a fixed topic. Existing work has mainly studied this problem in text-only settings, while social media interactions increasingly rely on images, screenshots, memes, reaction images, and cross-modal references. We introduce MMDS-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for multimodal dynamic stance classification in social media parent-reply interactions. MMDS-Bench contains 3,482 multimodal instances annotated with a seven-label dynamic stance taxonomy, together with an 800-instance diagnostic subset that requires structured reasoning over parent understanding, reply understanding, and stance-relation inference. We further annotate each instance with five challenge factors covering multimodal fusion, parent framing, non-literal expression, interaction reasoning, and label-boundary ambiguity. We evaluate 12 closed-source and open-source multimodal large language models and propose a reference-grounded LLM-judge protocol for assessing reasoning quality. Results show that current MLLMs still struggle with multimodal dynamic stance understanding, especially in cases that require relational inference beyond separate parent and reply comprehension.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MMDS-Bench:关于社会媒体互动动态态势的多模式大语言模式基准
articles.content_zh: 动态姿态叙级模式是答复如何回应其直接的母信息,而不是员额与固定主题的关系。 现有工作主要在文本专用设置中研究了这一问题,而社交媒体互动则越来越依赖于图像,截图,memes,反应图像,以及跨模式的引用. 我们引入了MMDS-Bench,这是在社交媒体亲和互动中多式联运动态姿态分类的诊断基准. MMDS-Bench包含3,482个多式实例,并附有7个标签的动态姿态分类法,以及一个800英寸诊断子集,它需要结构化的推理,而不是母体的理解、回复理解和姿态关系推论。 我们进一步对每个案例进行注释,其中包含五个挑战因素,包括多式联运、母体框架、非文学表达、互动推理和标签界限模糊等。 我们评价了12个封闭源码和开源多式大型语言模型,并提出了基于参考的LLM评断程序,用于评估推理质量。 结果表明,目前的小额金融服务仍然难以理解多式联运动态态势,特别是在需要超越单独母体和答复理解的关系推论的情况下。

articles.title: Low-Resource Preference Adaptation of LLMs via Activation-Based Label Propagation
articles.content: Adapting large language models to user-specific preferences is often constrained by the cost of human annotation, making preference optimisation impractical in low-resource settings where preferences cannot be reliably labelled by LLMs themselves, e.g., due to cultural, subjective, or personalised contexts. In this paper, we investigate how language models encode preference information in their intermediate representations, finding that activations from chosen and rejected responses form distinct clusters across layers, even in pretrained models. Strikingly, this structure is strengthened by alignment on canonical datasets but erased when the target preferences differ from those the model was aligned on, suggesting aligned LLMs are poor judges for non-mainstream populations. Exploiting this structure, we propose training a lightweight linear probe on a few labelled preference pairs ($\leq$500) and using it to annotate large unlabelled datasets (50K+) for downstream preference optimisation. We systematically evaluate this approach across different datasets, preference optimisation methods and model scales and find that our method consistently outperforms direct training given the same annotation budget, and remains competitive against baselines trained on $50-100\times$ more labelled data in the majority of our settings. Code is available at https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/activ-pref-probe.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 低资源优先度通过基于激活的标签来适应LLMS
articles.content_zh: 使大型语言模型适应用户特有偏好往往受到人类注释成本的限制,使得偏好优化在低资源环境下不切实际,因为偏好本身无法可靠地被LLMS贴上标签,例如由于文化,主观或个性化的背景. 在本文中,我们调查语言模型如何将偏好信息编码在其中间表达中,发现来自所选择的和被拒绝的响应的活化物会形成分层的分化群,甚至在预先训练的模型中. 令人惊奇的是,这种结构通过调整犬类数据集而得到加强,但当目标偏好与模型一致时却被抹去,这表明对准的LLMs对于非主流人群来说是差的判断. 利用这一结构,我们提议对几对贴有标签的首选配对进行轻量级线性探测器($\leq $500)的培训,并利用它来注释大型无标签数据集(50K+),用于下游首选优化. 我们通过不同的数据集、优化选择方法和模型尺度系统地评估这一方法,发现我们的方法在同样的注释预算下,一贯超过直接培训,并且仍然具有竞争力,与在多数情况下经过50-100美元更贴标签数据的基线相比。 代码见https://github.com/alessioGalatolo/activ-pref-probe.

articles.title: ECGQuest: Benchmarking and Fine-Tuning Language Models for Electrocardiography
articles.content: Electrocardiogram (ECG) interpretation requires knowledge of cardiology, electrophysiology, clinical diagnosis, ECG waveforms, signal acquisition, and instrumentation. Existing language-model benchmarks, however, primarily assess broad medical knowledge or interpretation of individual ECG signals and images rather than the broader contextual knowledge required for ECG interpretation. We developed ECGQuest, a literature-grounded resource for evaluating and fine-tuning ECG-specific language models. A GPT-4o-based pipeline generated questions from 23 ECG references and Computing in Cardiology proceedings from 2003-2025. The final dataset contains 10,904 unique True/False questions paired with their negated forms (21,808 Q&A pairs). We evaluated three commercial and 20 open-source language models on a held-out test set in a zero-shot setting. Five open-source models with 7-14B parameters were fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation, with BERT and BiomedBERT included as supervised encoder baselines. Generalization was assessed on ECG-related subsets of MedMCQA and MedQA converted to binary True/False questions using official answer keys. Zero-shot accuracy on ECGQuest ranged from 49.5% to 74.4%, with GPT-5 performing best. General-purpose models outperformed medically specialized models, several models showed strong True/False bias, and encoder baselines performed near chance. Fine-tuning improved all open-source models by 6.5-14.1%. Fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B reached 76.3% accuracy, while a five-model voting ensemble reached 78.5%. On MedMCQA and MedQA, fine-tuning mainly benefited weaker or class-biased models and did not consistently improve strong base models. ECGQuest provides a reproducible benchmark for contextual ECG knowledge and shows that parameter-efficient fine-tuning can make smaller language models competitive with substantially larger commercial models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: ECGQuest:电心学基准和精致语言模型
articles.content_zh: 电心学(ECG)解释需要掌握心电学,电生理学,临床诊断,ECG波形,信号获取,和仪器等知识. 然而,现有语言模型基准主要评估个人ECG信号和图像的广泛医学知识或解释,而不是ECG解释所需的更广泛的背景知识。 我们开发了基于文献的ECGQuest,用于评价和微调ECG特有的语言模型。 一个基于GPT-4o的管道从2003至2025年的23个ECG参考和心脏学计算程序中产生了问题。 最终数据集包含有10,904个独特的True/False问题与被否定的形式对齐(21,808个QQA对). 我们评价了三个商业模型和20个开源语言模型, 在一个零镜头设置的搁置测试中。 5个有7-14B参数的开源模型使用低Rank适应进行了微调,将BERT和BiomedBERT列为监督编码器基线. 对MedMCQA和MedQA中与ECG相关的子集进行了概括性评估,这些子集使用官方的回答键转换为二进制True/False问题. ECGQuest上的零发精度从49.5%到74.4%不等,GPT-5表现最好. 通用模型的性能超过了医学专业模型,有几种模型表现出了强烈的True/False偏差,而编码器基线的性能几乎是偶然的. 微调改进了所有开源型号,提高了6.5%至14.1%. 微调深Seek-R1-Distill-Quen-14B的精度达到76.3%,而五型投票综艺则达到78.5%. 在MedMCQA和MedQA上,微调主要有利于较弱或有阶级偏见的模型,没有一贯地改进强基模型. ECGQuest为背景ECG知识提供了一个可再生的基准,并表明参数高效的微调可以使更小的语言模型与大得多的商业模型相竞争.

articles.title: Evaluating and Mitigating Anti-LGBTQ Biases in German and Multilingual Language Models
articles.content: While gender and racial biases in language models have been widely studied, anti-LGBTQ biases remain underexplored, particularly beyond English. Existing benchmarks often do not capture cultural and linguistic variation and rely on gender representations. This paper introduces a multilingual German-English benchmark dataset for the evaluation of anti-LGBTQ biases in language models. It combines community-sourced stereotypes from German-speaking queer individuals with a German translation of WinoQueer. The data is used to evaluate eight language models across sizes and architectures and explore mitigation through fine-tuning on community and progressive media content. Results show that language models reproduce anti-queer stereotypes, with variation across identities and models. Differences between the translated and community-based data highlight the importance of cultural adaptation for multilingual bias evaluation. Fine-tuning reduces bias on average, but not consistently across models and identities. Warning: This text contains examples of anti-queer hateful language and stereotypes.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 评估和减缓反LGBTQ 德语和多语言语言模式的比喻
articles.content_zh: 虽然对语言模式中的性别和种族偏见进行了广泛研究,但反LGBTQ的偏见仍然没有得到充分探讨,特别是在英语之外。 现有基准往往没有反映文化和语言差异,而依赖于性别代表性。 本文为评价语言模型中的反LGBTQ偏差引入了多语种德-英基准数据集. 它结合了来自德语同性恋个人的社区来源的陈规定型观念和维诺克的德文翻译. 这些数据用于评价8个跨大小和跨结构的语言模型,并通过对社区和进步媒体内容的微调来探索减缓. 结果表明,语言模型复制了反排泄的定型观念,其特性和模式各不相同。 翻译数据与基于社区的数据之间的差异突出了文化适应对多语种偏见评价的重要性。 精细调整平均减少偏差,但不同模型和身份的偏差不一致. 警告: 该文中包含有反克勒仇恨语言和定型观念的例子.

articles.title: Personas Differ from Native-Language Generation: Language Pathways Shape LLM Interpersonal Advice
articles.content: LLMs are increasingly used for interpersonal advice and as tools for studying social behavior across languages and cultures. A common shortcut for eliciting language- or culture-related variation is to ask a model to answer as a native speaker. We test whether this native-speaker persona reproduces the outputs obtained when models instead generate advice in the target language and translate the response back into English. Using 600 interpersonal advice questions across 13 languages and eight LLMs, we compare native-language generation followed by translation (NL) with native-speaker persona prompting (NP), measuring linguistic style, behavioral scaffolding, and forced-choice action recommendations. We find that NP and NL are not interchangeable. Compared to NL, NP often increases lexical social cues, including affiliation and positive tone, while reducing qualities such as concreteness and social attunement; NP also provides less actionable scaffolding in open-ended advice. In forced-choice scenarios, NP changes which action the model selects, favoring confrontation over redirection, with effect sizes varying across languages, topics, and models. Our results show that cross-lingual elicitation strategy is a consequential methodological choice that can change both how advice is framed and which actions models recommend.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 本地语言代词:语言路径形状 LLM 人际咨询
articles.content_zh: LLM越来越多地用于人际咨询,并成为研究跨语言和文化的社会行为的工具. 吸引语言或文化差异的一个常见捷径是请一个模型作为母语回答。 我们测试这个母语的人a 是否复制了模型生成目标语言建议时获得的输出,并将回复翻译成英语。 我们利用来自13个语言和8个LLMs的600个人际咨询问题, 来比较当地语言的生成, 我们认为NP和NL不能互换. 与NL相比,NP经常会增加词汇化的社会提示,包括从属关系和正基调,同时会降低具体性和社会调和等品质;NP在开放式建议中也会提供较少可操作的脚手架. 在强制选择的情况下,NP改变模型选择的动作,倾向于对抗而不是重定向,效果大小因语言、主题和模型而异。 我们的结果显示,跨语种的引领战略是一种相应的方法选择,既可以改变如何制定建议,也可以改变哪些行动模式建议。

articles.title: Beyond Good Intentions: When Does the Framing of Multilingual and Low-Resource NLP Research Become a Caricature?
articles.content: Building language technologies and conducting NLP research for low-resource languages---particularly when led by native speakers or involving participatory research practices---are often framed as means of addressing inequality, serving local communities, and, at times, contributing to *decolonisation*. In this paper, we examine recently published NLP and ML papers, focusing on the narratives used to characterise multilinguality, low-resource languages, and underrepresented cultures. We propose a framework for analysing research framings and identify recurring rhetorical patterns that may hinder accountability and constrain equitable knowledge production for---and by---underserved communities. We further assess the evidential basis of assertions regarding community benefit and find that such statements are often weakly supported or left unsubstantiated. Although community ownership and participation are frequently presented as key objectives, our analysis, supported by statistics from the ACL Anthology, suggests that research outputs more often prioritise resource creation and benchmarking---important but distinct goals---over evidence of broader structural change. We conclude by offering practical recommendations to help authors, reviewers, and readers critically assess these assertions and avoid potentially misleading framings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超越好 意图:多语种和低资源NLP研究的花纹何时成为漫画?.
articles.content_zh: 语言技术的建设和低资源语言的NLP研究 -- -- 特别是当由讲土著语言的人领导或参与研究做法时 -- -- 往往被设定为解决不平等问题的手段,为当地社区服务,有时还助长 " 非殖民化 " 。 在本文中,我们审查了最近出版的NLP和ML论文,侧重于用于描述多语种特征的叙事、低资源语言和代表性不足的文化。 我们提出一个框架,用于分析研究框架并查明可能妨碍问责制和限制为得不到充分服务的社区创造公平知识的反复出现的言论模式。 我们进一步评估关于社区福利的断言的证据依据,并发现这种断言往往没有得到有力的支持或没有得到证实。 尽管社区当家作主和参与常常被说成是关键的目标,但我们的分析,加上ACL Anthology的统计数据,表明研究成果更经常地优先考虑资源创造和基准设定 -- -- 重要但截然不同的目标 -- -- 超越了更广泛的结构改革的证据。 最后,我们提出切实可行的建议,帮助作者、审查者和读者批判性地评估这些说法并避免可能误导性的框架。

articles.title: You Shouldn't Have Asked: A Pragmatics-Inspired Taxonomy for Evaluating LLM Refusals
articles.content: Refusals are often treated as face-threatening acts in pragmatics because they can challenge the requester's socially claimed self-image. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained to refuse unsafe and inappropriate requests, and these refusals may harm users when models fail to manage this interactional cost properly. While existing work has mainly approached LLM non-compliance as a safety-alignment outcome, it does not provide a way to evaluate whether LLMs refuse appropriately across different harmful contexts. To study this question, we propose (to our knowledge) the first taxonomy of LLM refusals that is grounded in pragmatic theory. Applying this taxonomy to responses from 16 modern LLMs across 14 harm categories, we find that although models differ in how they refuse, their refusals are overall explicit and strongly morally evaluative, with interactional repair occurring mainly through offering or providing safer alternatives instead of interpersonal facework. This pattern is especially consequential in sensitive harm contexts, where overuse of negative framing may make users feel shamed or provoked, undermining the purpose of safe non-compliance. We therefore call for alignment evaluation that considers not only whether models refuse harmful requests, but also whether they refuse in ways that are contextually adaptive and socially accountable for the interactional consequences of saying no.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 你不应该问:评估LLM的实用启发分类学 拒绝
articles.content_zh: 拒绝往往在实用主义中被视为威胁面部的行为,因为他们可以挑战请求者在社会上声称的自我形象. 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地接受拒绝不安全和不适当的请求的培训,当模型未能正确管理这种交互成本时,这些拒绝可能会伤害用户. 虽然现有工作主要将LLM不遵守作为安全调整的结果,但它没有提供一种方法来评价LLMs是否在不同有害的情况下适当拒绝。 为了研究这个问题,我们提出(据我们所知)以实用理论为基础的第一个LLM拒绝分类法。 将这种分类法应用于16个现代有限责任公司对14个伤害类别的反应,我们发现,虽然模式在拒绝方式上有所不同,但拒绝方式总体上是明确的,在道德上很强的评价,互动修复主要通过提供或提供更安全的替代办法而不是人际面部工作进行。 这种模式在敏感伤害情况下尤其严重,过度使用负面设定可能使用户感到羞耻或被激怒,损害安全不遵守的目的。 因此,我们呼吁进行协调统一评价,不仅考虑模型是否拒绝有害请求,而且考虑模型是否拒绝的方式符合具体情况,并对表示拒绝的相互作用后果承担社会责任。

articles.title: Linguistic Distance Segregates Latent Representations in Automatic Speech Recognition Systems
articles.content: While automatic speech recognition (ASR) models have achieved remarkable improvements in recent years, performance disparities persist across different speaker populations. One such disparity is for speakers whose first languages (L1) are from families distant from English. This paper investigates the relationship between first language background and English ASR performance. Through empirical analysis, we observe that the correlation between speakers' L1 distance and ASR error rates yields a systematic effect on English Speech, with its strength varying across datasets and models. This association is statistically significant in a follow-up analysis accounting for dataset-level variation in Tweedie mixed-effects models ($p<0.001$ across evaluated models). In addition, analysis of the latent space reveals a L1-based spatial segregation across deeper acoustic layers in the majority of evaluated architectures
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 语言距离 自动语音识别系统中的Latent表示
articles.content_zh: 虽然近年来自动语音识别(ASR)模式取得了显著的改进,但不同语种人群的表现差距仍然存在. 其中一个差距是第一语言(L1)来自远离英语的家庭的发言者。 本文调查第一语言背景与英语ASR性能的关系. 通过经验分析,我们观察到,发言者的L1距离与ASR误差率之间的关联对英语语音产生系统的影响,其强度因数据集和模型而异. 这种关联在后续分析中具有统计意义,分析了Tweedie混合效应模型的数据集水平变化(每套评估模型为0.001美元)。 此外,对潜在空间的分析显示,在大多数评价结构中,基于L1的空间隔离跨越更深的声层

articles.title: Thesis Proposal: Toward a Human-Centered and Perspective-Aware Framework for Reproducible ML Evaluation and AI Alignment
articles.content: Humans play a vital role at every stage of AI development, from data collection and curation to model development and evaluation. However, humans often disagree with each other and sometimes with themselves over time. It is essential to take disagreement into account when building human-centered AI systems, especially in domains where it is prevalent, such as AI safety, content moderation, or sentiment analysis. Disagreement often arises from subjective human opinion and can vary with one's identity, beliefs, and social environment. Despite this, current LLM evaluation approaches frequently rely on aggregating labels (often via plurality voting) to represent consensus, thereby obscuring minority perspectives. By failing to account for human disagreement, these evaluation methods contribute to the reproducibility crisis in AI. Human feedback is also crucial for ensuring that AI systems align with human values. For these systems to be trustworthy, it is critical to ensure that they reflect diverse human values and perspectives. In this thesis proposal, we present a human-centered and perspective-aware framework for reproducible ML evaluation and AI alignment.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 论文建议:建立一个以人为本和有远见的框架,以进行可复制的ML评价和AI调整
articles.content_zh: 人类在AI开发的每个阶段都发挥着至关重要的作用,从数据收集和目录到模型开发和评价. 然而,人类往往彼此有分歧,有时也会随着时间推移而与自己有分歧. 在建立以人为本的人工智能系统时,特别是在人工智能安全、内容节制或情绪分析等普遍存在的领域,必须考虑到分歧。 分歧往往源于主观的人类观点,并可能因个人的身份、信仰和社会环境而异。 尽管如此,目前的LLM评价方法往往依靠汇总标签(往往通过多元表决)来代表共识,从而掩盖少数群体的观点。 由于未能说明人类的分歧,这些评估方法助长了AI的再生产危机. 人类反馈对于确保人工智能系统符合人类价值观也至关重要。 为了使这些系统可信,必须确保它们反映不同的人类价值和观点。 在这个论文提案中,我们提出了一个以人为本和有远见的框架,用于可复制的ML评价和AI对齐.

articles.title: HSRM: Hidden-State Reward Models for Test-Time Verification
articles.content: Large language models can often generate plausible mathematical reasoning traces, but reliably identifying the correct solution among multiple candidates remains a key challenge. Existing test-time reasoning pipelines typically rely on text-based verifiers that re-read each generated solution, making verification an expensive component of inference. Prior work has shown, however, that LLMs often encode correctness-related signals in their internal representations, including awareness of when their own answers are likely to be wrong. Building on this observation, we introduce HSRM, a lightweight hidden-state reward model that verifies candidate solutions by directly reading the generator's internal representations rather than re-processing its text. HSRM extracts hidden states from a frozen generator at reasoning-step boundaries and uses a small Transformer encoder to rank candidates. It is trained from self-generated trajectories with outcome labels, requiring neither human-written process supervision nor a large pretrained verifier. Across four mathematical reasoning benchmarks, HSRM matches or outperforms a 55M-parameter text-only energy verifier in 15 of 16 generator--dataset settings while using only about 2M parameters, providing an efficient alternative to text-only verification by reusing representations already computed during generation.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: HSRM: 测试-时间验证的隐藏-状态奖励模型
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型往往可以产生可信的数学推理痕迹,但可靠地确定多个候选人的正确解决方案仍然是一个关键的挑战。 现有的测试时间推理管道一般依赖文本验证器,每个验证器重读生成的解决方案,使核查成为推论中昂贵的组成部分. 然而,先前的工作表明,LLMs经常在内部表述中编码与正确性有关的信号,包括知道何时他们自己的答案可能是错误的. 基于这一观察,我们引入了HSRM,一种轻量级隐藏状态奖励模型,通过直接阅读生成器的内部表示而不是重新处理其文本来验证候选解决方案. HSRM从一个处于推理步骤边界的冷冻生成器中提取隐藏状态,并使用一个小变形器编码器对候选人进行排名. 它从带有结果标签的自产生轨迹中训练出来,既不需要人文程序监督,也不需要经过预先培训的大型核查员。 在四个数学推理基准中,HSRM在16个生成器-数据集设置中的15个中匹配或超过了一个55M参数的文本唯一能量验证器,而只使用约2M参数,通过重用在生成过程中已经计算的表达值,提供了一种高效的文本唯一验证的替代品.

articles.title: Opinionated, Hesitant and Stressed: Three Studies of How Politicians Speak in Four Slavic Parliaments
articles.content: We present three large-scale studies of spoken parliamentary speech across four Slavic languages (Croatian, Czech, Polish, Serbian), drawing on over 6,000 hours from the ParlaSpeech 3.0 corpus. The first study examines how utterance-level sentiment shapes acoustic realisation: negative speech is consistently produced with higher pitch, greater intensity, and faster rate across all four parliaments, with a secondary arousal-driven upturn at the most positive extreme. The second study models filled pause frequency using negative binomial GEE, finding that speech rate, age, and sentiment are robust cross-lingual predictors, while gender effects reverse between South Slavic (men produce fewer filled pauses) and West Slavic parliaments (no gender difference) - a pattern invisible to single-language designs. The third study investigates primary stress variation in Croatian, showing that speaker-level preferences for early versus late stress cohere across verbs, adjectives, and nouns but decouple for adverbs and proper nouns. We conclude with a research agenda spanning corpus phonetics, disfluency modelling, and political rhetoric.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 观点,赫西坦和压力:政治人物如何在四个斯拉夫议会发言的三项研究
articles.content_zh: 我们利用ParlaSpeech 3.0 字节的6 000多小时,对四种斯拉夫语言(克罗地亚语、捷克语、波兰语、塞尔维亚语)的议会口头发言进行了三项大规模研究。 第一项研究研究了言论层面情绪如何影响声学实现:负面言论的产生始终如一,其投射率更高,强度更高,而且所有四个议会的速率更快,在最正面的极端是二次催眠驱动的上升。 第二研究模型使用负二分位GEE填充暂停频率,发现语音速率,年龄,情绪都是强力的跨语言预测器,而南斯拉夫语(男性产生更少的填充暂停)和西斯拉夫语议会(无性别差异)之间的性别效应反向——这种模式是单一语言设计所看不见的. 第三项研究调查了克罗地亚语的主要压力变化情况,显示发言者一级对早期和晚期压力的偏好,跨越动词、形容词和名词,但副词和适当名词的偏好。 最后,我们提出一个研究议程,内容包括题词、不成功建模和政治言论。

articles.title: Error-Type-Aware Loss Reweighting for Robust Named Entity Recognition with Noisy LLM Labels
articles.content: Large language models are increasingly used to annotate datasets for training smaller, task-specialized models such as named entity recognition. While this method yields effective models, it assumes that the synthetic dataset is correctly annotated. In this work, we find that (i) current fine-tuning processes simply ignore LLM-introduced annotation noise, resulting in degraded performance and (ii) existing noise-robust losses are not transferable to sequence labeling because annotation noise in named entity recognition is heterogeneous: for example, missing mentions and type errors affect the training signal in different ways. Treating all noisy tokens equally in noise-robust losses and applying a single reweighing criterion for all may therefore remove useful supervision or reinforce incorrect labels. To address this limitation, we propose error-type-aware loss reweighting for NER, which introduces separate reweighing rules for different types of potentially erroneous tokens. Our approach is simple and efficient, does not require additional training resources, and improves F1 by 0.8 - 2.0 percentage points on dataset-level average for noise levels between 15% and 40%, with a maximum improvement of 4.6 percentage points with 24.1% noise on Wikigold.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 用无声 LLM 标签重命名实体识别错误- Type- Aware 丢失
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于对数据集进行注释,用于培训较小的、专门的任务模型,如命名的实体识别。 虽然这种方法产生有效的模型,但它假设合成数据集的注释是正确的. 在这项工作中,我们发现:(一)当前的微调过程只是忽略了LLM-引入的注释噪声,导致性能退化;(二)由于命名的实体识别中的注释噪声是多种多样的,因此现有的噪声-阻塞损失不能转移给序列标签:例如,缺失的引用和类型错误以不同的方式影响训练信号. 因此,在噪音破坏损失中平等对待所有噪音标志,并对所有人适用单一的重写标准,可能会取消有用的监督或强化不正确的标签。 为了解决这一限制,我们提议对NER进行误差类型的损失重新加权,对不同类型的可能错误的符号分别实行重排规则. 我们的方法简单高效,不需要额外的培训资源,对于15%至40%的噪声水平,在数据集水平平均值上将F1提高0.8-2.0个百分点,在维基黄金上最大提高4.6个百分点,噪音24.1%.

articles.title: Vocal Music under Phoneme-Conditional Analysis
articles.content: The vocal music of each language carries a distinctive sonic identity, even without instrumental accompaniment. We ask whether these differences are measurable and traceable to specific phonemes. To tackle this question, we introduce phoneme-conditional analysis, which isolates the acoustic effect of typologically distinctive phonemes by comparing marker syllables against matched non-marker controls within the same song, holding singer, melody, and genre constant. Across nine typologically diverse languages and thousands of songs, we measure effects along five acoustic dimensions. Song-level profiles built from these effects identify the language of an unaccompanied vocal at 85.5% balanced accuracy in a nine-way classification with folds grouped by artist; whether the separability arises by accumulation of the phoneme-local effects themselves is left open. Our findings suggest that phonological structure leaves systematic and measurable traces in how each language is sung.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Phoneme-条件分析下的 Vocal 音乐
articles.content_zh: 每种语言的声乐都带有独特的声乐特征,即使没有器乐伴奏. 我们问,这些差异是否可以衡量,是否可以追踪到具体电话。 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了电话-条件分析,通过将标记音节与同一首歌中匹配的非标记控制,持有歌手,旋律和流派常数进行比对,来分离出打字特色电话的声学效果. 在9种类型多样的语言和数千首歌曲中, 我们用5个声学维度来测量效果。 从这些效果中构建的宋级剖面,在由艺术家组合的折叠的九向分类中,将无伴音的精度达到85.5%的平衡度;电话-局部效应本身的积累是否产生可分离性,则未打开。 我们的调查结果表明,音响结构在每种语言的唱法方面留下了系统和可衡量的痕迹。

articles.title: TopoCompress: Long Context Compression via Graph-Wired Semantic Trajectories
articles.content: Long-context compression is essential for reducing the cost and latency of large language model inference. However, existing methods can fragment important evidence, require additional training or alignment, and often depend on the target model for effective compression. We introduce TopoCompress, a training-free and model-agnostic framework that compresses long contexts by selecting coherent semantic spans. TopoCompress first scores each span using dense and lexical query relevance together with semantic acceleration. It then constructs a hybrid graph that connects spans based on semantic similarity and sequential adjacency, and propagates the query-guided relevance scores over the graph. Across five long-context tasks-HotpotQA, 2WikiMQA, MuSiQue, Qasper, and MultiFieldQA-en-TopoCompress consistently outperforms strong compression baselines. Notably, TopoCompress achieves performance comparable to the strongest baseline while using a 4x smaller compression budget, and provides a 1.41x smaller compression time over the fastest baseline.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TopoCompress:通过图线语义轨迹进行长上下文压缩
articles.content_zh: 长文本压缩对于降低大语言模型推论的成本和耐久性至关重要. 然而,现有方法可能分散重要证据,需要额外的培训或调整,而且往往取决于目标模式的有效压缩。 我们介绍TopoCompress,这是一个免费的模型不可知框架,通过选择连贯的语义跨度来压缩长的语境. TopoCompress的第一分数每个跨度使用稠密和词典的查询关联性加上语义加速. 然后它构建一个基于语义相似性和相继性连接跨度的混合图,并在图上传播查询指导相关性分数. 跨越5个长文本任务——HotpotQA,2WikimQA,MuSiQue,Qasper,和MultifieldQA-en-TopoCompress 持续超过强压缩基线. 值得注意的是,TopoCompress在使用4x更小的压缩预算的同时,实现了与最强基线相当的性能,并在最快的基准上提供了1.41x更小的压缩时间.

articles.title: CLIN: an Objective Framework for Evaluating Creativity in Short Persian Literary Text
articles.content: Evaluating creativity in large language model (LLM) outputs remains challenging because creativity is multidimensional and human-centered. We examine how reliably LLMs evaluate short literary text in Persian, a low-resource language, across multiple evaluation strategies and prompt formulations. We find that LLM-human agreement varies substantially across dimensions: alignment is stronger for structured TTCT-derived properties such as Originality, Fluency, and Elaboration, but considerably weaker for more subjective dimensions, particularly Emotion and Attractiveness. Judgments are also sensitive to prompt formulation, while few-shot prompting, ensembling, and multi-agent debate provide no consistent improvement. Motivated by this dimension-dependent behavior, we investigate whether structured creativity dimensions can instead be approximated using simple, interpretable proxy metrics. We introduce CLIN, which evaluates three TTCT-derived dimensions separately using topic-aware novelty for Originality, contextual lexical clustering for Fluency, and lexical diversity for Elaboration. These proxies achieve human alignment comparable to or better than the strongest zero-shot LLM judge in our setting while requiring substantially lower evaluation cost.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: CLIN:评价波斯语短文中创造性的目标框架
articles.content_zh: 评估大型语言模型产出的创造性仍然具有挑战性,因为创造性是多层面的和以人为本的。 我们审查LLMS如何可靠地评价波斯语的文学短文,这种低资源语言跨越多种评价战略和迅速的表述。 我们认为,LLM-人类协议在各个层面差异很大:对于结构化的TTCT衍生特性,如原始性、流畅性和精细性,协调性更强,但对于更主观的维度,特别是情感和吸引力,则要弱得多。 判断对迅速的表述也十分敏感,而少许镜头的提示,共鸣,以及多剂性的辩论则不能提供一致的改进. 基于这种依赖维度的行为,我们调查结构化的创造力维度是否可以使用简单,可解释的代用度量来进行近似. 我们介绍CLIN,它利用专题认识新颖的原生性、背景词汇组合的流利性和词汇多样性分别评价三个TTCT衍生的维度。 这些代名词实现了与我们环境中最强的零镜头LLM评断相比或更好的人与人的一致性,同时要求大幅度降低评价成本。

articles.title: The Fragility of Jailbreak Robustness Across Operational States
articles.content: Existing jailbreak evaluations typically characterize robustness using a single attack success rate (ASR) measured in a default configuration (the vanilla state). However, user-LLM interactions can induce diverse operational states beyond the vanilla state. In this work, we find that jailbreak robustness is highly fragile to operational-state variation: even when the attack remains fixed, changing only an ordinary system prompt not designed to affect safety can dramatically alter attack success rates. We systematically investigate this phenomenon across seven aligned models and three representative jailbreak attacks, observing substantial differences in ASR between vanilla and non-vanilla operational states. In one case, ASR increases by up to 56 percentage points (2% to 58%) solely due to a change in operational state. Remarkably, these increases occur even for attacks originally designed and optimized under vanilla-state evaluation. We further show that state-dependent robustness variation is systematically associated with differences in hidden representations along a refusal-related axis, and that projections onto this axis strongly predict jailbreak outcomes. Our results show that a single vanilla-state evaluation may not fully characterize jailbreak robustness, motivating evaluations that also examine how robustness changes across non-vanilla operational states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 整个业务国家监狱破案的脆弱性
articles.content_zh: 现有的越狱评价通常采用以默认配置(香草状态)衡量的单一攻击成功率来描述强健性。 然而,用户-LLM相互作用可以诱导香草状态以外的多种运行状态. 在这项工作中,我们发现越狱的坚韧性极易受到行动状态的变异:即使攻击仍然固定不变,只有改变一个不能影响安全的普通系统才能大大改变攻击的成功率。 我们通过七个统一的模式和三个具有代表性的越狱袭击,系统地调查这一现象,发现香草州与非香草州之间在ASR方面存在很大差异。 在一个案例中,只由于业务状态的变化,ASR就增加了高达56个百分点(2%至58%)。 值得注意的是,这些增加甚至发生在最初根据香草州评价设计和优化的攻击。 我们进一步表明,国家依赖的强性变化有系统地与与拒绝有关的轴线上隐性表述的差异有关,而对这一轴线的预测则有力地预测了越狱的结果。 我们的结果表明,单一的香草州评价可能不能充分描述越狱的强性,从而促使开展评价,同时审查非香草州业务州的强性变化。

articles.title: Not All Fallbacks Are Failures: Understanding and Recovering from Fallbacks in Mobile Voice Assistants
articles.content: Robust understanding of user input is a core requirement for voice assistants deployed in real-world environments. In practice, these systems encounter heterogeneous fallback situations caused by noisy audio input, transcription errors, ambiguous requests, incomplete utterances, or unintended activations. Existing systems typically respond with generic fallback messages, which do not resolve the underlying interaction failure and can degrade user experience. We study fallback handling in a deployed smartwatch-based voice assistant for general health support in everyday environments. Our analysis is based on six months of real-world usage data from more than 500 users, yielding a dataset of 3,030 anonymized, naturally occurring fallback-triggering utterances. We contribute (1) an operational taxonomy and the annotated VoxFallbacks dataset of these interactions, (2) a comparative evaluation of different models within a classification pipeline under practical deployment constraints, and (3) practical lessons for designing robust and cost-efficient fallback mechanisms. Results show that lightweight embedding-based classifiers outperform larger generative models on most classification tasks while requiring substantially fewer computational resources.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 并非所有的退缩都是失败:在移动语音助理中理解和从退缩中恢复
articles.content_zh: 有力理解用户输入是部署在现实世界环境中的语音助理的核心要求。 在实践中,这些系统遇到各种倒退情况,原因有:音频输入吵闹、抄录错误、请求模棱两可、言论不完整或意外启动。 现有系统一般以通用的回落信息进行响应,这些回落信息不能解决潜在的交互故障,并可降低用户体验. 我们在一个部署的智能观察语音助理中研究日常环境的一般保健支助的倒置处理。 我们的分析基于来自500多个用户的6个月真实世界使用数据,得出的数据集为3,030个无名化的、自然出现的倒计时语句。 我们提供了(1) 这些相互作用的业务分类和附加说明的VoxFallbacks数据集,(2) 在实际部署限制下对分类程序内的不同模型进行比较评价,以及(3) 设计强大和具有成本效益的倒置机制的实际经验教训。 结果显示,轻量级嵌入式分类器在大多数分类任务上都超过了较大的基因模型,同时需要大量较少的计算资源。

articles.title: Calibrating Small Language Models for Claim Check-Worthiness Detection
articles.content: Assessing claim check-worthiness is an essential first step in automated fact-checking pipelines.
