This work is motivated by a real deployment challenge at an early-stage startup: running large language models (LLMs) over every incoming claim is cost- and latency-prohibitive, yet smaller models sacrifice accuracy. We propose NN-PPI, a pointwise extension of Prediction-Powered Inference (PPI) that calibrates model predictions at inference time as a lightweight post-hoc layer, without re-training the underlying model. NN-PPI achieves weighted F1 gains ranging from 12% to 33.80% depending on the size and performance of the baseline model, bringing SLMs on par with larger LLMs. Beyond few-shot SLMs, NN-PPI further improves a production-deployed fine-tuned model, demonstrating that residual calibration is complementary to supervised fine-tuning. By recovering LLM-level accuracy from models that are an order of magnitude cheaper to serve, it makes accurate check-worthiness detection substantially cheaper to operate at scale. Our code and data can be found at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/arr-claim-worthiness-F237.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 校准小语言模型,以进行索赔核对和估价检测
articles.content_zh: 评估索赔核实是否合格是自动核实事实管道中必不可少的第一步。 这项工作的动机是,在早期启动阶段面临真正的部署挑战:在收到的每份申请中运行大型语文模型是成本和时间禁止的,但较小的模型牺牲准确性。 我们提出NN-PPI,这是预测力推论(PPI)的尖端延伸,在推论时将模型预测校准为轻量级的后热层,而不重新训练基础模型. NN-PPI的加权F1收益从12%到33.80%不等,这取决于基准模型的规模和性能,使可持续土地管理与大型有限责任公司持平。 除了少量的SLM外,NN-PPI还进一步改进了生产部署的微调模型,表明剩余校准是对监督微调的补充。 通过从数量级更便宜的模型中恢复LLM水平的精度,它使得精确的可检查性检测在规模操作上更便宜。 我们的代码和数据见https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ar-claim-worthible-F237.

articles.title: E-Commerce Bench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Autonomous Business Operation
articles.content: Long-horizon agentic tasks go beyond chaining short tasks over more interaction turns. Their evolving dynamic environments and long-range dependencies require Large Language Models (LLMs) to continually explore, learn from experience, and adapt their policies over thousands of steps. We introduce E-Commerce Bench, the first open-source benchmark that integrates multi-round counterpart negotiation and dynamic events into a year-long business operation. Over a 365-day year, an LLM agent concurrently runs multiple online stores, researching the market, negotiating with suppliers to source inventory, optimizing sales strategies, fulfilling orders, handling returns, and managing cash flow to maximize its end-of-year total assets. To construct a realistic merchant-side operating environment, the product and supplier data are derived from a real e-commerce platform, while a year-long calendar of promotions, natural disasters, and supply-chain shocks continually reshapes demand. For reproducibility, both sides of the market are deterministic: customer purchases and returns follow a fixed demand model, while a negotiation kernel determines supplier pricing, concessions, and decisions, with an LLM used only to verbalize them. We evaluate 18 frontier models across seven dimensions, including year-end assets, and find that no single model dominates. GPT-5.6 Sol earns the most, growing the 100,000 opening stake into 1,431,425, yet it ranks 16th of 18 on fraud avoidance and trails Fable5 in operational efficiency. Among open-weight models, Qwen3.8-Max-Preview leads with 416,252, 38% above GLM 5.2 (high), and achieves the strongest learning over the horizon, progressively bargaining down prices across repeated orders. Our code is available at https://github.com/QwenLM/E-CommerceBench.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 电子商务法官组:评价长效自治业务的LLM代理人
articles.content_zh: 长视距代理任务超越了连锁短任务,超越了更多的交互转折. 它们不断变化的动态环境和长期依赖性要求大语言模型(LLMs)不断探索,从经验中吸取教训,并在数千个步骤中调整政策. 我们实行电子商务座席制,这是第一个将多轮对口谈判和动态事件纳入一年业务的开源基准. 在365天的时间内,一个LLM代理公司同时经营多个在线商店,研究市场,与供应商谈判以提供库存,优化销售策略,执行订单,处理收益,管理现金流量以最大限度地增加年终总资产。 为了构建一个现实的商边经营环境,产品和供应商数据来自一个真正的电子商务平台,而长达一年的促销日历、自然灾害和供应链冲击不断重塑需求。 对于可再生产,市场双方是决定性的:客户购买和回报遵循固定需求模式,而谈判内核则决定供应商定价,特许权,以及决定,LLM只用于口头化. 我们评价包括年终资产在内的七个方面的18个前沿模型,发现没有任何单一模型占主导地位。 GPT-5.6 常规 索尔收入最高,将10万的开盘股权增长到1,431,425,然而在避免欺诈方面却位列第16位,在业务效率方面位列Fable5的踪迹. 在开放量级模型中,Qune3.8-Max-Preview领先,比GLM5.2(高)高416,252,38%,并实现了地平线上最强的学习,在反复订单中逐渐讨价还价. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/QuenLM/E-Commerce Bench上查阅。

articles.title: Where Do Multilingual Vision-Language Encoders Fail on Low-Resource Languages?
articles.content: Recent multilingual vision--language encoders cover hundreds of languages in a single model, yet on two state-of-the-art instances retrieval on low-resource languages (LRL; e.g. Swahili) trails high-resource ones (HRL; e.g. English) by $30^+$\,pp. We ask where in the trained encoder this gap is located. Prior modality-gap and cross-lingual subspace work suggests a linear language direction at the output crowds out alignment-relevant geometry. We falsify this: LEACE drives the linear language classifier from $>99\%$ to near chance and iterated INLP to $37$--$50\%$ while LRL retrieval moves within $\pm 1.5$\,pp and all tier means within $2.2$\,pp, tracking random controls. The linear bias is a \emph{symptom}, not the cause. Instead, the alignment-causal factor lies along the encoder's forward path: the EOS (end-of-sequence) hidden state's per-language trajectory diverges with depth. Substituting the EOS with its parallel English value three blocks before the projector lifts Swahili from $22.1\%$ to $69.1\%$ on one encoder (and reproduces on the other); three controls rule out pooled-position tautology and English specificity. A front-layer trunk that pulls each language's projection toward the parallel-content centroid corroborates the diagnosis at training time, recovering $+9.6$ / $+17.1$\,pp on LRL XM3600 retrieval (1{,}000-image subset), with consistent gains across three further benchmarks while preserving HRL performance.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 多语言视野语言编码器在低资源语言上失败在哪里?.
articles.content_zh: 最近的多语种视觉语言编码器以单一模式覆盖了数百种语言,然而在两种资源低语言(LRL;例如斯瓦希里语)的先进实例检索中,高资源语言(HRL;例如英语)的检索额为30美元\\\,pp. 我们问这个缺口在训练有素的编码器中在哪里。 先前模式-gap和跨语言子空间的工作建议在输出时采用线性语言方向,挤出与对齐相关的几何. 我们伪造: LEACE 将线性语言分类器从 $ > 99%\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\LLLLLRL检索在 $\pm 1.5$\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\ 线性偏差是一个\emph{ symptom},而不是原因 。 相反,对齐-因子位于编码器的前进路径上: EOS(序列的末端)隐藏的每个语言的轨迹随深度而异. 在投影机将斯瓦希里语从22.1美元提升到69.1美元之前,用其平行的英语值替换EOS(一个编码器上是22.1美元),另一个编码器上是复制的;三个控制器排除了集合位置的同位素和英语的特异性. 将每种语言的投影引向平行内容的中间体的前层树干证实了培训时的诊断,在LRL XM3600检索(1{,} 000-image子集)上回收了9.6美元/17.1美元/pp美元,在保持HRL性能的同时在另外三个基准上取得一致的收益。

articles.title: Mind the Gap: Theory-of-Mind-Grounded Friction for Epistemic Alignment
articles.content: Productive dialogue alignment requires distinguishing \emph{surface coordination} (acknowledgments and smooth task progression) from \emph{epistemic alignment} (convergence of belief states); standard preference-based methods typically optimize response-level preferences without explicitly modeling the latter. We operationalize Theory-of-Mind (ToM) inference as a control signal within Frictive Policy Optimization by extracting, at each referring expression, a four-part belief structure: the speaker's intended referent, the addressee's interpretation, and each participant's model of the other's belief. This makes friction mechanically computable from epistemic-state comparisons, capturing \emph{silent divergence}, where both participants proceed confidently while grounding to different referents. We evaluate the signal at two levels. At the representation level, ablating the second-order channel reduces misunderstanding recall from $65\%$ to $26\%$. At the policy level, reward-shaping (FAR) and trust-region (FTR) variants improve intervention F1 and warranted-context calibration over DPO, with Brier scores independently supporting the calibration gains. Across three training runs, FAR and FTR remain substantially more stable, whereas DPO varies widely and can degrade intervention competence already present in the base policy. Thus, ToM-grounded friction provides a trainable signal for context-sensitive intervention under referential belief divergence.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 注意缺口: 静脉对齐的定理
articles.content_zh: 生产性对话对接需要区分\emph{表面协调}(承认和顺利的任务进展)和\emph{流行病对接}(信念状态的趋同);基于标准偏好的方法通常在没有明确模拟后者的情况下优化反应级别偏好。 我们通过在每个参考表达方式中提取一个四部分的信念结构,即演讲者意图的参考者,收件人的解释,以及每位参与者对对方信仰的模型,将思维理论(toM)推论(to-of-Mind)作为激励政策优化中的控制信号进行操作. 这使得摩擦在机械上可以从感官与状态的比较中计算出来,捕捉\emph{silent difference},其中双方参与者都自信地进行,同时对不同的参照物进行搁浅. 我们从两个层面评估信号 在代表一级,二等频道的铺设将误解从65美元减少到26美元。 在政策层面,奖励-塑造(FAR)和信托-区域(FTR)的变体改进了干预F1和对DPO的合理校准,布里尔得分独立支持校准收益. 在整个三次培训中,FAR和FTR保持了大幅度的稳定性,而DPO则大不相同,可能会降低基础政策中已经存在的干预能力。 因此,基于Tom的摩擦为在偏好信仰分歧下进行环境敏感干预提供了一个可调节的信号。

articles.title: SocialReasonBench: A Video-QA Benchmark for Social Reasoning with Counterfactual Narrative Videos
articles.content: Recent advances in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have greatly improved video understanding, yet their ability to reason about human-centered social situations remains limited. Existing benchmarks typically rely on videos with a single observed trajectory, making it difficult to determine whether models truly understand social dynamics or merely exploit recurring narrative patterns. We introduce SocialReasonBench, a video multiple-choice QA benchmark for evaluating socially grounded reasoning in scenarios derived from interactive narratives. Built from gameplay videos of Detroit: Become Human, the benchmark leverages branching storylines where player decisions lead to alternative social outcomes that can be checked against the game's own script, flowchart, and recorded branches. We develop a multi-agent curation pipeline that localizes socially meaningful clips, grounds answer labels in game-state signals, and generates theory-guided questions with diagnostic distractors. SocialReasonBench covers seven reasoning dimensions, including intent recognition, emotional empathy, moral dilemma, counterfactual reasoning, and causal antecedent. Experiments on contemporary LMMs show that models perform reasonably well on basic social understanding but struggle with counterfactual and causal reasoning. Further ablation and diagnostic error analyses reveal that models often depend on incomplete modality cues and fall into reasoning traps such as visual shortcuts, highlighting a gap between observable event recognition and deeper reasoning over latent social states.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 社会思想 座席:用反事实描述视频进行社会理性分析的视频-QA基准
articles.content_zh: 大型多式联运模式(LMMs)最近的进展大大提高了对视频的了解,然而,它们对以人为中心的社会状况进行解释的能力仍然有限。 现有基准通常依靠具有单一观测轨迹的视频,因此很难确定模型是真正理解社会动态还是仅仅利用反复出现的叙述模式. 我们引入了SocialReason Bench,这是一个多选择的视频QA基准,用于评价从互动叙事衍生出来的情景中基于社会理由的推理. 由底特律:成为人类(Betroit: Become Human)的游戏游戏视频所建,基准杠杆是分支故事线,玩家的决定导致替代社会结果,可以对照游戏自己的脚本,流程图,以及录制的分支来检查. 我们开发了一个多剂解析管道,将具有社会意义的剪辑本地化,游戏状态信号中的地面解答标签,并生成带有诊断分心器的理论指导问题. SocialReason Bench涵盖了七个推理层面,包括意向识别,情感共鸣,道德困境,反事实推理,以及因果前因. 对当代LMMs的实验表明,模型在基本的社会理解上表现得相当好,但与反事实和因果推理斗争. 进一步的衰减和诊断错误分析显示,模型往往依赖于不完全的模式提示,并落入视觉捷径等推理陷阱,凸显了可观测事件识别与潜伏社会状态的更深层次推理之间的差距.

articles.title: GUIDE: Guiding Internal Evidence with Language Instructions
articles.content: Large multimodal models follow instructions about what to generate, but not necessarily about what evidence to rely on. Hence, models may continue to depend on shortcut-associated cues even when instructions suggest otherwise. We introduce GUIDE, a framework for controlling internal evidence usage through language instructions. GUIDE combines grouped parameter-efficient adaptation with instruction-conditioned gating to modulate multimodal evidence pathways during reasoning and generation. We further introduce a pathway-level evaluation framework that characterizes instruction-conditioned evidence modulation through reliance sensitivity, controlled perturbation analysis, pathway modulation, and autoregressive decoding dynamics. Across multimodal reasoning, classification, and generation, GUIDE induces structured and instruction-aligned redistribution of evidence reliance while largely preserving task behavior. Experiments on GQA, TextVQA, MM-IMDb, CREMA-D, RAVDESS, and Flickr30K show that GUIDE improves robustness under targeted evidence perturbations and enables controllable modulation across diverse multimodal settings. This suggests that multimodal instruction following can extend beyond output control toward regulating how different evidence sources contribute to model predictions.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 指南:指导内部证据与语言指导
articles.content_zh: 大型多式联运模型遵循关于生成什么的指示,但不一定遵循关于依赖什么证据的指示。 因此,即使指示另有说明,模型也可能继续依赖快捷键。 我们采用《指导准则》,这是一个通过语言指示控制内部证据使用的框架。 指导准则将分类参数效率调整与指令条件调整结合起来,以便在推理和生成过程中调整多式联运证据路径。 我们还引入了一个路径级评价框架,该框架通过依赖敏感性、控制扰动分析、路径调值和自动解码动态来描述具有指导条件的证据调值特点。 通过多模式推理、分类和生成,《准则》诱导对证据依赖进行结构化和指令化的再分配,同时在很大程度上保持任务行为。 关于GQA、TextVQA、MM-IMDb、CREMA-D、RAVDESS和Flickr30K的实验表明,在有针对性的证据扰动下,《指导准则》提高了稳健性,并能够在不同多式联运环境中进行可控调制。 这表明,所遵循的多式联运指令可以超越产出控制,进而规范不同证据来源如何有助于模型预测。

articles.title: SingProbe Technical Report
articles.content: Runtime guardrails are essential for reliable large language model (LLM) deployment, yet existing approaches typically rely on independent, external models that introduce additional inference cost, delayed safety signals, and a capacity mismatch with increasingly capable base models. To address these issues, we introduce SingProbe, a lightweight intrinsic runtime guard that directly reuses hidden states produced during LLM inference and operates alongside autoregressive decoding. Within a unified framework, SingProbe continuously predicts query intent, response safety, and hallucination risk at the token level with negligible additional guardrail inference overhead, offering a "free-lunch" solution. We further introduce SingStreamBench, a benchmark designed to assess whether streaming guardrails remain inactive on benign prefixes while promptly detecting emerging unsafe content. Extensive experiments show that SingProbe achieves competitive or superior performance compared with substantially larger standalone guardrails and specialized hallucination detectors, with only $\approx$2M parameters and $<0.5\%$ extra overhead. Beyond passive detection, we also show that SingProbe scores can anticipate future generation risk and guide constrained safe decoding. We further extend this paradigm to medical generation through SingProbe-Med, which selectively activates risk-directed decoding interventions only when clinically relevant risks emerge. Together, these results demonstrate that internal model representations provide an effective and efficient interface for generation-time monitoring and control.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: SingProbe 技术报告
articles.content_zh: 运行时护栏对可靠的大型语言模型(LLM)的部署至关重要,但现有方法通常依赖独立的外部模型,这些模型引入了额外的推论成本,延迟了安全信号,以及能力与日益有能力的基础模型不匹配. 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了SingProbe, 一种轻量级的内在运行时护卫, 它直接再利用LLM推论期间产生的隐藏状态, 并同时进行自旋解码。 在统一的框架内,SingProbe持续预测在信使级别上的查询意图,响应安全,和幻觉风险,加上可忽略不计的额外护栏推导机顶,提供了一个"自由流"解决方案. 我们进一步引入SingStream Bench,这是一个用于评估流体护栏在良性前缀上是否仍然闲置,同时迅速发现新出现的不安全内容的基准. 广泛的实验表明,SingProbe与大得多的独立护栏和专用的幻觉探测器相比,其性能具有竞争力或优异性能,只有约2百万美元的参数和0.5美元的额外间接费用。 除了被动检测之外,我们还显示SingProbe分数可以预见到未来世代的风险,并引导受约束的安全解码. 我们通过SingProbe-Med将这一模式进一步推广到医疗生成,只有临床相关风险出现时,SingProbe-Med才有选择地启动风险定向解码干预。 这些结果共同表明,内部模型表述为生成时间监测和控制提供了切实有效的接口。

articles.title: An Agentic Retrobiosynthesis Framework with Learned Frontier Selection
articles.content: Large language models are increasingly used as agents for multistep retrosynthesis, raising the question of how much their search policy contributes independently of the underlying reaction model. We investigate this question in a biological setting through rule-based retrobiosynthesis: a deterministic biochemical engine generates the same validated transitions for every method, searching for routes that terminate in metabolites available to an \emph{Escherichia coli} chassis, while the policy only selects which frontier molecule to expand next. Prompted and LoRA-tuned Qwen2.5-7B policies use a strict choice-only interface. The fine-tuned policy reaches $65\pm1$\% solve rate at 10 expansions on LASER versus 59\% for MCTS, and at 200 expansions reaches $78\pm1$\% versus 75\% on LASER, $88\pm3$\% versus 80\% on the RetroPath RL Golden benchmark, and $63\pm2$\% versus 45\% on the BioNavi-NP benchmark. Fine-tuning also consistently outperforms direct prompting. These results show that route-supervised frontier selection can improve budgeted search without altering biochemical generation, although performance remains dependent on frontier construction and reaction ranking.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 与 " 学习边界选择 " 相结合的代理生物合成框架
articles.content_zh: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用作多步反转合成的剂剂,从而提出了其搜索政策独立于基础反应模型贡献多少的问题. 我们在生物环境中通过基于规则的反生合成来调查这个问题:一种定型生化引擎为每一种方法产生相同的经验证的过渡,寻找终止一个\emph{Escherichia coli}底盘可用的代谢物的路线,而政策只选择下一步要扩展的前沿分子. 提示和LORA-tuned Quen2.5-7B政策使用严格的只选择界面. 微调后的政策在LASER对59%的扩展中达到了65\pm1$\%的解答率,在LASER对79%的扩展中达到了78\pm1$\%的解答率,在LASER对75%的扩展中达到了88\pm3$\%的解答率,在RetroPath RL Golden的基准中达到了80\的解答率,在BioNavi-NP的基准中达到了63\pm2$\%的解答率与45\\%的解答率. 微调也始终超过直接提示。 这些结果表明,经过路线监督的前沿选择可以改善预算搜索而不会改变生化生成,尽管性能仍然取决于前沿建设和反应排名.

articles.title: Beyond the Payload: How User Invocation Shapes Coding Agent Vulnerability to Repository Poisoning
articles.content: Coding agents are increasingly used for software engineering tasks, including bootstrapping projects from third-party repositories whose integrity cannot be assumed. Prior work on repository poisoning largely focuses on attacker-controlled injection and disguise, but developers also shape risk through everyday invocation choices: what task to delegate, how to phrase the request, and which skills or rules to supply. We term these user-side choices Prompt-Level Configurations (PLCs) and introduce CIPR (Coding In Poisoned Repos), the first benchmark that systematically varies PLCs in poisoned real-world repositories. CIPR comprises 1,920 instances across 20 repositories, four task types, three social-media-grounded prompt styles, and three skill/rule conditions, and measures attack success rate (ASR) and agent alert rate (AR) using automated runtime and trace-based oracles. Our evaluation reveals two key insights: (1) Vulnerability is highly context-dependent, with task type creating up to a 4.5-fold difference in ASR, with test-execution task forming a silent attack surface (high ASR, low AR). (2) Prompt expression shifts risk indirectly: underspecified prompts reduce ASR by truncating execution depth; noisy prompts exhibit a directional trend toward suppressing alerts by making malicious content less conspicuous. These findings highlight that coding agent vulnerability is not a static property, but a dynamic outcome shaped by everyday user configurations.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 超过有效载荷:用户如何调用形状编码代理对存储器中毒的脆弱性
articles.content_zh: 编码剂越来越多地用于软件工程任务,包括不能假定完整性的第三方寄存器的拖曳项目。 之前关于寄存器中毒的工作主要集中于攻击者控制的注射和伪装,但开发者也通过日常引用选择来塑造风险:授权的任务,如何对请求进行短语,以及提供哪些技能或规则. 我们使用这些用户端选择 Point-Level配置(PLCs) 并引入 CIPR(在有毒的 Repos 中编码) , 这是第一个在有毒真实世界寄存器中系统改变 PLC 的基准 。 中心包括20个寄存器的1 920个案例、4个任务类型、3个基于社交媒体的即时样式、3个技能/规则条件,以及使用自动运行时间和微量轨道攻击成功率和代理预警率的措施。 我们的评估揭示了两个主要见解: (1)脆弱性高度依赖上下文,任务类型在ASR中产生高达4.5倍的差异,测试-执行任务形成无声攻击表面(高ASR,低AR). (2) 即时表达转换风险是间接的:不精确的提示通过缩短执行深度来降低ASR;响亮的提示显示方向性趋势,通过使恶意内容不那么明显来压制警报。 这些调查结果突出表明,编码剂的脆弱性不是一个静态属性,而是由日常用户配置形成的动态结果.

articles.title: WildSEEK: Evaluating Language Models for Information-Seeking
articles.content: Language models are increasingly mediating information access to end users, urging a systematic evaluation of their responses for a fair and reliable information ecosystem. Existing evaluations, however, are often topic-specific or synthetic, limiting their ability to capture the complexity of "in the wild" information-seeking queries and the risks present in model responses. To address this gap, we introduce WildSEEK, a manually annotated dataset of 3k information-seeking queries from real user interactions, and an evaluation framework for LLM-generated responses. WildSEEK includes annotations for risk-sensitive domains (e.g. health and financial information), and distinguishes factoid queries from analytical queries which seek responses beyond facts. We train classifiers on WildSEEK to analyze more than 1.8M realistic user queries. We find that over a third of information-seeking queries are high-risk and more often analytical. Our findings show that LLM responses fail more often in four criteria: sycophantic behavior, overreliance, a default US-centric perspective, and poor handling of vulnerable populations -- with failure rates being mostly higher for analytical queries. By providing methods to monitor the reliability, safety, and fairness of LLM behavior, our dataset and evaluation framework offer an empirical foundation for the broader question of how these systems should behave as they take on a growing role in information access.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: WildSEEK:评估信息搜索语言模型
articles.content_zh: 语言模式越来越多地为最终用户的信息获取提供调解,敦促系统地评价他们的反应,以建立一个公平和可靠的信息生态系统。 然而,现有的评价往往是针对特定主题的或合成的,限制了它们捕捉"野外"信息搜索询问的复杂性以及模型响应中存在的风险的能力. 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了WildSEEK,一个手动附加说明的数据集,其中包含3k从真正的用户互动中寻找信息的查询,以及LLM生成的响应的评价框架. WildSEEK包括风险敏感领域的说明(如健康和财务信息),并区分事实调查与寻求超出事实范围的答复的分析调查。 我们在WildSEEK上培训分类人员,分析超过1.8M现实的用户查询. 我们认为,三分之一以上的寻求信息的查询是高风险的,而且往往是分析性的。 我们的研究结果显示,LLM反应在四个标准中更常见的失败:共生行为,过度依赖,默认的以美国为中心的视角,以及对弱势人群的处理不当——分析询问的失败率大多更高. 通过提供监测LLM行为的可靠性、安全性和公正性的方法,我们的数据集和评价框架为更广泛的问题提供了一个经验基础,即这些系统在信息获取方面如何发挥越来越大的作用。

articles.title: LCoT-GV: Graph Attention Networks for Verifying Long Reasoning Chains in Large Language Models
articles.content: Large Reasoning Models produce Long Chains-of-Thought (LCoTs) which involve breaking down the problem into smaller reasoning steps before reaching the conclusion. However, these steps often contain contradictions, unsupported inferences, or irrelevant steps, even when the final answer is correct. We propose Long Chain-of-Thought Graph Verifier (LCoT-GV), a graph-based framework that represents LCoTs as reasoning graphs. Each node in the graph represents a reasoning step and the edges encode semantic and logical relations. A Graph Attention Network is then trained to predict chain-of-thought correctness from the reasoning graph. We construct a new graph-oriented verification dataset from multiple reasoning benchmarks for question answering in various domains. The results show that our method is competitive with the most similar approaches.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: LCoT-GV:大语言模型中用于验证长理性链的图表关注网络
articles.content_zh: 大原因 模型产生"思想的长链"(LCOTs),涉及在达成结论之前将问题分解为较小的推理步骤. 然而,这些步骤往往包含矛盾,不支持的推论,或者不相关的步骤,即使最终答案是正确的. 我们提出长链图形验证器(LCoT-GV),这个以图表为基础的框架代表LCoTs作为推理图表. 图中的每个节点代表一个推理步骤和边缘编码语义和逻辑关系. 然后培训一个图表关注网络,从推理图中预测思维链正确性。 我们从多个推理基准中构建了一个新的面向图表的核查数据集,用于各领域的回答问题。 结果显示,我们的方法与最相似的方法具有竞争力。

articles.title: OCR-MetaReasoning Benchmark: Evaluating the Meta-Reasoning Ability of MLLMs in Text-Rich Image Understanding
articles.content: Text-rich image understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to organize OCR (Optical Character Recognition)-grounded evidence across words, layout, fields, charts, and visual correspondences. Existing evaluations often conflate extraction with reasoning and rarely test whether models follow the required reasoning direction: applying visible rules, abstracting hidden regularities, or recovering missing premises. We introduce OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark that treats deduction, induction, and abduction as distinct directions and separates final-answer correctness from reasoning-process compliance. The benchmark contains 1,500 verified samples in a balanced \(3\times5\) taxonomy crossing three reasoning types with five OCR-object categories, along with reference reasoning steps, automatic answer scoring, the Meta-Reasoning Macro Score (MRMS), and the Reasoning Process Compliance Score (RPCS). Experiments with representative closed-source and open-source MLLMs show that OCR-grounded meta-reasoning remains far from saturated: models struggle with visible-rule application and layout-sensitive inference, while process-compliant rationales can accompany incorrect final answers under exact-match evaluation. The code is available at https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: OCR-Meta Reasoning (英语). 基准: 评价文本- Rich 图像理解中 MLLMs 的元重振能力
articles.content_zh: 文本丰富的图像理解需要多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)来组织OCR(Optical C字符识别)基于证据,跨越文字,布局,字段,图表,以及视觉对应. 现有评价往往将提取与推理混为一谈,很少测试模型是否遵循了所要求的推理方向:应用可见规则,抽象隐藏规律,或恢复缺失的前提. 我们采用了OCR-MetaReasoning,这是一个控制下的单一图像基准,将扣减、诱导和绑架作为不同的方向,并将最终答案的正确性与推理过程的合规性区分开来。 基准包含1,500个经核实的样本,在一个平衡的\(3\time5\)分类学中,跨越了三个推理类型,包含5个OCR-对象类别,以及参考推理步骤,自动回答分数,Meta-Reasoning Macro分数(MRMS),以及理性过程遵守分数(RPCS). 具有代表性的闭源和开源MLLMs的实验表明,OCR基于元理性仍然远未饱和:模型与可见规则应用和布局敏感推论发生斗争,而符合过程的原理可以在精确匹配评价下伴随不正确的最终答案. 该代码可查阅https://github.com/gengxuli/OCR-MetaReasoning.

articles.title: MURANO: Design, Run, and Reproduce Mechanistic Interpretability Experiments as Composable Pipelines
articles.content: This paper presents Murano, an open source framework for designing, running, and reproducing mechanistic interpretability studies of large language models, intended for researchers across disciplines. These studies often combine loading, recording, attribution, intervention, and evaluation, while existing libraries tend to focus on different parts of this workflow. As a result, researchers using several libraries may need to adapt outputs from one for use by another. To bridge this gap, Murano represents operations from these five areas as composable steps. Steps exchange named result artifacts and declare the inputs they require and the outputs they produce. A pipeline executes its steps in the order supplied, and Murano uses canonical addresses when component identities pass between operations. Murano builds on existing interpretability and machine learning libraries. We demonstrate Murano through two reproductions of established interpretability studies and one illustrative sparse autoencoder case study.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: MURNO: 设计、运行和复制机械解释实验
articles.content_zh: 本文介绍Murano,是用于设计,运行,复制大语言模型的机械解释性研究的开源框架,供跨学科的研究人员使用. 这些研究往往将加载,记录,归属,干预和评价结合起来,而现有的图书馆则倾向于侧重于这一工作流程的不同部分. 因此,利用若干图书馆的研究人员可能需要将产出从一个图书馆调整为另一个图书馆使用。 为了弥补这一差距,村野将这五个地区的业务作为可调和的步骤。 步骤交换指定了结果的文物,并申报它们所需要的投入及其产出。 管道按提供的顺序执行步骤,当组件身份在操作之间传递时,村野使用犬形地址. 村野以现有的可解释性和机器学习图书馆为基础。 我们通过两次复制既定的可解释性研究和一次说明性稀疏的自动编码器案例研究来展示村野。

articles.title: SwarmBench: Can Large Language Models Act as Agent Swarm Orchestrators?
articles.content: Large language model-based multi-agent systems are evolving from fixed interaction topologies toward dynamically orchestrated Agent Swarms. However, existing benchmarks are still largely based on single-agent or general-purpose agent tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate key orchestration capabilities. We propose SwarmBench, a benchmark that evaluates model performance from multiple perspectives, including accuracy, efficiency, cost, and process quality. Experimental results show that current models exhibit substantial differences in orchestration capability. These differences are reflected not only in final accuracy, efficiency, and cost, but also in the overall quality of the orchestration process itself. Based on these findings, we further propose SwarmExp, a simple yet effective method based on experience extraction and experience replay, which consistently improves the orchestration performance of large language models.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: Swarm Bench:作为Swarm Orchestrators特工的大语言模型法案可以吗?.
articles.content_zh: 大型基于语言模型的多剂系统正在从固定的相互作用地形演变为动态的布局剂Swarms。 然而,现有的基准仍然在很大程度上以单一代理人或普通用途代理人的任务为基础,因此难以系统地评估关键的指挥能力。 我们提议采用Swarm Bench这一基准,从多个角度评价模型性能,包括准确性、效率、成本和工艺质量。 实验结果显示,目前的模型在管弦能力上表现出很大的差异. 这些差异不仅体现在最终的准确性、效率和成本方面,还体现在协调过程本身的整体质量方面。 基于这些发现,我们进一步提出SwarmExp,这是一种基于经验提取和经验重播的简单而有效的方法,它不断提高大型语言模型的管弦演奏性能.

articles.title: Geometry of Divergence: Tracking Hidden-State Trajectories for Adaptive Multi-Turn Reasoning
articles.content: LLM agents need to sustain goal-consistent reasoning across long multi-turn interactions under strict resource constraints. However, as the multi-turn context accumulates, it can destabilize the underlying LLM's internal representation of task-relevant information from earlier turns, blurring the boundary between constructive reasoning and representation drift. We formulate multi-turn reasoning as a hidden-state trajectory of the underlying LLM that is characterized via two complementary signals: temporal curvature that captures the directional consistency of turn-to-turn updates, and variance slope which measures the expansion or contraction of the exploration space. Across four tasks and three underlying LLMs, we observed that these geometric signals distinguish between correct and incorrect episodes prior to completion. We further decompose each episode into three-action chains formed from four actions (Read, Write, Respond, Transfer) and show that separability is action-dependent, with different signals distinguishing various chain patterns. Our experiments demonstrate that trajectory geometry can identify critical turns in the reasoning process, increasing task success rates on $τ$-Bench from 24.1% to 39.6% while reducing token cost by 11.2%.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 差异几何:跟踪隐藏状态轨迹以适应性多变理性
articles.content_zh: 在严格的资源限制下,LLM代理人需要在多回合长期互动中保持目标一致的推理. 然而,随着多回合背景的积累,它可能会动摇LLM对早先回合中与任务有关的信息的内部表述,模糊了建设性推理和代表性漂移之间的界限. 我们提出多回合推理,作为基础LLM的隐藏状态轨迹,通过两个互补信号加以描述:捕捉转动更新方向一致性的时间曲率和测量勘探空间扩张或收缩的偏移坡度。 在四项任务和三项基本有限责任清单中,我们观察到,这些几何信号在完成之前区分了正确和不正确的情况。 我们进一步将每集分解成由四个动作(读,写,回,转)形成的三个动作链,并显示可分离性是动作依赖的,不同的信号区分了各种链式. 我们的实验表明,轨迹几何可以识别推理过程中的关键转折,将币元-奔驰的任务成功率从24.1%提高到39.6%,同时将象征性成本降低11.2%。

articles.title: Where Identity Lives: Localized, Retain-Free Identity Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
articles.content: Removing a specific individual's information from multimodal large language models (MLLMs) is often needed after deployment, but existing methods rely on a retain set, which is hardest to obtain at that point, and rebuilding it recreates the privacy exposure that unlearning aims to remove. Forgetting from the forget set alone instead damages the shared visual-language computation, harming perception. We cast retain-free unlearning as a localization problem: causal tracing, weight transplant, and Fisher overlap all point to early-to-mid decoder MLPs as the layers where identity information is stored and, unlike other module families, can be modified without substantially disrupting vision. We turn this into Pathway-Aware Visual-attribute Anchoring (PAVA), which confines updates to these layers and pairs a forget loss with a visual-attribute anchor that preserves image-grounded behavior by distilling the model's own pre-unlearning answers from the forget images alone. On MLLMU-Bench and ReMem, PAVA gives the strongest forget-retain trade-off among forget-set-only methods and remains competitive with retain-based baselines.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 身份生活:本地化、保留自由身份 不学习多种大语文模式
articles.content_zh: 从多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)中移除特定个人的信息,在部署后往往需要,但现有方法依赖于一个保留集,这在当时最难获得,并重建它重新创造出未学会去除的隐私曝光. 仅仅从遗忘中忘记,反而损害共同的视觉语言计算,损害认知。 我们把无保留无学习作为一个本地化问题:因果追踪,重量移植,费舍尔重叠都指向早期到中间的解码器MLP作为存储身份信息的层,与其他模块家族不同,可以修改而不会严重干扰视觉. 我们把它变成Pathway-Aware视觉属性安乔林(PAVA), 将更新限制在这些层, 在MLLMU-Bench和ReMem上,PAVA给出了最强的忘却-保留取舍方法,并且仍然具有基于保留的基线的竞争力.

articles.title: What It Costs to Compose, Rebuild, and Correct Precomputed Memory
articles.content: Language models can answer from precomputed memory, a model's saved reading of a body of material, reused across requests instead of read again at each. This paper maps where that practice preserves correctness and the conditions under which it fails. Across experiments on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct using both saved key-value caches and trained compressions of them, precomputed memory degrades when assembled from separately prepared parts, stays current only through rebuilds costing a large fraction of full preparation in our measurements, and ignores corrections served beside it conditional on phrasing. If precomputed memories can be served alongside one another, be cost-efficiently rebuilt, and be superseded by new information arriving in real-time, they can serve as a way to avoid re-feeding context to a model over repeated queries. The implication of our results for a deployed system that deals with a variety of queries is that precomputed memories are best rebuilt on the cadence at which new information changes what the memory was originally computed from. Both warm-rebuilding trained compressions of key-value caches and serving specifically-phrased updates beside a memory, as pasted text or injected cache state, show particular promise for keeping precomputed memories current, the latter as an interim measure between rebuilds, and we measure the cost and name the remaining questions associated with each.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 编译、重建以及正确的预计算内存的成本
articles.content_zh: 语言模型可以从预算的内存中解答,一个模型保存了对一组材料的读取,在请求之间重复使用,而不是在每个请求中再次读取. 本文描绘了这种做法保持正确性和失败的条件。 在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上进行实验时,既使用保存的密钥值缓存,又使用经过训练的压缩,预计算出的内存在从单独准备的部分组装时会退化,只能通过重建来保持电流,在我们的测量中耗尽了全部准备的很大一部分,并且忽略了在它旁边提供的以措辞为条件的校正。 如果预先计算过的记忆可以同时服务,以成本效益高的方式重建,被实时到达的新信息所取代,那么这些记忆可以作为一种方法,避免给模型重新输入上下文,而不是重复询问。 我们的结果对一个处理各种查询的部署系统的影响是,预先计算出来的记忆最好在新信息改变记忆最初从中计算出来的粗略结构上重建。 无论是经过温和重建训练的密钥-值缓存压缩,还是作为粘贴文本或注入缓存状态,在内存旁提供具体表达的更新,都显示出保持预算记忆流的特殊承诺,后者是重建之间的临时措施,我们衡量成本并点出与每个存储相关的剩余问题.

articles.title: BiG-SURE - Bipartite Graph for Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation of LLMs
articles.content: Reliable uncertainty estimation is a crucial requirement for deploying large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) in safety-critical settings, especially when the model parameters are not accessible (black-box). We propose BiG-SURE, an uncertainty estimator based on cross-temperature semantic agreement. The method samples low-temperature responses as stable semantic anchors and high-temperature responses as probes under meaning-preserving input transformations. It then constructs an anchor-probe Bipartite Graph (BiG) using NLI-based entailment scores and defines confidence through the normalized squared spectral energy of this matrix, with uncertainty given by its complement. This bipartite graph-based Semantic Uncertainty and Reliability Estimation (SURE) score measures whether high-temperature probes remain semantically aligned with the model's stable low-temperature belief or not. We evaluate BiG-SURE on text QA, multilingual QA, and multimodal QA tasks across multiple model families. In these experiments, BiG-SURE improves average abstention AUROC over prior black-box uncertainty estimators, while remaining simple, unsupervised, and applicable to black-box model settings.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: BiG-SURE - 有限责任公司语义不确定性和可靠性估计的双面图
articles.content_zh: 可靠的不确定性估算是在安全关键环境下部署大型语言模型(LLM)和视觉语言模型(VLM)的关键要求,特别是在模型参数无法获取(黑盒)的情况下. 我们提出BiG-SURE,一个基于跨温度语义协议的不确定性估计器. 该方法将低温反应样品作为稳定的语义锚和高温反应作为意义保留输入变换下的探测器. 然后,它利用基于NLI的内含分数构建锚定-概率双方图(BIG),并通过这个矩阵的正方形光谱能量定义信心,其补充给出了不确定性. 这种基于双面图的语义不确定性和可靠性估计(SURE)测量高温探测器是否仍然与模型的稳定低温信念保持同步. 我们对文本QA、多语种QA和多种模式QA任务的评价。 在这些实验中,BiG-SURE改进了平均弃权的AUROC比之前的黑盒不确定性估计器,同时保持简单,不受监督,并适用于黑盒模型设置.

articles.title: GMTS: Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection Improves RLVR Training for LLM Reasoning
articles.content: Reinforcement learning (RL), particularly RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), has recently emerged as a central paradigm for enhancing large language models' (LLMs) reasoning abilities, demonstrating remarkable effectiveness across reasoning tasks. Recent studies suggest that high-entropy tokens play an exceptionally important role in model training, since training with only the highest 20% entropy tokens yields significant performance gains. However, why such high-entropy tokens are beneficial remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we find that although high-entropy tokens within one answer tend to correlate with large gradient magnitude, entropy alone fails to consistently reflect token importance across different answers, considering the variations in the answer-level reward signals. Based on this observation, we introduce the Gradient Magnitude-based Token Selection (GMTS) method to quantify token importance, which leverages the entropy-gradient connection to approximate gradient-magnitude rankings for token selection. We find that training on the top 20% tokens ranked by GMTS consistently outperforms entropy-based token selection across three reasoning domains and various model sizes, suggesting that GMTS provides a more fine-grained estimate of token contribution for RLVR training.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: GMTS:基于梯度磁量的托肯选择改进LLM的RLVR培训 理由说明
articles.content_zh: 强化学习(RL),特别是具有可验证奖励(RLVR)的RL,最近成为增强大型语言模型'(LLMs)推理能力的中心范式,在推理任务中表现出显著的有效性. 最近的研究表明,高性价比标志在示范培训中发挥着特别重要的作用,因为只有20%的 en标志牌最高的培训能产生显著的绩效收益。 然而,为什么这种高性价比的标志是有好处的,仍然没有得到充分的理解。 在这项工作中,我们发现,虽然一个答案中的高内涵符号往往与大梯度量相关,但考虑到答案等级奖励信号的变异,单是 en无法一致反映不同答案之间的象征性重要性。 基于这一观察,我们引入了基于渐变磁力的Token选择(GMTS)方法,以量化表示值重要性,这种方法利用了近似梯度-渐变的连接来进行表示值选择. 我们发现,GMTS排名前20%的标志性培训,在三个推理领域和各种模型大小上,始终超过基于entropy的标志性选择,这表明GMTS为RLVR培训提供了更加精细的标志性贡献估计.

articles.title: REER-PT: Reverse-Engineered Reasoning for Perplexity-Guided Pre-training Data Augmentation
articles.content: As language-model compute continues to scale, high-quality training data is becoming an increasingly important bottleneck. Conventional next-token prediction supervises what follows a context but leaves the intermediate reasoning behind that continuation implicit. We introduce \textbf{REER-PT}, a scalable framework that extends Reverse-Engineered Reasoning (REER) to raw pre-training data. REER-PT identifies continuations that are difficult to predict but can still be inferred from the preceding context, and inserts concise reasoning annotations that reconstruct the missing connection between context and continuation. Candidate annotations are generated and refined offline, with perplexity serving as the optimization signal. Constraints on length and target leakage filter out unhelpful or trivial annotations. This sparse transformation preserves the source text and remains compatible with standard next-token prediction, avoiding online reasoning rollouts during pre-training. We apply REER-PT to transform a source pre-training corpus into an augmented one. Across augmented-data, original-token, and selected-continuation comparisons, perplexity reductions range from 0.42 to 7.29, and only about 0.05\% of annotation 13-grams appear verbatim in the source text. We then train two 680M-parameter models with the same architecture and training configuration on the source and augmented corpora, respectively. The augmented-data model gains up to 2.07 percentage points on several knowledge and reasoning benchmarks. Together, the perplexity analysis indicates improved continuation predictability, while the controlled pre-training experiments suggest that this augmentation can improve model performance without changing the standard pre-training objective.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: REER-PT: 偏差的反向工程原因 - 指导前培训数据增强
articles.content_zh: 随着语言模型计算继续扩大,高质量的培训数据正成为日益重要的瓶颈。 常规的后继预测对上下文进行监管,但对延续背后的中间推理留有隐含。 我们引入\textbf{REER-PT},一个可扩展的框架,将逆向工程理性(REER)延伸至原始的预训练数据. REER-PT识别出难以预测但仍可以从前一种上下文推断的续作,并插入简洁的推理说明,重建上下文和续作之间缺失的连接. 候选人说明会生成和完善离线,而模糊性则充当优化信号. 对长度和目标泄漏的限制过滤出无益或无关紧要的说明。 这种稀疏的转变保留了源文本,并且仍然与标准的下接键预测兼容,避免了在预训期间的在线推理推出. 我们使用REER-PT将源培训前的教程转化为扩充的教程. 纵观扩充数据、原始数据以及选定的连续数据比较,复杂程度的减少幅度从0.42到7.29不等,只有约0.05+%的注解13克在源文本中逐字显示。 然后,我们培训了两个680M参数模型,在源头和训练配置上分别具有相同的结构和训练配置,并扩充了corpora. 扩大后的数据模型在若干知识和推理基准上提高了2.07个百分点。 复杂度分析加在一起表明持续可预测性提高,而受控的训练前实验表明,这种增强可以改善模型性能,而不会改变标准的培训前目标.

articles.title: Hidden Threat in Synthetic Data: Covert Targeted Bias Injection through Benign Text
articles.content: Synthetic data is increasingly used to train large language models (LLMs), yet its security implications remain poorly understood. Prior work on subliminal learning suggests that models can inherit behavioral traits from seemingly unrelated training data. In this work, we investigate whether such mechanisms can be exploited to inject targeted social biases into aligned models through semantically benign synthetic data. We construct a pipeline in which a misaligned teacher model generates filtered synthetic datasets across domains such as creative writing and code generation, which are then used to fine-tune aligned student models. Our experiments show that benign-looking synthetic data can act as a covert channel for transmitting targeted biases while largely preserving the student model's general task capabilities. These results reveal a previously underexplored security risk in synthetic data-driven LLM training pipelines and highlight the need for improved safeguards. As one possible step toward this goal, we suggest that log-linearity-based scoring may provide a useful signal for screening seemingly benign synthetic data.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 在合成中隐藏威胁 数据:通过Benign文本进行隐蔽定向bias注射
articles.content_zh: 合成数据越来越多地用于训练大型语言模型(LLMs),但其安全影响仍然没有得到很好的理解. 先前关于潜意识学习的研究表明模型可以从看似无关的训练数据中继承行为特征. 在这项工作中,我们调查是否可以利用这种机制,通过无害的合成数据,将有针对性的社会偏见注入一致的模型。 我们构建了一个管道,一个错误的师范模型在其中生成跨越创意写作和代码生成等领域过滤的合成数据集,然后用于微调校正的学生模型. 我们的实验表明,良性外观的合成数据可以作为传播目标偏差的秘密渠道,同时在很大程度上保留学生模型的一般任务能力. 这些结果表明,在合成数据驱动的LLM培训管道中,安全风险过去未得到充分探讨,并强调需要改进保障措施。 作为实现这一目标的一个可能步骤,我们建议以对数线性为基础的评分可为筛选看似无害的合成数据提供有用的信号。

articles.title: TaxCE : A Framework for Automated Taxonomy Construction and Evaluation at Scale
articles.content: Organizing unstructured feedback text into hierarchical taxonomy is a fundamental challenge in NLP, particularly in domains where feedback arrives at massive scale in varied forms such as reviews, transcripts, and surveys. Existing approaches either produce shallow hierarchies, neglect long-tail topics, or lack rigorous evaluation frameworks. We present TaxCE, a fully automated framework that constructs multi-level hierarchical taxonomies from raw text through progressive condensation of corpus content into actionable segments, deduplicated semantic units, and granular topics with definitions, which are then organized bottom-up into a hierarchy with corpus-groundedness. We also introduce three corpus-grounded evaluation metrics, Exclusivity, Exhaustivity, and Granularity (EEG), and integrate them into a metrics-in-the-loop iterative refinement mechanism that diagnoses deficiencies and applies targeted corrections until convergence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TaxCE consistently outperforms existing baselines spanning classical topic models, neural methods, and LLM-based approaches, with average improvements of 11.8, 20.5, and 15.7 percentage points in exclusivity, exhaustivity, and granularity respectively over the strongest baseline. Human evaluation further confirms superior taxonomy quality, actionability, and navigability.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: TaxCE:规模自动化分类学建设和评价框架
articles.content_zh: 将无结构的反馈文本组织成分级分类是NLP的一个根本挑战,特别是在反馈以审查、记录和调查等不同形式大规模实现的领域。 现有办法要么产生浅薄的等级,要么忽略长尾议题,要么缺乏严格的评价框架。 我们提出TaxCE,这是一个完全自动化的框架,它通过将实体内容逐步压缩成可操作部分、去重复的语义单元和带有定义的颗粒式专题,从原始文本中构建多层次的层次分类,然后从下到上排列成有实体基础的层次。 我们还采用了三个基于实体的评价指标,即 " 包容性 " 、 " 精通度 " 和 " 广度 " (EEG),并将其纳入一个衡量 " 即时 " 迭代完善机制,用以诊断缺陷,并在趋同前采用有针对性的矫正方法。 广泛的实验表明,TaxCE的业绩一贯超过涵盖古典主题模型、神经方法和LLM方法的现有基线,在排他性、疲劳性和颗粒性方面分别比最强的基准平均提高11.8、20.5和15.7个百分点。 人类评价进一步确认了较高的分类质量、可操作性和可航行性。

articles.title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training
articles.content: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: 阅读新闻:通过继续前期培训使大语言模式适应瑞典新闻学
articles.content_zh: 一般来说,大型语言模型的能力越来越强,但其实用性在优势领域或研究不足领域仍然不大。 解决这一局限性的一个办法是通过对目标领域公司进行额外培训,专门化现有模式。 在这部作品中,我们调查了这种持续的培训前工作,通过使用我们从数百万篇新闻文章中收集的高质量数据集,使大型语言模型适应瑞典新闻。 为了评估适应效果,我们还构建了一个新的具体领域基准,涵盖六项编辑任务。 通过两个模型大小的完整和参数效率的微调,我们发现,持续的培训前在目标领域产生效益,但只有在与经验重播以缓解遗忘的情况下。 我们看到,模型的生成质量和事实知识不断提高,但是它们没有熟练从事歧视性工作。 我们探索一种无培训方法,以便利随后的教学,我们看到进一步的改进,但仅针对受过低级别适应训练的模型。 重要的是,我们表明在适应进程中进行有针对性的评估的重要性,因为现有的瑞典基准在很大程度上未能反映模型的国内绩效收益。

articles.title: PLC-DPO: Posterior Label Correction in Noisy and Ambiguous Preference Optimization
articles.content: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies alignment through pairwise comparisons but assumes all observed preferences are reliable. Real data often violates this assumption, leading to reversed, weak, or ambiguous labels that cause harmful policy updates. To address this, we propose Posterior Label Correction DPO (PLC-DPO) to robustly optimize preferences by routing each pair's training signal as a clean, flip, or tie case. The key idea is to use the calibrated policy-reference margin as online evidence to take appropriate correction actions. This reframes noisy preference learning as actively correcting supervision direction and strength rather than merely filtering suspicious examples. Across 57 dataset-model-benchmark cells, PLC-DPO obtains the best mean win rate against DPO (60.5 vs. 55.5 for the next-best method). Injected-noise and tie stress tests, human disagreement analysis, and self-confirmation diagnostics further show that the routing remains stable and distinguishes flipped from weakly directional pairs.
articles.subject: paper
articles.title_zh: PLC-DPO:噪声和偏好优化的后标签校正
articles.content_zh: 直接偏好优化(DPO)通过对等比较简化对齐,但假设所有观察到的偏好都是可靠的. 真实数据经常违反这一假设,导致出现反向,弱化或模糊的标签,导致对政策进行有害的更新. 为了解决这个问题,我们提议PLC-DPO(PLC-DPO)通过将每对的训练信号作为干净的,翻转的,或领带的外壳,来有力优化偏好. 关键的想法是将校准的政策参考比值作为在线证据,以采取适当的纠正行动。 这重新界定了吵闹的偏好学习,即积极纠正监督方向和力量,而不仅仅是过滤可疑的例子。 在57个数据集-模型-基准单元格中,PLC-DPO在DPO(60.5 vs 55.5 for the next best method)中获得了最佳平均胜率. 注射式噪声和结扎式应力测试,人类的分歧分析,以及自我确认诊断进一步表明,路由仍然稳定,并区别于微弱的方向对.
